v: Ha in Jeremías in tik, yuninal in winhaj Hilcías, yinhtilal in heb' sakerdote kajan t'a chonhab' Anatot t'a yol smakb'en lum Benjamín. Haton t'a jun tik tz'ib'ab'ilkan tas ix yal Jehová t'ayin yik swaleli.
Ix el yich slolon Jehová t'ayin ayik 13 ab'il yoch winhaj Josías yuninal winhaj Amón reyal t'a Judá.

Ix lolonnhej t'ayin ayik ayoch winhaj Joacim yuninal winhaj Josías chi' reyal t'a Judá. Ix lolonnhej pax t'ayin masanto ayik yoil ujal yoch yuxluchil ab'il yoch winhaj Sedequías reyal, yuninal pax winhaj Josías chi'. Ata' ix ik'jib'at heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén icha preso t'a Babilonia.
Ayik ix el yich slolon Jehová t'ayin, ix yalan icha tik:
Ach Jeremías, yiktax manto ach wak' pitzwok t'a a nun, sik'b'ilachxoel wuuj. Ayik manto ach alji, sik'b'ilachxoel wuuj yik tzach och in chekab'ok t'a juntzanh chonhab', xchi t'ayin.
Ix in tak'wi icha tik: Mamin Jehová, ach Wajalil, unin into. Maxto nachaj tas swutej in loloni, xin chi.
Ix yalanxi Jehová chi' t'ayin: Manh ala' to unin ach. Anhej to ol ach b'at b'aj ol ach in chekb'ati, ol alan tas ol in chek ala'.
Malaj mach b'aj tzach xiwi. Ha in Jehová in swala' to ayinnhejoch et'ok yik tzach in kolani, xchi t'ayin.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'ankot sk'ab', ix yak'anoch t'a in ti', ix yalan t'ayin:

Haton wal tiknaik swak'och in lolonel t'a a ti'. Tzach in chekb'at t'a juntzanh chonhab' yik tzalan yab' heb' to ol jawok yaelal t'a yib'anh heb', ol satel heb', ol lajwokem heb'. Ay chonhab' chi' ol satel t'a junelnhej, ay pax ol b'ochajxik'eok, xchi Jehová.
Ix lolonxi Jehová t'ayin, ix yalani: ¿Tas tzil chi' ach Jeremías? xchi. Ha jun te' k'ab' almendro swila', xin chi.
Yel tzala'. Ol wilnhej to a tas swal tik t'ayach ol elk'och t'a elanhchamel, xchi Jehová chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová chi' t'ayin t'a schaelal: ¿Tas tzil chi'? xchi t'ayin. Swil jun lum chen wan xeji, wan stob'kot t'a stojolal norte, xin chi t'ay.
Ix yalanxi t'ayin: Ha t'a norte chi', ata' ol kot yaelal ol jawok t'a yib'anh masanil heb' anima kajan t'a tik.

Ha in Jehová in tik swal t'ayach to ol laj wawtejkot jantak soldado skot t'a juntzanh chonhab' ay t'a norte. Ol oymaj heb' t'a spatiktak chonhab' Jerusalén tik yet' t'a spatiktak juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a smakb'en Judá. Ol jawok sreyal heb', ol sb'oanem sdespacho heb' t'a spuertail Jerusalén tik.

Haton jun yaelal tik ol wak'kot t'a yib'anh heb' anima ix och smul t'ayin. Ix in yaktejkan heb', haxo t'a juntzanh komon Dios ix sb'o heb', ata' ix och heb' ejmelal. Ix snhusanpaxtz'a inkienso heb' t'ay.
Ha tiknaik ak' ip, tek'b'ej a b'a, b'at alan masanil tas ol in chek ala'. Manh ach xiw t'a heb' etanimail chi'. Tato ol ach xiwok, ol ach wak' ib'xokk'e t'a yichanh heb'.

Ha tiknaik tzach wak'och icha junok chonhab' te tek'an, icha wal junok oy nab'a hierro, ma icha muro nab'a bronke. Yuj chi' ol yal a tek'b'an a b'a t'a yichanh chonhab' Judá, t'a yichanh heb' rey, heb' yajal, heb' sakerdote yet' t'a yichanh masanil anima.
Ol yak' owal heb' chi' et'ok, palta a in wal Jehová in swala' to manh ol ach telwok yuj heb', yujto ayinnhejoch et'ok ach in kolani, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:

Ixik, b'at alan yab' heb' aj Jerusalén to a in Jehová in swal t'a heb' icha tik: Tzin nawalkoti ayik ex wak'anoch in chonhab'ok. Ix in he k'anab'ajej wal, ix in he xajanej wal, icha junok ix kob'es toto snupnaji xajanan winh yetb'eyum. Ix ex ochwal tzak'an wuj t'a tzinan lu'um, t'a lum malaj b'aj tz'awchaj tas t'ay.
Ayik chi' wiknhej eyaj a ex israel ex tik, icha wal b'ab'el sat awb'en. Ha in Jehová in swala' to yalnhej mach heb' ex ixtani, ix och smul heb', ix wak'kot yaelal t'a yib'anh heb', xchi t'ayin.
E masanil ex yinhtilalkan winhaj Jacob, haton winhaj Israel, maklejek eyab' tas syal Jehová.

Syalan t'ayex icha tik: ¿Tas in paltail ix yil heb' he mam eyicham? ¿Tas yuj ix in spatikejkanel heb', haxo t'a komon Dios malaj yelk'och b'aj ix yal sb'a heb'? Yuj chi' manhxalaj jab'ok ix ajkan yelk'och heb'.
Majxo in snakot heb', wach'chom a in ix wik'elta heb' t'a Egipto, ix wik'an b'ey heb' t'a lum tzinan lu'um, lum takinh sat, lum pak'kiltak, lum malaj mach kajan t'ay, lum malaj mach tzek' t'a sat.

Ha in ix wak'och heb' t'a lum te yax sat tik, b'aj te ay tas wach' syab'lej heb'. Palta a exxo yinhtilal ex heb' tik, ex kajan ex t'a sat in lu'um tik, ix eyixtejb'at lu'um yuj he chukal, yuj chi' maxtzak scha in k'ol jun in lu'um tik.

Ha heb' sakerdote maxtzak in snakot heb'. Ha heb' tzex k'ayb'ani, maxtzak in yojtakejel heb'. Ha heb' yajal yaj t'a he chonhab', smeltzajoch heb' ajk'olal t'ayin, haxo heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok, a sb'i Baal syalel heb'. Axo t'a komon Dios syal sb'a heb', haton juntzanh malaj jab'ok tas wach' syik' heb' t'ay, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanpax Jehová icha tik: Ha in Jehová in swala' to ol wak' owal eyet'ok yet' pax heb' eyinhtilal.

Ixikek t'a chonhab' Chipre ay t'a snanhal ha' mar, t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, tzeyilan wal. Tze chekanb'at heb' he chekab' t'a chonhab' Cedar t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, sb'at yilan wal heb' tato ayxo b'aj tzuji icha wal jun tik.

¿Tom ay junok chonhab' skomon aktankan sdiosal, wach'chom a sdiosal heb' chi' manh Diosok? Ha exxo ex in chonhab' ex tik, ix in eyaktejkani. Wach'chom a in ix ex wak' wal b'inajok, palta haxo t'a komon Dios malaj yelk'ochi, ata' tzeyal he b'a.
Yuj chi' a in Jehová in swala': Ex kajan ex t'a satcha'anh, satokab' he k'ool, cheklajokab' xiwelal t'a he sat yuj tas wan yuji tik.

Ha in chonhab' tik, cha makan smul ix och t'ayin: Ha in tik lajan in icha sjaj ha ha' sk'euli, palta ix in spatikejeli. Ix sb'oanpax sdiosal lajan icha yet'tal ha ha' jateltakxo, maxtzak yal-laj skan waan ha' t'a yool, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanpax Jehová chi' icha tik: Ha ex in chonhab' Israel ex tik, manh chekab'ok eyajkaneli, palta ¿tas yuj tzex ixtaj icha tz'utaj heb' chekab'?
¿Tas yuj ix och heb' anima ajk'olal t'ayex? Icha yel yaw nok' choj icha chi' yel yaw heb' t'ayex. Ix kan tzinan he lu'um, ix tz'ab'at he chonhab'. Manhxa mach syal skajnaj t'ay.
Ha heb' soldado aj Menfis yet' heb' aj Tafnes yik Egipto, ix smak'poj he jolom heb'.
Haton wal juntzanh tik ix eyik'kot t'a eyib'anh, yujto ix in he patikejel a in Jehová he Diosal in tik, yakb'an ix ex in kuchb'ej b'eyok.

Axo tiknaik ¿tas tzeyak' yala', yuj chi' tzex b'at he k'an skolwal heb' aj Egipto ay t'a sti' ha' Nilo? ¿Tas pax tzeyak' yala' yuj chi' tzex b'at he k'an skolwal heb' aj Asiria ay t'a sti' ha' Éufrates?

Ha in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, a in swala': Ha wal he mul chi' ol ik'ankot eyaelal t'a eyib'anh. Ha he pitalil ol ak'anb'at t'a eyib'anh. Nachajokab'el eyuuj to te chuk ix he k'ulej yujto ix in he patikejeli, a in Jehová he Diosal in. Ol wak'och yaelal t'a eyib'anh yujto malaj welk'och t'ayex, xchi Jehová.

Atax t'a peka' ix ex och ijan he pitan he b'a t'ayin. Maj yal he k'ol ix in he k'anab'ajej. Ix eyalani: Malaj ko gana tzach kak' serwil, xe chi. Axonhej ajmulal ix he k'ulej t'a tzalkixtak yet' t'a yichtak te te' k'ayum xiil.
Icha wal tz'aj yawchaj te' uwa te wach', icha chi' ix aj ex wawani, lajan ex icha yinhatil te' uwa te wach'. ¿Tas yuj lajanxonhej tzex ajkan icha te' kaltakte'al uwa?

Ha in wal Jehová in swala': Wach'chom tze komon b'ikejel he b'a yet' k'een yal taanh, mato niwan xapon tzeyak'ek' t'ayex, palta a he mul chi', chekel yajek' t'a in sat. Malaj b'ak'uinh syal he sakb'ikani.

Tze komon alan icha tik: Ha onh tik maj ko juel ko b'a kalan ko b'a t'a komon Dios, xe chi. Naekkoti, tas ix eyutej he b'a t'a lum ch'olkixtak. Tonhej tzex komon ek' jechechok icha junok nok' nun kamello sayanek' nok' smam.

Lajan ex wal icha junok nok' kaltakte'al nun b'uru k'ajan sb'eyek' b'aj malaj anima, suk'lan nok' tzek' nok' ayik wan stajni nok'. Malaj mach syal syaman wanaj nok'. Ayik stajni nok' chi', sekojtak tz'aj schax nok' yuj nok' mam b'uru chi'.

Ex israel, aktejek he b'eyek' he sayanek' he komon diosal. Nab'anhej slajwi eyok yet' stakji he ti' he b'eyeq'ui. Palta a ex tik tzeyala': Maay, ayoch ko pensar t'a juntzanh komon Dios, yuj chi' ol kalnhej ko b'a t'ay, xe chi.
Icha wal sq'uixwi junok elk'um ayik syamchajelta, icha wal chi' ol aj he q'uixwi a ex israel ex tik yet' heb' he reyal, heb' eyajal, heb' sakerdote yet' pax heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok.

Tzeyal t'a junok te te' icha tik: Mamin, xe chi t'a te'. Tzeyalanpax t'a junok k'een k'een: Nunin, xe chi. Axo pax t'ayin jun, a yich he patik tze meltzitejkoti. Maxtzak ex kot k'elan t'ayin. Axo wal yik tzeyilani to ay tas tzex ik'ani: Kotanh, kolwajanh, xe chi t'ayin.

Ex aj Judá, icha wal sb'isul he chonhab', icha chi' sb'isul he diosal. ¿B'ajtil ay juntzanh he komon diosal ix he b'o chi'? Kotokab' heb', ol kilani tato ol yal ex skolan heb' ayik ol jawok yaelal t'a eyib'anh.
Ha in wal Jehová in swala': ¿Tas in mul t'ayex yuj chi' tzeyalub'tanhej to max ex in kolo'? Ina he masanil tze pitej he b'a t'ayin.
Nab'anhej swak'och eyaelal, maxtzak yal pax he k'ol tze k'anab'ajej in k'ayb'ub'al. Lajan ex wal icha junok nok' choj te ow, tze milcham heb' in chekab' swak'b'at t'a he kal.

¿Tas animail eyaj a ex yinhtilal ex kan Israel? Maklejek eyab' tas swala'. ¿Tom malaj jab'ok tas swak' t'ayex? ¿Tom icha takinh lu'um waj t'ayex, mato icha junok lum lum te ay smay? Ex in chonhab', ¿tas wal yuj tzeyal t'ayin icha tik: Munil kik ko b'a, malaj tzach och kuuj? xe chi.
¿Tom ol sat sk'ol junok ix kob'es t'a stonh, ma t'a spichul ayik sb'at ix t'a nupnajel? Palta a exxo pax in chonhab' ex tik, junjun k'u tzin b'atnhej satk'olal eyuuj.
Lajan ex icha heb' ix ajmul ix yojtak b'e b'aj sb'ati, ayik sayanek' heb' winh winak heb' ix. Sat k'ayb'um eyaj t'a chukal.
Te chik'tak he pichul yuj schiq'uil heb' meb'a' yet' heb' malaj smul. Tze milcham heb', wach'chom malaj b'aj tz'och heb' elk'al t'ayex.

Wach'chom tze k'ulej icha chi', palta tzeyalan icha tik: Ha onh tik, te wach' onh, malaj ko mul, manhxalaj yowal sk'ol Jehová t'ayonh, xe chi. Palta a in Jehová in tik ol wak'kot yaelal t'a eyib'anh, yujto tzeyala' to malaj he mul.

¿Tas yuj tze pech he b'a yik tze k'exan heb' tze nib'ej skolwaj eyet'ok? Icha wal ajnak yel he q'uixwelal yuj heb' aj Asiria, yujto maj ex skol heb', icha pax chi' ol aj yel he q'uixwelal yuj heb' aj Egipto.
Toxonhej nhojan ex em yuj q'uixwelal ayik ol ex meltzajkot t'a Egipto chi', yujto toxo ix in patikejel heb' tzeyak'och yipok he k'ool chi'. Malaj tas ol eyak' yal yet' heb', xchi Jehová.

Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ex israel, tato ay junok ix ix spuk sb'a yet' winh yetb'eyum, syik'an junokxo winh ix, tato spukxi sb'a ix yet' winh schab'il chi', a winh yetb'eyum ix chi', maxtzak yal yik'lanxi sb'a winh yet' ix. Tato syik'lajxi sb'a heb' jun, a lum lum tik sjuwiel lum t'a yol in sat. Palta a in Jehová in tik swala' to lajan ix eyutej he b'a icha heb' ix ajmul ix tzijtum swinak, haxo tiknaik, tze nib'ej tzex meltzajxikot t'ayin.

Q'ueanhek k'elan t'a lum tzalkixtak manhxalaj ste'al, scham eyilan lum jolomtak tzalan chi'. ¿Tok ayto lum tzalan chi' b'aj maj he k'ulej ajmulal? Tzex em k'ojan t'a titak b'e tze maklan yek' heb' tzex mulan chi' yet'ok, icha tz'aj smaklan heb' árabe yek' heb' tzek' b'aj malaj anima. Yuj eyajmulal chi' ix eyixtejb'at lum lum tik.
Yuj wal he mul chi' maxtzak yak' nhab' t'a stiempoal. Icha heb' ix ajmul ix maxtzak q'uixwi jab'ok, icha wal chi' eyaji.
Ina ato eyalan tik t'ayin: Mamin, wach' ak'an ket'ok yiktax yune' chonhab' onhto.
¿Tom aynhejkot owal t'ayonh? ¿Tom aynhejkot owal chi' t'a junelnhej? xe chi. Yakb'an wan eyalan icha chi', wannhej pax he k'ulan jantak tas malaj swach'il stechaj he k'ulani, xchi Jehová.

Ha t'a yol stiempoal winhaj rey Josías, ix yal Jehová t'ayin icha tik: ¿Ix am wal il tas ix sk'ulej heb' etchonhab' israel? Icha wal heb' ix ajmul ix ix yutej sb'a heb'. Ix laj b'at heb' sk'ulej ajmulal t'a tzalkixtak yet' t'a yichtak te te' k'ayum xiil.

Ha in tik, a tzin naani to ayik toxo ix sk'ulej heb' icha chi', ol meltzajpaxkot heb' t'ayin, palta maj meltzajxikot heb'. Ha chonhab' Judá te pit, ix yil tas sk'ulej chonhab' Israel ayto yuj sb'a yet'ok.
Ix yilanpax heb' to ix in puk in b'a yet' heb' israel yuj yajmulal, palta a heb' aj Judá chi' maj xiw jab'ok heb', ix empax heb' ajmulal.
Yujto malaj yelk'och ajmulal t'a heb', yuj chi' ix yixtejb'at lum lum tik heb' yuj smul chi', yuj pax to ix och heb' ejmelal t'a komon Dios nab'a k'een, nab'a te'.
Wach'chom ix yil heb' tas ix aj heb' israel chi', manh yujok chi' ix meltzajxikot heb' t'ayin t'a smasanil sk'ool, palta tonhej ix stz'ak meltzajkot sb'a heb' t'ayin, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanpax Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ha heb' israel te pit heb', palta kennhej wal smul heb' t'a yichanh heb' aj Judá. Ha heb' aj Judá chi' maj yak' elk'och tas ix yal heb'.

Ach Jeremías, ixik k'elan t'a stojolal norte, tzalanb'at jun lolonel tik t'a heb' etisraelal ay t'a norte chi'. Ha wal Jehová tz'alan t'ayex icha tik: Ex israel te pit, meltzajanhekxikot t'ayin. Manh owalok ol wutej ex in chaani, manh masanilok tiempo aykot wowal t'ayex, yujto tz'ok' in k'ol t'ayex.

Anhej to tzeyojtakejel he chukal, to te pit ix eyutej he b'a t'ayin, a in Jehová he Diosal in tik. Ha in swala' to ix och he mul he k'ulan ajmulal yet' juntzanh komon Dios t'a yichtak te te' k'ayum xiil. Maj he k'anab'ajej jab'ok in cheknab'il, xchi Jehová t'ayex, xa chi, xchi t'ayin.

Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ex in chonhab' te pit, meltzajanhekxi t'ayin, yujto eyetb'eyum waji. Junjun ex ol ex wik'kot t'a junjun chonhab'. Chatakwanh ol aj ex wik'ankot t'a junjun makan inhtilal. Icha chi' ol aj ex wik'anxikankot t'a Sion.
Ol wak'och heb' eyilumal icha wal in gana, haxo heb' ol ak'an yajalil t'a eyib'anh t'a jelanil yet' t'a sjichanil.

Ha in wal Jehová in swala' to ayik toxo ix q'uib'xi he b'isul t'a he chonhab' tik, manhxa b'aj ol eyak' b'inaj te' skaxail in trato. Manhxa b'aj ol he nakot te', manhxo pax olto jawok te' t'a he pensar. Manhxo ol he b'o junokxo sk'exul te'.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', a Jerusalén ol alchaj yuj to in despacho yaj a in Jehová in tik. Masanil chonhab' ol smolb'ej sb'a t'a tik yik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'ayin. Manhxo ol yak' sb'a heb' skuchb'ajb'at yuj schuk pensaril.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', junxonhej ol aj chonhab' Judá yet' chonhab' Israel. Junxonhej ol aj he meltzajkot t'a jun nakión t'a stojolal norte, haxo he jawikan kajan t'a lum lum wak'nak smakb'enej heb' he mam eyicham.

Ex israel, ix in na' to tzex in chaoch wuninalok, swak'an jun lum te nib'ab'il tik t'ayex. Anhej wal jun lum tik te wach' yilji t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Ix in na' to ol in eyal he mamok t'a junelnhej, manhxo ol in eyaktejkan walani.
Palta a in wal Jehová in swala' to icha junok ix ix te chuk t'a winh yetb'eyum, icha chi' ix eyutej he b'a t'ayin.

Tz'ab'chaj yoch jaj t'a lum tzalkixtak manhxa ste'al, haton heb' israel tz'el yaw yoq'ui sk'anan kolwal heb'. Ix elkan heb' t'a sb'eal tojolal. Ix in b'at satk'olal yuj heb', a in Jehová sDiosal in heb' tik.

Ex anima te pit, kotanhekxi t'ayin, ol wik'anel jun pitalil ayoch t'a he pensar chi', xchi Jehová chi'. Ix tak'wi heb' israel chi' icha tik: Ina kajek' tik, skak'och ko b'a t'a yol a k'ab', yujto a ach tik Jehová ko Diosal ach.
Nab'anhej onh xit'ek' t'a tzalkixtak, onh awaj chaanh kak'an q'uinh t'a juntzanh komon Dios. Anhej wal t'ayach Jehová ko Diosal tz'ilchaj ko kolnab'il.

Yiktax yune' chonhab' onhto, onh och ejmelal t'a juntzanh yechel q'uixwub'tak chi', yuj chi' ix ak' satel tastak ix aj t'a heb' ko mam kicham, haton nok' kalnel yet' nok' wakax. Ix champax yuninal heb' yet' yisil heb'.

Kiq'ek em ko b'a yuj q'uixwelal, yujto a onh tik yet' heb' ko mam kicham, ix te och wal ko mul t'a Jehová ko Diosal. Yiktax yune' chonhab' onhto masanto tiknaik, max ko k'anab'ajej tas syal t'ayonh, xchi heb'.
Ha wal Jehová tz'alani: Ex israel, tato t'a wal yel tze nib'ej tzex meltzajxi t'ayin, aktejekkan juntzanh he diosal yajb'entak chi'.
Hak'ek he ti' t'a wichanh, tzeyak'an elk'och tas tzeyala'. Ichato chi' b'ian, ol in yik'anchaanh masanil nakión, ol wak'an in wach'k'olal t'a heb', xchi.

Syalanxi Jehová t'ayex, ex aj Judá yet' ex aj Jerusalén: Ix pitb'iel he pensar icha lum lum malaj mach smunlaj t'a sat, anhej te' q'uix sq'uib' t'ay. Komonok k'un tzeyutej jab'ok he pensar yik tz'och in lolonel t'ay.

Ex aj Judá yet' ex aj Jerusalén, k'anab'ajejek in trato ix in b'o eyet'ok. Ch'oxekel in trato t'a he b'eyb'al, haton in trato chab'il eyuuj. Ojtakejek eli to a in ton Jehová he Diosal in. Tato maay, a yuj he chuk b'eyb'al chi' skot yowal in k'ol t'a eyib'anh icha te' k'ak' manhxa mach syal smak'an tupok.

Alek juntzanh tik t'a heb' aj Judá yet' t'a heb' aj Jerusalén: Hak'ek ok' k'een trompeta t'a masanil chonhab', xe chi. Te chaanh tzex awaji tzeyalan icha tik: Ko molb'ejek ko b'a t'a yol juntzanh chonhab' wach' yaj smuroal, xe chi.
Ik'ekchaanh he bandera sch'oxani to sb'at he k'ub'ejel he b'a t'a Sion. Sayek ek' b'aj tze kol he b'a, manh ex och waan. Yujto ha t'a norte ol wik'kot jun niwan yaelal ol satanel smasanil.

Icha yelta nok' choj b'aj ay, icha chi' ol aj skot heb' ol ul satanel juntzanh chonhab' tik. Toxo ix elta heb' t'a yol schonhab' yik tzul satanel he chonhab' tik heb', ol smak'anem lanhnaj heb', manhxa mach ol kan t'ay.
Yuj chi' ak'ekoch pichul ya swa'i, ok'anhek, elokab' eyaw yuj yaelal, yujto a wal yowal in k'ol a in Jehová in tik manto el-laj t'a eyib'anh, xchi Jehová.

Ha wal Jehová tz'alanxi icha tik: Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', a winh rey yet' heb' yajal, ol el yip heb' yuj xiwelal. Ha heb' sakerdote yet' heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok, toxonhej ol satkan sk'ol heb', xchi.
Ix walan Jeremías in tik: Ay Mamin ¿tas yuj ix a k'exanh tiej heb' aj Jerusalén tik? Ix ak' a ti' ak'an junk'olal t'a heb', haxo tiknaik, a k'een kuchilub' ijanoch t'a sjaj heb' uuj, xin chi.

Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ol wal t'a heb' aj Jerusalén: Ay jun takinh ik' skot t'a lum tzalkixtak ay t'a takinh lu'um. Sjawi xumnaj t'a stojolal in chonhab', manh ichok ik' tz'ik'anel smatz'il ixim trigo.
Ha jun ik' swak'kot chi', te ow t'a yichanh junxo ik' chi'. Ha jun ik' sb'inaj tik, haton yaelal ol wak'kot t'a yib'anh in chonhab', xchi Jehová.

Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ilek wal skot heb' soldado ajk'ool, icha wal skot junok asun skot heb'. Ha wal skarruaje heb' lajan sb'ey icha chakxuxum ik'. Axo nok' schej heb' ek'b'al sb'ey nok' t'a yichanh nok' ch'akb'a. Yuj chi' ol eyal icha tik: Ob'iltak onh wal, ol onh satelok, xe chama.
Ex aj Jerusalén, ik'ekel masanil chukal ay t'a he pensar yik wach' ol ex kolchajok. ¿B'aq'uinhto wal ol eyaktej he naan chukal?
Ato t'a Dan yet' t'a lum tzalkixtak yik Efraín, ata' skot yab'ixal owal.
Alek t'a juntzanh ch'ok chonhab'il yet' t'a Jerusalén to ha t'a jun chonhab' te najat ay, ata' skot heb' ajk'ool. Tz'el yaw heb' skot yak' owal yet' juntzanh chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá.
Ol oymaj heb' t'a chonhab' Jerusalén, icha heb' stanhwan junok munlajel. Ha in wal Jehová in swala' to icha chi' ol ujok, yujto ix ste pitej sb'a heb' t'ayin.
Yuj he b'eyb'al yet' tas tze k'ulej sjawi juntzanh tik t'a eyib'anh. Ha yuj he chukal, te chuk tz'aj eyelk'ochi, syab' wal syail he pixan yuj, xchi Jehová.
Ay..., ste kus in k'ool, tz'och wal pitz'an t'a in pixan. Stinhtinhan in pixan yuj tas sjawi chi'. Maxtzak in em numan. Toxo ix wab' yok' k'een trompeta yet' yel yaw heb' soldado yik tz'och owal.
Tzoltzon sja ab'ix yik juntzanh yaelal sjawi. Masanil chonhab' tik toxo ix laj juwib'ati. Elanhchamel ix lajwiem ko kampamento, ix ixtaxb'at b'aj kajan onh.
¿Jantakto wal tiempo ol wil sbandera heb' soldado yet' wab'an spukhaj k'een trompeta? xin chi.

Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ha heb' in chonhab', te malaj spensar heb', max in yojtakejel heb'. Lajan heb' icha heb' unin malaj jab'ok spensar, manh jab'ok snachajel yuj heb'. Te jelan heb' t'a chukal. Manh yojtakok heb' sk'ulan wach'il, xchi.
Ha in Jeremías in tik, ix ch'oxji wil sat lu'um tik, tz'inanxonhej ix ajkani. Ix wilpaxk'e satcha'anh, manhxalaj sakil k'inal t'ay.
Ix laj wil lum niwak witz, ix ib'xik'e lu'um yet' pax lum tzalkixtak, ix laj tzikub'tanhaj lu'um.
Ix wilani manhxalaj anima, haxo masanil nok' sjenhwi toxo ix b'at nok' elelal.
Ix wilanpaxi, a lum lum b'aj ay awb'en, toxo ix kan tzinan lu'um. Masanil chonhab' toxo ix juwiemi. Yuj yowal sk'ol Jehová icha chi' ix aj masanil juntzanh chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Masanil lum lum ol juwokb'atok, palta manh ol in satel lum t'a junelnhej.

Kuseltak ol ajkan lum lum tik, haxo satcha'anh ol k'ik'b'okkanok. Icha chi' ol ajok yujto icha chi' ix aj in naani, ix walan paxi. Manh ol in k'exlaj tas ix in na' chi', manh ol ek'b'atlaj tas ix wal chi', xchi Jehová.

Ayik syab'an heb' anima yel yaw heb' soldado ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej yet' heb' yet'nak sjul-lab', sb'at heb' elelal, b'at sk'ub'ejel sb'a heb' t'a kaltak te', sq'ekan lotzlon heb' t'a sattak k'een tenam. Yuj chi' ix laj kan tzinan schonhab' heb'. Manhxalaj mach skajnajkan t'ay.

Ha Jerusalén wan slajwiemi, lajan icha junok ix ix nab'axonhej syak'och sk'apak púrpura, syak'anoch k'een oro ix wach' yilji, k'ik' syutej stitak sat ix yak'an uk'ok. Manhxa yelk'och b'aj sb'o sb'a ix chi', yujto a heb' winh winak nib'ab'il yuj ix, yajb'ilxoel ix yuj heb' winh. Toxonhej sna heb' winh tas ol aj smilan ix heb' winh. Icha chi' wan sk'ulan Jerusalén yet' juntzanhxo ch'ok nakional.

Ha heb' aj Sion tz'el yaw chi'. Swab' wal yel yaw heb' icha yel yaw junok ix ix b'ab'elto tz'alji yune'. Sk'akwi heb', syak'anel lian sk'ab' heb', syalan heb': Ay, ob'iltak onh. Ol onh miljokcham yuj heb' milum anima, xchi heb'.

Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ek'anh t'a skalleal Jerusalén tik, tzilan masanil anima, tzilan t'a merkado tato ay junok anima sb'eyb'alan tojolal, wach'nhej syutej sb'a. Wach'chom junok pitanh tz'ilchaj uuj, ol wak' niwank'olal Jerusalén tik.
Ay heb' stz'akan slok in b'i ayik syak'an sti' heb', palta t'a es slok in b'i chi' heb', xchi Jehová.

Mamin Jehová, a heb' tza nib'ej, haton heb' yelnhej syala'. Yuj chi' ix ak'och syaelal heb' a chonhab' tik, palta malaj yelk'och t'a heb'. Ix ak' lajwokem heb', palta maj nachajpaxel yuj heb'. Te pit spensar heb', icha stzatzil junok k'een k'een. Malaj snib'ej heb' syaktejkan schuk b'eyb'al.
Ix in na' icha tik: Tekan a heb' meb'a' malaj wal jab'ok spensar, a heb' icha chi' sk'ulani, yujto manh yojtakok heb' tas snib'ej Jehová Dios t'a heb' yet' tas syal t'a heb'.

Ol b'at in lolon yet' heb' anima niwak yelk'ochi, xin chi. Ha walani to yojtak heb' tas snib'ej Jehová Dios t'a heb' yet' tas syal t'a heb'. Palta masanil juntzanh heb' chi', ix spitejpax sb'a heb' t'a Dios. Maj yal sk'ol heb' ix sk'anab'ajej Jehová chi'.

Yuj wal chi' ol elta nok' choj t'a kaltak yax lu'um, ol miljokcham heb' yuj nok'. Ha nok' okes ay t'a tzinan lu'um ol tzilchitanb'at heb'. Axo nok' leopardo, ol laj k'och nok' t'a stitak schonhab' heb'. Tato tz'elta heb', chok' tz'ajkan heb' yuj nok', yujto te niwan smul heb' ix ochi, manhxo b'ischajb'enok spitalil heb'.

Yuj chi' syal Jehová icha tik: ¿Tasto wal ol aj ex wak'an niwank'olal? Ha heb' eyuninal, ix in yaktejkan heb', syak'an sti' heb' t'a sb'i juntzanh komon Dios to manh diosok. Jantak wael ix wak' t'a heb', palta maj in sk'anab'ajej heb', anhej ajmulal sk'ulej heb', molannhejek' heb' b'aj ay heb' ix ajmul ix.
Icha nok' mam chej nhepepi yuj b'ak'uech, toxonhej tz'el yaw jinhinhi yeq'ui, icha chi' heb', komonxonhej stzuntzejb'at heb' ix ix heb' ay t'a slak'anil, heb' ix ayxo yetb'eyum.
¿Tom manh ol wak'och syaelal heb' yuj juntzanh sb'eyb'al chi'? ¿Tom manh ol wak' spak t'a junok chonhab' t'a smojal icha tas sk'ulej?
Ochokab' heb' ajk'ol satanel te' uwa, palta manh masanilok te' ol lajwokelok. Sjekokab'el te' sk'ab' heb', yujto manhxo wikok te'.
Ha in wal Jehová in swala' to icha chi' ol ajok, yujto maj sk'anab'ajej heb' aj Israel yet' heb' aj Judá in trato ix in b'o yet'ok, xchi Jehová t'ayin.
Ha heb' aj Israel yet' heb' aj Judá, manh yelok tas syal heb' t'a spatik Jehová. Syalan heb' icha tik: Ha Dios malaj tas sna t'a kib'anh. Manh ol kab'laj syail yuj owal, ma yuj wejel.

Ha heb' schekab' Dios malaj yelk'och tas syal heb', manhok slolonel Dios syal heb', xchi heb'. Palta a wal Jehová Dios Yajal t'a Smasanil, ha' ix alan juntzanh tik t'ayin: Yujto syal heb' icha chi', yuj chi' a wal tik ol jawok t'a yib'anh heb'. Ha in lolonel ol elta t'a a ti', lajan wal ol wutej icha te' k'ak'. Axo heb' anima tik, lajan ol aj heb' icha te' k'atzitz. Axo jun k'ak' chi' ol satanel heb' smasanil, xchi Jehová.

Ha wal Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ex yinhtilal Israel, a jun chonhab' te najat ay, te tek'an, aytaxon t'a peka', ol wik'kot t'ayex, haton jun chonhab' to manh eyojtakok sti', manh ol eyab'laj tas ol yal heb'.
Masanil juntzanh anima chi', te jelan heb' yak'an owal, a syamk'ab' heb' yik owal yet'nak chamel.

Ol slajel sat eyawb'en heb' yet' he wael. Ol smilcham eyuninal heb' yet' eyisil. Ol schianb'at nok' he kalnel heb' yet' nok' he wakax, ol sloanpaxb'at sat te' uwa heb' yet' sat te' higo awab'il eyuuj. Ha heb' soldado heb' ol mak'anem lanhnaj he chonhab' wach' yajoch smuroal ayoch yipok he k'ool, xchi Jehová.
Ha wal Jehová ix alan t'ayin: Wach'chom tzijtum yaelal ol ja t'a jun pekti' chi', palta manh ol ex in satel-laj t'a junelnhej.

Tato ay mach ol k'anb'an t'ayach: ¿Tas yuj syak'kot juntzanh tik Jehová ko Diosal t'a kib'anh? tato xchi heb', tzal t'a heb' icha tik: Icha chi' ex yutej yujto ix he patikejkaneli, haxo juntzanh ch'ok diosal ix eyak' serwil t'a yol he makb'en tik. Yuj chi' yowalil ol eyak' serwil heb' ch'ok animail t'a junokxo makb'en manh eyikok, xa chi, xchi Jehová t'ayin.
Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Alek t'a heb' yinhtilalkan Jacob kajan t'a smakb'en Judá:
Ex anima malaj he pensar, ab'ek juntzanh tik: Ay yol he sat, palta max yal-laj eyilani. Ay he chikin, palta max eyab'laj.

Ha ex tik, malaj welk'och t'ayex. Ha in tik ix in b'okanem k'een arena t'a stitak ha' mar t'a junelnhej. Wach'chom sk'e waan ha' sk'anh yem ponhnaj ha', palta max ek'laj ha' t'a k'een arena aykanem chi' wuuj. Tato icha chi' in poder tzeyila', ¿tom manh smojok he xiw t'ayin?
Ha ex tik te pit ex, ix in he patikejkaneli.
Max he na jab'ok eyal icha tik: Ayokab' yelk'och Jehová ko Diosal t'ayonh, yujto a tz'ak'ankot nhab' t'a stiempoal, syak'anpax elul sat kawb'en t'a stiempoal, manh xe chiok.
Palta yuj he mul tz'och waan juntzanh tik, yuj chi' max yal eyak'an tzalajb'ok he k'ool yet' juntzanh in wach'k'olal tik, xchi Jehová, xa chi.
Ha t'a in chonhab' tik, ay wal heb' anima te chuk, say modo heb' tas tz'aj yixtan heb' anima heb', icha heb' tz'ak'anem syaalil nok' much.
Sb'ut' spat heb' yet' masanil tastak sutel heb' t'a heb' anima, icha tz'aj yak'jioch nok' much t'a yol ste', sb'ut'ji yuj nok', yuj chi' niwan tz'aj yelk'och heb' yuj sb'eyumal syelk'ej chi'.
Naynay yaj heb' yuj b'ak'uech. Manhxa yalnab'il schukal heb'. Max sb'olaj yaj heb' t'a stojolal tas tz'utaj heb' unin chamnak smam yet' heb' meb'a'.
¿Tom manh ol wak'kot yaelal t'a eyib'anh yuj juntzanh tik? Ha in wal Jehová in swala' to ol wak' spak t'ayex in chonhab' ex tik icha wal t'a smojal.
Xiwub'tak, satk'olaltak yuj tas tzuji t'a jun chonhab' tik.
Ha heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok, anhej es syal heb'. Axo heb' sakerdote syak' yajalil heb' icha snib'ej. Axo in chonhab' tik, wach' syab'i. Palta, ¿tas wal ol aj heb' ayik ol ja slajwub'?

Ex yinhtilal Benjamín, sayek b'aj tze kol he b'a. Elanhek t'a Jerusalén. Puek k'een trompeta t'a Tecoa, ak'ekk'e te' tab' ch'oxnab'ilal t'a Bet-haquerem, yujto t'a norte skot jun niwan yaelal, niwan tas ol lajwokel yuj.
Toxo wal ol in satel heb' anima ay t'a Sion, heb' te nib'ab'il.
Ha heb' rey yet' heb' soldado ol jawok heb' t'a jun chonhab' tik, ol sb'oan skampamento heb' t'a spatiktak. Ha b'aj ol kan junjun heb', ol satnhejel yuj heb'.
Ha heb' eyajk'ol chi', syal heb' icha tik: Kaq'ek lista ko b'a kak'an owal yet'ok. Kotanhek, kaq'ek owal yet' t'a chimk'ualil. Palta anhej to wan yem k'u, wanxo yoch wewen,
yuj chi' t'ak'walil ol onh ochek kak' owal yet'ok. Ol ko mak'anem lanhnaj yet'tal heb' soldado stanhwan chonhab', xchi heb'.

Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil tz'alan icha tik: Ch'akekel te te', tze b'oank'e he tek'nub' yik tzex och eyak' owal t'a Jerusalén. Ol wak'och yaelal t'a yib'anh jun chonhab'il anima chi', yujto axonhej ixtoj anima syak' heb'.
Ha t'a Jerusalén chi' spak'chaanh chukal, icha wal sk'eul sjaj junok ha ha'. Anhej ixtoj anima yet' chukal sb'inaj t'ay. Yuj chi' ol janhej yaelal t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' chi'.
B'oek he b'eyb'al ex aj Jerusalén, yik wach' max wik'el in pensar t'ayex. Tato maay, ol wak'kan tzinan he lu'um tik, manhxalaj mach ol kajnajkan t'ay, xchi Jehová.

Ix yalan Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil t'ayin icha tik: Ha heb' israel tik manhxa junok heb' ol kanok, icha tz'aj smolchaj sat te' uwa manhxa b'aj skan junok pitanh sat, icha chi' ol aj heb'. Yuj chi' yakb'an manto uji jun chi', kolkanel jantak heb' syal yelkani, icha wal tz'aj yek' heb' swach' molan te' sat uwa t'a sk'ab', xchi t'ayin.
Ix in tak'wi: ¿Mamin, mach ol ab'anok tato swal jun ab'ix tik? Icha wal to makan schikin heb', max yab'laj heb'. Tonhej sb'uchwaj heb', max schalaj sk'ol a lolonel heb'.

Mamin, skot pax yowal in k'ol et'ok t'a jun chonhab' tik. Maxtzak techaj wuj in yamanoch waan, xin chi. Ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Hak'uem yowal in k'ol chi' t'a yib'anh heb' unin tzek' t'a yoltak kalle yet' t'a yib'anh heb' winh kelemtak umaneq'ui. Ol yamchaj heb' winh winak yet' ix yetb'eyum yet' heb' te icham animaxo.
Masanil spat heb', smunlajel heb', heb' ix yetb'eyum heb', ch'okxo mach ol ik'ankanok. Yujto a in wal Jehová in swala', ol wik'k'e in k'ab' wak'an syaelal heb' kajan t'a jun chonhab' tik.

Masanil heb' niwak yelk'ochi yet' heb' malaj yelk'ochi, anhej tas syutej heb' yak'an ganar t'a spatik chukal sna'a. Anheja' heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok yet' heb' sakerdote, axonhej elk'al syak' heb'.
Snib'ej heb' sk'ub'ejel jantak yaelal syab' in chonhab', syalan heb' to ay junk'olal, palta manh yeloklaj.

Max q'uixwi jab'ok heb' sk'ulan juntzanh tas max techaj wilani. Malaj jab'ok sq'uixwelal heb', manh yojtakok heb' tas jun q'uixwelal chi'. Yuj chi' a in wal Jehová in swala', a wal yik ol wak'an syaelal heb', ol satkanel heb', xchi Jehová.

Ix yalan Jehová t'a heb' schonhab' icha tik: Ayik ex och tek'tek' b'aj skulusej sb'a b'e, ix walan t'ayex: Scham wal eyilan b'aj tzex b'ati. Tze k'anb'ej eyab'i tas b'eal yik'nak heb' he mam eyicham. Haton t'a b'e wach' chi' tzex b'ati, ata' ol eyik' eyip, xin chi t'ayex. Palta ix eyalani: Maay, malaj ko gana tzonh b'at ta', xe chi.

Icha spukhaj k'een trompeta yik syak'an ab'ix to wan sjawi owal t'a skal heb' anima, icha chi' ix wutej in chekanb'at heb' in chekab' ex skacha', ix in chekan yal heb' icha tik: Aktejekkan he chuk b'eyb'al tik, yik manh ol ja yaelal t'a eyib'anh, xin chi. Palta ix eyalan icha tik: Malaj ko gana skaktejkani, xe chi.
Yuj chi' swalan icha tik: Ab'ek ex ch'ok chonhab'il, ojtakejekel tas ol ujok t'a in chonhab' tik.

Ab'ek he masanil ex kajan ex t'a sat lu'um tik: Ol wik'kot junok yaelal te chuk t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' tik, yuj chukal sna heb' sk'ulej, yujto maj scha yab' in lolonel heb', ix spatikejel in k'ayb'ub'al heb'.

Ex in chonhab', ¿tasto yuj tzeyik'kot inkienso yik chonhab' Sabá t'ayin yet' te te' suk'uq'ui sjab' skot t'a juntzanh chonhab' najat? Maxtzak schalaj in k'ol juntzanh he silab' tze nhustz'aok, ma juntzanhxo he silab' tzeyak'a', xchi Jehová.

Yuj juntzanh tik ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ol wak'em junok tas b'aj ol slok sb'a eyok t'a yichanh heb' eyajk'ool. Eb' mamab'il, heb' uninab'il, heb' kajan t'a slak'anil heb' yet' heb' yamigo heb', lajannhej ol aj scham heb' smasanil, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Ato t'a snajatil lum lum ay t'a stojolal norte, ata' ay jun chonhab' te ay yip wan yak'an lista sb'a skoti.

Yet'nak sjul-lab' heb' yet' slanza. Te chuk heb', malaj yok'elk'olal heb'. Icha wal sk'anh sk'e waan ha' mar, icha wal chi' yel yaw heb' skoti, ayk'e heb' t'a yib'anh chej. Listaxo yaj heb' skot yak' owal eyet'ok a ex kajan ex t'a Jerusalén tik, xchi Jehová.
Ha heb' anima t'a Jerusalén tik, ol yal heb' icha tik: Toxo ix kab' jun ab'ix chi', ix el kip yuj xiwelal. Te ya skab'i, icha wal yab'an syail junok ix ix ayik tz'alji yune'.
Manhxo ex b'at munlajel, manhxo ex b'eyek' t'a yoltak b'e, yujto te ay xiwk'olal. Yalxonhej b'aj ayek' heb' ajk'ool yet' syamk'ab' yik owal, xcham heb' anima chi'.

Ix yalan Jehová t'a schonhab' icha tik: Ex in chonhab', ak'ekoch pichul ya swa'i yik tze ch'oxanel he kusk'olal. Ek'anhek b'alb'on t'a skal k'een tik'aq'uil taanh. Ochanhek wal t'a kusk'olal, ok'anhek wal sik'lab'il, icha wal yik scham junok k'otanh eyuninal, yujto a jun mach ol ex satanelok, wan sja tzak'najok, xchi.
Ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Tzach wak'ochi yik tzak'an prowal in chonhab' tik. Tza ch'olb'itej wal heb' sik'lab'il, tzilan wal tas yaj sb'eyb'al heb'.
Te pit heb' smasanil, alum pekal heb'. Ix pitb'iel spixan heb' icha stzatzil k'een bronke, ma k'een hierro.

Ayik slawaj te' k'ak' yet' junok lawlab', schakb'i te', tz'ulaxel k'een plomo t'a skal k'een plata. Palta haxo in chonhab' tik, wach'chom ix wak'lej in b'oan sb'eyb'al heb', palta malaj jab'ok yelk'ochi, yujto malaj jab'ok swach'il sb'eyb'al heb', max satel chukal t'a skal heb'.
Yuj chi' ol aljok yuj heb' to lajan heb' icha schukal k'een plata sjulchajeli, yujto a in Jehová in tik, ix in spatikejel heb', xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin a in Jeremías in tik:

Ochanh tek'tek' t'a spuertail in templo a in Jehová in tik, tzalan juntzanh lolonel tik t'a heb' anima: Masanil ex kajan ex t'a Judá, mach ex tzex och t'a jun puerta tik yik tzex och ejmelal t'a Jehová, scham wal eyab'an jun lolonel yik Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, haton ko Diosal: Tato ol he b'o he b'eyb'al yet' tas tze k'ulej, ol ex wak' kajnaj t'a sat lum tik.
Manh eyak'och he pensar t'a heb' tz'esani, heb' tz'alan icha tik: Kojtak wal to malaj tas ol onh ik'anok, yujto ayek' skajnub' Jehová t'a tik, haton wal stemplo tik, skomon chiej heb'.
Tato tze b'o he b'eyb'al yet' tas tze k'ulej, tato wach'nhej tzeyutej he b'a t'ayex junjun ex,

tato max eyixtej heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, heb' unin manhxa smam yet' heb' ix chamnakxo yetb'eyum ayek' t'a he kal, tato max he milcham heb' anima malaj smul, tato max ex och ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios, juntzanh tz'ik'an he juwieli,
tato icha chi' tze k'ulej, ol ex wak'kan kajan t'a jun lum tik, haton lum wak'nakkan t'a heb' he mam eyicham t'a junelnhej.
Palta a ex tik, tzeyak'och juntzanh esal lolonel malaj yelk'och t'a he k'ool.
Tzex elk'ani, tzex mak'wicham anima, tze k'ulej ajmulal, tze lok in b'i t'a es, tze nhusan inkienso t'a Baal, tzex och ejmelal t'a komon Dios to malaj eyalan eyik t'ay.
Slajwi chi' tzex ja pax t'a wichanh t'a in templo tik, tzeyalani: Malaj tas ol onh ik'anok, xe chi. Anhej yik tzex elb'ati tze b'eyb'alanxi juntzanh tas yajb'entak t'a yol in sat.
¿Tom tze na' to a in templo tik lajan yet' k'een nhak'een b'aj sk'ub'ej sb'a heb' elk'um? Ha in wal Jehová in swala' to swilnhej masanil juntzanh tze k'ulej tik.
Ixikek b'aj ek'nak chonhab' Silo b'aj ek'nak in kajnub', haton jun chi' in sik'nakel t'a sb'ab'elal b'aj in ch'oxnak in b'a. Ata' ol eyila' tas wutejnak in satanel yuj smul heb' he mam eyicham.
Ha in Jehová in swala' to ix he k'ulej juntzanh chukal tik, tzijtum el ix wal t'ayex to tzeyaktejkani, palta maj he k'anab'ajej. Ix ex wawtej, palta maj ex tak'woklaj t'ayin.
Yuj chi' icha wal wutejnak in kajnub' t'a Silo chi', icha chi' ol wutejkan in templo tik, haton jun wak'nak t'a heb' he mam eyicham yet' t'ayex tik, haton jun tzeyak'och yipok he k'ol tiknaik.
Ol ex wik'kanel t'a wichanh, icha wal ix aj wik'anel heb' eyetchonhab' t'a wichanh t'a yalanhtaxo, haton heb' yinhtilal Efraín, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ach Jeremías, manh ach lesalwok yuj jun chonhab' tik. Manh al t'ayin, manh ach tewok t'ayin yuj heb', yujto manh ol in tak'wok t'ayach.
¿Tom max il tastak sk'ulej heb' t'a juntzanh chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá yet' t'a yoltak kalle t'a Jerusalén?

Ha heb' yuninal heb' sayankot te' k'atzitz, haxo heb' mamab'il tz'ak'anoch te' k'ak', haxo heb' ix nunab'il sb'oan ixim k'oxox pan yik syak'an heb' silab'il t'a sdiosalil, jun skuchan ix yajalil satcha'anh. Stzuntzej wal kot yowal in k'ol heb' ayik syak'an wino heb' silab'il t'a komon Dios.
Ha in wal Jehová in swala' to manhok innhej tzin yixtej heb', palta munil syixtej pax sb'a heb' yak'an q'uixwelal sb'a.

Yuj chi', a in Jehová Yajal in swala' to ol wak'kot yowal in k'ol t'a yib'anh jun lugar tik: Haton t'a yib'anh heb' anima, t'a nok' nok' yet' te te' yet' t'a yib'anh masanil awb'en. Lajan wal wowal chi' icha junok te' k'ak' tz'eli, maxtzak yal-laj stupi, xchi Jehová.
Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, haton sDiosal Israel, a tz'alan t'a schonhab' icha tik: Hak'ek he gana eyak'an he silab', nok' snhusjitz'aok, tze chi'an schib'ejal juntzanhxo nok' silab' chi'.
Palta ayik wik'annakelta heb' he mam eyicham t'a Egipto, malaj tas walnak t'a heb' yuj nok' silab' snhusji yet' ofrenda.

Ha tas in b'ab'laj alejnak t'a heb' to tzin sk'anab'ajej heb'. Tato icha chi', a in ton tzin och sDiosalok heb', haxo heb' tz'ochkan in chonhab'ok. Walannak to sk'anab'ajej heb' icha wal tas ix wala', yik wach'nhej tz'elk'och heb'.

Palta maj schalaj yab' heb', maj sk'anab'ajej heb'. Ha tas sk'ulejnak heb' to yak'nak pitb'okel spensar heb', sk'anab'ajannak schukal spensar heb'. Oktom swach' b'oejnak sb'eyb'al heb', palta to swach' juejnakel sb'a heb'.
Yiktax yelnakkot heb' he mam eyicham t'a Egipto masanto tiknaik, tzin cheknhejb'at heb' in chekab' yala'.
Palta a ex tik, max he k'anab'ajej, max he cha eyab' tas swala'. Te pit tzeyutej he b'a. Yelxo wal te chuk tzeyutej he b'a t'a yichanh heb' he mam eyicham chi'.
Ha achxo tik ach Jeremías, al masanil juntzanh tik, wach'chom manh ol schalaj yab' heb' t'ayach. Alnhej, wach'chom manh ol tak'wok heb'.
Al t'a heb' icha tik: Ha ex wal tik junelnhej te pit ex, malaj he gana tzex kachji yuj Jehová ko Diosal. Manhxa mach yel syal t'a he kal, xa chi t'a heb'.
Ex aj Jerusalén, joxekel xil he jolom yuj kusk'olal, tzeyumaneli. Ixikek t'a lum tzalkixtak kuseltak yilji, tze b'itan b'it yik kusk'olal, yujto toxo ix ex waktejkan yuj yowal in k'ool, xchi Jehová.

Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ha heb' aj Judá, te chuk sk'ulej heb' t'a wichanh. Ha juntzanh skomon diosal heb' yajb'entak ix yak' wal och heb' t'a yol in templo. Icha chi' ix aj sjuwiel in templo chi' yuj heb'.
Ha t'a sch'olanil lum Ben-hinom, ata' ix sb'ok'e jun altar heb' yik Tofet b'aj snhustz'a yuninal heb' yet' yisil. Manhok in ix in chek sk'ulej heb', maj ek'paxlaj jab'ok t'a in pensar.

Yuj chi' a in wal Jehová in swala', ay jun pekti' to a jun ch'olan chi', manhxo ol skuch Tofet, ma sch'olanil lum Ben-hinom, palta ol skuchkan icha tik: Lum Sch'olanil yik heb' mak'b'ilchamok. Yujto manhxa b'aj syal smukji heb' chamnak, yuj chi' ha t'a lum Tofet chi' ol b'at juljokkan heb'.
Ha sniwanil heb' anima ayek' tiknaik t'a jun chonhab' tik, ol och schib'ejok nok' ostok yet' nok' chium nok' t'a kaltak te'. Manhxa mach ol xib'tan nok' t'a heb'.

Ol wak' satel heb' anima t'a juntzanh chonhab' yik Judá. Axo t'a yoltak skalleal Jerusalén, manhxa b'it yik q'uinh yet' yik tzalajk'olal. Manhxa pax b'it yik nupnajel ol ochok. Ichaxonhej tzinan lu'um ol ajkan jun chonhab' tik, xchi Jehová.

Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ol joychajk'eta sb'akil heb' ak'annak reyal t'a Judá b'aj mukan, sb'akil heb' ak'annak yajalil, sb'akil heb' sakerdote, sb'akil heb' yalnakoch sb'a in chekab'ok yet' sb'akil pax juntzanhxo heb' ek'nak kajan t'a Jerusalén.

Ol laj b'atkan lean sb'akil heb' chi' t'a yok k'u, t'a yok k'een uj yet' t'a yok k'een k'anal. Ayik pitzanto heb', xajan juntzanh chi' yuj heb', yak'nak serwil heb', yalnak sb'a heb' t'ay. Yuj chi' malaj mach ol molank'e sb'akil heb' chi' yik smukchaji. Ol kannhej ta' icha tz'ajkan stza' nok' nok'.

Ha in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, a in swala' to a jantak heb' anima pitzanto ol kan t'a skal juntzanh anima te chuk tik, ol snib'ej cham sb'a heb' t'a yichanh to pitzan b'aj ol in saklemkanb'at heb' t'a skal juntzanhxo chonhab'.

Ha Jehová ix alan t'ayin icha tik: Ach Jeremías icha tik tzutej alan t'a jun in chonhab' tik: Tato ay junok mach stelwi, tokwal maxtzak k'e waan. Tato ay junok mach satb'at t'a junok b'e, tokwal maxtzak sayxi sb'e chi'.

Palta a exxo tik ex israel, ¿tas yuj tzeyik'el he b'a t'ayin? Ex aj Jerusalén, ¿tas yuj maxtzak ex meltzajxi t'ayin? ¿Tas yuj ha t'a juntzanh komon Dios tzeyak'och he pensar, haxo t'ayin malaj he gana he meltzajxi?

Ix in maklej wal wab'i, palta malaj mach slolon t'a stojolal. Malaj wal junok mach sna sb'a t'a schukal syalani: ¿Tas wal ix in k'ulej? manh xchiok. Sb'atkan heb' smasanil t'a yol b'e, icha sb'at lemnaj nok' chej t'a owal.

Ha nok' kigüeña tzek' jenhenhok t'a satcha'anh, yojtak nok' b'ak'uinh ol meltzaj nok'. Yet' nok' kuwajte', nok' sanhkapech yet' nok' grulla, yojtak nok' b'ak'uinh ol b'at nok' t'a junokxo lugar. Ha exxo pax tik ex in chonhab', manh eyojtakok jab'ok in k'ayb'ub'al.
¿Tas yuj tzeyala' to ay he pensar, eyojtak in k'ayb'ub'al eyalani? Palta haxo heb' slaj tz'ib'anelta in k'ayb'ub'al, slaj sk'ex heb' tas syala'.
Ha juntzanh heb' jelan yalan chi', ol q'uixwokkanel heb', ol somchajk'e sk'ol heb', ol kotkan t'a yib'anh heb'. Ix spatikejel in lolonel heb', yuj chi' ¿b'ajtil ol yik' sjelanil heb'?

Yuj wal chi' ol wak'kanoch heb' ix yetb'eyum heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ch'ok winakil, haxo sluum heb' ch'ok mach ol ikankanok. Masanil heb' niwak yelk'ochi yet' heb' malaj yelk'ochi, axonhej yak'an ganar heb' t'a spatik chukal, a chi' sna heb'. Icha pax chi' heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok yet' heb' sakerdote, axonhej elk'al syak' heb'.
Snib'ej heb' sk'ub'ejel jantak yaelal syab' in chonhab'. Syalan heb' to ay junk'olal, palta manh yeloklaj.

Max q'uixwi heb' sk'ulan juntzanh tas max techaj wilani. Malaj jab'ok sq'uixwelal heb', manh yojtakok heb' tas jun q'uixwelal chi'. Yuj chi', a in wal Jehová in swala', a wal yik ol wak'an syaelal heb', ol satkanel heb', xchi Jehová, xa chi.

Syalanpax Jehová icha tik: Ol wik'el heb' in chonhab' t'a tik, yujto icha wal junok snunal te' uwa, ma junok ste'al te' higo malaj sat, tonhej sk'ajb'anel xiil ayik wan stakjieli, icha chi' yaj heb'. Yuj chi' a tas ix wak' t'a yol sk'ab' heb', ol wik'xiek' t'a heb', xchi.

Ol yal heb' aj Judá icha tik: ¿Tas yuj tzonh kan t'a tik? Ko molb'ejek ko b'a, konh b'atekkan t'a chonhab' wach' yajoch smuroal. Ata' ol ko kol ko b'a, wach'chom t'a skal owal ol onh chamok. Ha Jehová ko Diosal tzonh sataneli, yujto ix och ko mul t'ay, ichato ix yak' kuk' ha ha' ayb'at weneno t'a skal.
Ix ko na' to wach' ol onh elk'ochok, palta malaj tas wach' ix ak'ji t'ayonh. Ha ko naani to tzalajk'olal ol onh ajok, palta anhej xiwk'olal ix jawi t'ayonh.

Wan sjawi heb' ajk'ol t'ayonh. Sjornaj snhi' nok' schej heb' t'a Dan, skab'ul ato t'a tik. Ayik tz'ok' nok', tz'ib'xi wal lum lum tik. Sjawi heb' satel ko chonhab' tik yet' masanil tastak ay t'ay yet' masanil onh kajan onh t'a tik, xchi heb'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ol wak'kot chamel t'a he kal icha wal schiwaj nok' chan te ow schiwaji. Manhxalaj mach syal yak'an nanamax nok', xchi Jehová chi'.
Ha in kusk'olal tik manhxalaj yanhal, slajwi wal el in pixan yuj swab'i.

Tz'ab'chaj wal yel yaw heb' wetchonhab' t'a smasanil yol ko makb'en. Syalan heb', ¿tom manhxo ayokek' Jehová t'a Sion? ¿Tom manhxo ayokek' ko reyal sik'b'il och yuj Jehová ta'? xchi heb'. Ix tak'wi Jehová t'a heb' icha tik: ¿Tas yuj ix he tzuntzejkot yowal in k'ool ayik ix ex och ejmelal t'a komon Dios, juntzanh yechel malaj yelk'ochi, ch'ok b'aj kotnak? xchi.
Syalan heb' anima icha tik: Toxo ix ek'b'at stiempoal ko kolji, icha yek'b'at stiempoal jochoj trigo, ma icha yek'b'at stiempoal smolchaj sat awb'en, xchi heb'.
Swab' wal syail yuj syaelal heb' wetchonhab'. Toxo ix k'echaanh kusk'olal yet' xiwk'olal t'ayin.
Yakb'an ay yanhal t'a Galaad, ay pax heb' syal yanhtan ta', ¿tas yuj max anhtaj in chonhab' tik?
Komonok lajan in sat tik icha sjaj ha ha' tz'el yok, yik k'ual t'ak'wal tzin ok' yuj jantak heb' wetchonhab' ix chami.
Komonok ay junok b'aj syal waj t'a tzinan lu'um, yik wach' najat tzin b'atkan t'a in chonhab' tik. Yujto ix spatikejel Dios heb', ixtum anima heb'.

Te jelan yesan heb'. Sk'e wal chaanh heb' yet' es chi', icha wal junok mach sk'echaanh ste julanel sjul-lab'. Manhxa jab'ok tas yel tz'alji. Yuj chi' syal Jehová icha tik: Masnhej ste chukb'iel heb'. Maxtzak yal sk'ol heb' tzin yaloch sDiosalok.
Ach Jeremías, manhxo ak'och heb' amigo yet' heb' a k'ab' ok yipok a k'ool, yujto chuklaj tas wan snaan heb' t'a a patik. Ha tas sna masanil heb' amigo chi', syik'lajkot heb' t'a yib'anh junjun.
Syak'laj musansatil sb'a heb'. Manhxa mach slolon t'a yel. Toxo ix te k'ay heb' yesani. Maxtzak yal sk'exan spensar heb'.
Ha wal tas ay t'a skal heb', anhej ak'oj musansatil, ixtoj anima, yuj chi' maxtzak yal sk'ol heb' tzin yal sDiosalok.

Yuj chi' a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil swala': ¿Tasto wal junokxo syal in k'ulan yet' in chonhab' tik? Anhej to ol wak'och heb' t'a syaelal, icha tz'aj yak'jioch k'een plata t'a kal k'ak', yik tz'el schukal k'een.

Ha tas tz'elta t'a sti' heb' lajan icha jul-lab' jay ye scham anima yuj. Axonhej es tzek' yal heb'. Wach' sk'umlan sb'a heb' yet' heb' yamigo yalani, palta haxo t'a spensar heb' wan snaani tas ol yutej heb' yak'an chukal t'a heb' yamigo chi'.
Ha in wal Jehová in swala': ¿Tom manh smojok wak'anoch syaelal heb' yuj tas sk'ulej chi'? ¿Tom manh smojok wak'an spak t'a in chonhab' tik?

Ix walanxi a in Jeremías in tik: Tzin te ok' wal yuj lum tzalkixtak, tzin kus wal yuj lum takinhtak sat b'aj swa nok' nok', yujto toxo ix te takji sat lu'um. Manhxa mach tzek' ta'. Manhxa junok nok' wakax tz'ab'chaj yoq'ui. Ha nok' kaltakte'al nok' yet' nok' much toxo ix b'at nok' elelal.

Ix wab' yalan Jehová icha tik: Ha jun chonhab' Jerusalén tik, icha junok b'ulanh k'een b'aj kajan nok' niwak okes, icha chi' ol wutejkani. Ha juntzanh chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá, ol kan tzinan. Manhxa junok anima ol kajnajkan t'ay, xchi Jehová.
Ix walan t'a Jehová icha tik: Malaj junok onh snachajel kuuj tas yuj a jun ko chonhab' tik tzinan lu'um ix ajkani. Al t'ayonh tas yuj icha chi' ix ajkani, xin chi t'ay.
Ix tak'wi Jehová chi' t'ayin icha tik: Icha tik ix aji yujto ix spatikejel in k'ayb'ub'al heb'. Maj sk'anab'ajej heb', maj sb'eyb'alej heb'.
Ix yak'an wal pitb'okel spensar heb', ix yak'anem sb'a heb' t'a juntzanh komon Dios, icha ix aj sk'ayb'ajkan heb' yuj smam yicham.

Yuj chi' a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, sDiosal in Israel swala': Ol wak' yab' syail heb' t'a junjun k'u, ol k'e wal chi'an sat heb' yab'an syail icha sk'a'il junok tas k'a' swa heb', ma syuk' heb'.

Ol in saklemankanb'at heb' t'a juntzanh chonhab' manh yojtakok yet' pax heb' smam yicham heb' manh yojtakok heb'. Ol in chekb'at heb' soldado yak' owal yet' heb', masanto ol satel heb' smasanil, xchi Jehová.
Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil tz'alan icha tik: Ab'ek, b'at chekek ik'chajkot heb' ix ix aytaxonoch t'a yib'anh yoq'ui.
Yalokab' heb' aj Jerusalén: Kotokab' heb' ix t'a elanhchamel, kusokab' heb' ix kuuj. B'ut'jokab'el yol ko sat yuj yaal, elokab' b'ulnaj xil ko sat yuj jantak yal ko sat koq'ui, xchiokab' heb'.

Ha t'a chonhab' Sion, tz'ab'chaj wal yoch ok'el yuj kusk'olal. Syalan heb' icha tik: Te ob'iltak onh, wan ko sateli, skab' wal syail yuj q'uixwelal. Ha tiknaik, yowalil skaktejkan ko chonhab' tik, yujto toxo ix laj em lanhnaj ko pat, xchi heb' tz'ok' chi', xchi Jehová.
Ex ix, maklejek eyab' slolonel Jehová, aq'ek wal och he chikin t'a tas syala'. k'ayb'ejek heb' eyune' yet' heb' ix wach' eyak'an yet'ok yik tz'ok' heb' yuj skusk'olalil chamel.
Ha chamel toxo ix och t'a yoltak ko pat, toxo ix k'och t'a yoltak ko palakio. Slaj cham heb' unin t'a yoltak kalle, schampax heb' kelemtak t'a yoltak chonhab'.

Ix yal Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Al t'a heb' to a in swal icha tik: Toxonhej saktzipinak ol ajkan sniwanil heb' anima, icha tz'ajkan tzipan stza' nok' nok' t'a ak'liktak. Icha wal tz'ajkan ixim trigo manojail t'a spatik heb' sjochani tato malaj mach smolank'e waan ixim, icha chi' ol ajkan heb', xa chi, xchi Jehová t'ayin.

Ix yalanpax Jehová icha tik: Ha heb' jelan, mokab' yak'och sjelanil heb' chi' yipok sk'ool, heb' ay yip, mokab' yak'och yip heb' chi' yipok sk'ool, anhejtona' heb' b'eyum, mokab' yak'och sb'eyumal heb' chi' yipok sk'ool.

Ha in Jehová in swala', tato ay mach ay tas syak'och yipok sk'ool, a in okab' tzin yak'och yipok sk'ool, tzin yojtakaneli to a in Jehová in. Swak'elk'och swach'il in k'ool, tzin ch'olb'itan tas yaj anima t'a stojolal. Haton juntzanh tik snib'ej in k'ool sb'eyb'alej heb' anima, xchi Jehová.

Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Wan sja stiempoal wak'an syaelal heb' aj Egipto, heb' aj Judá, heb' aj Edom, heb' aj Amón, heb' aj Moab yet' heb' kajan t'a tzinan lu'um, haton heb' sjoxel xil spak'ul sti'. Masanil juntzanh anima chi' ak'b'il kirkunkidar heb', palta max sk'anab'ajej jun trato sch'oxan jun yechel chi' heb', anhejtona' pax heb' israel max sk'anab'ajej heb', xchi Jehová.
Ha in Jeremías in tik, ix wal icha tik: E masanil ex wetchonhab' israel, maklejek eyab' tas syal Jehová.
Ha tz'alan t'ayex icha tik: Manh he b'eyb'alej sb'eyb'al juntzanhxo nakión, manh ex xiw yuj juntzanh tas sch'ox sb'a t'a satcha'anh, icha syutej sb'a juntzanh ch'ok chonhab'il chi'.
Ha sb'eyb'al juntzanh nakión chi', malaj jab'ok yelk'ochi. Sb'at suykot junok te yib' te' heb' t'a kaltak te', haxo junok winh nhikum te' snhikan te' yet' syamk'ab'.
Slajwi chi' syak'anoch k'een plata yet' k'een oro winh yelwanub'ok. Smak'anb'at slawuxal te' winh yet' k'een martillo yik stzatzb'i te', yik max el k'otnaj te'.

Ha juntzanh yechel chi', lajan icha xib'tanub'al nok' much t'a skal junok awb'en. Max yal-laj sloloni. Yowalil skuchji b'eyek'ok, yujto max yal-laj sb'eyi. Manh ex xiw t'a juntzanh chi', yujto malaj chukal, ma wach'il syak' t'a heb' anima, xchi Jehová.
Mamin Jehová, malaj junokxo mach lajan et'ok, yujto te niwan elk'ochi, te b'inajnak ach, syal uj smasanil.

Ach sReyal masanil nakión, ¿tom ay junok mach manh smojok xiw t'ayach? Smoj wal te niwan elk'och t'a masanil anima. Ha t'a skal heb' jelan yet' t'a skal heb' rey t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, malaj junokxo mach lajan et'ok.
Masanil heb' anima chi' malaj spensar heb', malaj sjelanil heb', max yal sk'ayb'aj jab'ok heb' yuj juntzanh yechel b'ob'il t'a te te' chi'.

Ha juntzanh yechel komon Dios chi', b'ob'il yuj heb' tenum k'een, nab'a plata, haton k'een ik'b'ilkot t'a Tarsis yet' k'een oro ik'b'ilkot t'a Ufaz. Ha k'apak k'apak k'ik'mutz'inak yilji yet' k'apak chakchak k'apak ayoch spichulok. Masanil juntzanh chi', b'ob'il yuj heb' anima jelan spensar sb'oan tastak.

Axo Jehová, haton Dios pitzan, Dios t'a wal yel, Rey t'a junelnhej. Ayik skot yowal, tz'ib'xi wal lum lum tik yuj. Maxtzak yal-laj stek'b'an sb'a juntzanh niwak chonhab' t'a yichanh yowal sk'ol Jehová chi'.
Ex wetisraelal, alek t'a heb' ch'ok chonhab'il icha tik: Ha juntzanh komon Dios, manhok b'oannak satcha'anh yet' lum lum tik, ol satel t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, manhxa junok ol kanok, xe chi.
Ha Jehová b'oannak lum lum tik yet' spoder, a yet' sjelanil sb'onak yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Anheja' yet' sjelanil chi' sb'onak pax satcha'anh.

Ayik tz'awaj Jehová chi', tz'ib'xik'e ha ha' t'a satcha'anh, sk'e waan asun t'a chaanh yuj masanto b'aj slajwik'och lum lum tik. Tz'ek' kopoljok lheb'lon t'a skal niwak yaxnhab' yuj, sjakanelta ik' b'aj molan yuj.

Masanil heb' anima tz'ak'anoch komon Dios yipok sk'ool, malaj spensar heb', malaj tas yojtak heb'. Masanil heb' tenum k'een, tz'ak'ji q'uixwelal heb' yuj juntzanh yechel sb'o chi'. Ha juntzanh yechel sb'o heb' chi', malaj yelk'ochi, malaj spixan.
Ha juntzanh yechel chi', malaj jab'ok yopisio, smoj wal stzetzaji. Ayik ol jawok yaelal yuj Jehová, ol satelok.
Te ch'ok yel ko Diosal a onh yinhtilal onh winhaj Jacob tik. Ha b'oannak masanil tasi, ix onh sik'anpaxel a onh israel onh tik yik tzonh ochkan yikok. Ha sb'i, haton Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil.
Ex aj Jerusalén, oyb'ilxok'e ko chonhab' yuj heb' ajk'ool, molb'ejek masanil he k'ael.

Yujto syal Jehová icha tik: Ha tiknaik ol in molkot yaelal t'a he patik masanto ol yal eyamchaji. Masanil ex kajan ex t'a jun chonhab' tik, ol ex in pechb'at t'a najat, icha tz'aj sjuljib'at junok k'een k'een yet' ch'anh mejmeech, xchi.
Ix walan a in Jeremías in tik: Ob'iltak in, wan wab'an syail. Ha wechen tik malaj yanhal. Ha jun yaelal tik wik yaji yuj chi' ol wak' techajok.
Toxo ix em lanhnaj ko pat, icha mantiado st'inhchaj sch'anhal. Toxo ix cham heb' kuninal, ix onh yaktejkan heb', yuj chi' manhxa mach skolwaj ket'ok yik slich'ank'e jab'ok kenhul.
Ha heb' yilumal ko chonhab', malaj spensar heb'. Max sk'an sjelanil heb' t'a Jehová. Yuj chi' onh saklemb'at icha nok' kalnel.

Ab'ek wal sjawi jun ab'ix tik. Ay jun chonhab' skot t'a stojolal norte nhilili sk'anh skoti. Ha jun chi' ol ak'ankanoch juntzanh ko chonhab' tik tzinan lumal. Axonhej nok' niwak okes ol kajnajkan t'ay.
Mamin Jehová, wojtak sik'lab'il to a onh anima onh tik manh kojtakok tas ol aj kelk'ochi. Max nachaj kuj tastak sjawi t'a kichanh.
Ak' ko yaelal icha wal t'a stojolal, palta manhokab' yet' yowal a k'ool yik max onh a sateli.

Hak'uem yowal a k'ol t'a yib'anh juntzanh ch'ok chonhab'il, juntzanh chonhab' to manh ach ojtannakok, juntzanh chonhab' max yal sb'a t'ayach, yujto ix satel ko chonhab' heb' a onh yinhtilal onh winhaj Jacob tik. Junelnhej ix onh satel heb'. Ix laj yak'kan tzinan ko chonhab' tik heb', xin chi.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin Jeremías in tik icha tik:
Ab' wal tas syal in trato, tzalan t'a heb' aj Judá yet' pax t'a heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén.
Tzalan t'a heb' to a in Jehová sDiosal in heb', a in swala' to skatab'aj mach max k'anab'ajan tas syal in trato tik.

Haton in trato in b'onak yet' heb' he mam eyicham, ayik wik'annakelta heb' t'a Egipto. Ha jun nakión chi', lajan yaj t'a heb' icha junok horno b'aj stz'a k'een hierro. Walannak t'a heb': k'anab'ajejinek, b'oek masanil tas swala'. Tato icha chi' tze k'ulej, ol ex och in chonhab'ok, a inxo ol in och he Diosalok, xin chi t'a heb'.

Ha exxo pax tik, tato ol in he k'anab'ajej, ol wak'nhej elk'och in ti' wak'nak t'a heb' he mam eyicham, yik swak'an jun he lu'um, haton lum te yax sat b'aj ayex ek' tik, xchi Jehová, xa chi, xchi t'ayin. Yuj chi' ix in tak'wi t'ay icha tik: Ujokab' Mamin Jehová, xin chi.

Yuj chi' ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Al jun cheknab'il tik t'a juntzanh chonhab' ay t'a yol yik Judá yet' t'a yoltak skalleal Jerusalén. Tzalan t'a heb' anima icha tik: Maklejek eyab' jun trato tik, tze b'eyb'alan tas syala'.
Ayik wik'annakelta heb' he mam eyicham t'a Egipto, cham wal walnak t'a heb' to scha yab' heb' tas swala'. Atax t'a jun pekti' chi' masanto tiknaik ayinnhejoch walani.

Palta maj schalaj yab' heb', maj sk'anab'ajej heb', anhej to wach' pitb'inakel spensar heb'. Yak'annakb'at sb'a heb' t'a skal chukal. Maj yal sk'ol heb' sk'anab'ajej tas swala'. Yuj chi' wak'nakb'at yaelal t'a yib'anh heb', icha yajkan t'a in trato chi', xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ha heb' aj Judá yet' heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén, ix slajtiej sb'a heb' yik syik'anel sb'a heb' t'a yol in k'ab'.

Ix sk'ulejxi chukal heb' icha sb'eyb'alejnak heb' he mam eyicham. Haton heb' manh k'anab'ajannakok tas walnak, haxo t'a juntzanh komon Dios yak'nakoch spensar heb', yochnak heb' ejmelal t'ay. Ha pax tiknaik manhok chonhab' Israel, manhok pax chonhab' Judá sk'anab'ajan in trato in b'onak yet' heb' he mam eyicham chi'.
Yuj chi' a in wal Jehová in swala', ol wak'kot yaelal t'a yib'anh heb', manhxo ol yal skolan sb'a heb' t'ay. Olto awaj heb' t'ayin sk'anan in kolwal, palta manhxo ol in tak'wok t'a heb'.

Ichato chi' b'ian a heb' aj Judá yet' heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén tik, ol b'at snhus inkienso heb' yik sk'anan kolwal t'a juntzanh sdiosal chi'. Yujto a heb' aj Judá tik, tzijtum wal sdiosal heb', lajan sb'isul icha sb'isul schonhab' heb'. Anheja' pax heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén, te tzijtum altar ix sb'ok'e heb', icha wal skalleal chonhab', haton ta' snhus inkienso heb' t'a Baal, jun komon Dios yajb'entak. Palta manh ol yal-laj skolji heb' t'a syaelal chi' yuj juntzanh skomon diosal chi'.
Ach Jeremías, manh ach lesalwok yuj jun chonhab' tik. Manh al t'ayin, manh ach tewok t'ayin yuj heb', yujto manh ol in tak'wok, wach'chom ol sk'an in kolwal heb' t'a skal syaelal.

Ix yalan Jehová to swal t'a heb' wetchonhab' icha tik: Ex in chonhab' xajanab'il wuuj, malaj eyalan eyik he jawi t'a in kajnub', yujto manh jantakok tas yajb'entak tze k'ulej. Ha xepual yet' schib'ejal nok' he silab', manh ol yal ex skolanel t'a jun yaelal ol jawok t'a eyib'anh. Manhxo eyak'och q'uinh t'a in kajnub' tik.

Yujto ha t'a yalanhtaxo, lajan ex icha junok te' oliwo k'ayum xiil, te ay sat. Palta haxo tiknaik, ol ex in sateli, icha tz'aj slajwiem junok te te' sjekchaj sk'ab' yuj junok owal ik' nhab', stz'ab'at te' yuj sk'ak'al lheb'lon.

Ha in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, a in ix ex wak' pitzwok ex aj Israel yet' ex aj Judá, icha yawchaj junok te te'. Palta toxo ix wala' to ol ex in satel yuj jantak chukal tze k'ulej, icha junok te te' stok'jik'eta t'a yol lu'um. Ix he tzuntzejkot yowal in k'ool, yujto ix he nhus inkienso t'a Baal, xchi Jehová.
Mamin Jehová, ix ak' wojtakejeli to ay heb' ajk'ol t'ayin wan snaan in smilani. Ix a jak in pensar yik snachajel wuuj.

Junk'olal wajeq'ui, icha junok nok' kalnel tz'ik'jib'at b'aj smiljichamok, palta manh wojtakok tas wan snaan heb' t'a in patik. Syalan heb' icha tik: Ko mak'ekchamok, yik wach' manhxa mach ol naankotok, icha wal tz'aj xikjiel junok te te' syak' sat, xchi heb'.

Mamin Jehová, Yajal ach t'a Smasanil, Juez ach t'a stojolal. Ojtak tas ayek' t'a ko pensar. Ak' wil tas ol aj ak'an spak t'a juntzanh anima tik, yujto toxo ix wab'enejoch t'a yol a k'ab' tas sna heb' t'a in patik, xin chi.
Ha heb' aj Anatot, ix sna heb' tas tz'aj in chami. Ix yalan heb' to tzin smilcham heb' tato anheja' walanel slolonel Jehová.

Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil ix alan yuj heb' aj Anatot chi' icha tik: Ayik ol in b'oan yaj yet' heb', a heb' kelemtak ol cham heb' t'a skal owal, haxo yuninal heb' yet' yisil, ol cham heb' yuj wejel.
Manhxa junok heb' winak ol kanok, yujto ol ja sk'ual ol in ch'olb'itan tas sk'ulej heb'. Ol jawok yaelal t'a yib'anh heb', xchi Jehová.

Ix walan t'a Jehová icha tik: Mamin Jehová, wach'chom wojtak to te tojol a pensar, palta in gana tzin telaj in b'a et'ok. Tzin nib'ej tzin k'anb'ej juntzanh tik t'ayach: ¿Tas yuj wach'nhej yaj heb' chuk sb'eyb'al? ¿Tas yuj junk'olal yaj heb' anhej chukal sna'a?

Ha ach a b'onak heb', wach'nhej sq'uib' heb', icha junok te te' wach' sb'at sch'anhal yib', wach' sq'uib'i, syak'an sat, icha chi' yaj heb'. Anhej yet' sti' heb' syal wach' lolonel t'ayach, haxo spensar heb' najat yajeli.

Palta a ach tik Mamin Jehová, ojtak in. Tzila' jantak yajoch in pensar t'ayach. Ik'b'at juntzanh anima chi', icha tz'aj yik'jib'at nok' kalnel b'aj smiljichamok. Tza sik'kanel heb', yik wach' ol cham heb' t'a jun k'ual ayik ol miljokcham anima.

¿B'aq'uinh ol och waan stakji yib'anhq'uinal tik yet' stakjiel anh ank'ultak sk'ux nok' nok'? Anheja' nok' much wan scham nok' yuj schukal heb' anima kajan t'a jun chonhab' tik. Sna heb' to max il tastak sk'ulej heb', xin chi t'a Jehová.

Ix yalan Jehová t'ayin: Tato maj ach tzak'wan a b'ey yet' heb' sb'ey t'a yok, ¿tas wal ol aj a lajb'an a b'ey yet' heb' ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej? Tato manh junk'olalok ajek' b'aj sekan, ¿tas ol aj a naani tato tzach ek' t'a skaltak swayumtakil stitak ha' Jordán?

Ijan spax ip, palta manto ojtakok to a heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach, haton heb' ayto uj a b'a yet'ok. Tz'awaj heb' skot heb' t'a a patik icha heb' pechum nok'. Wach'chom wach'nhej syutej lolon sb'a heb' t'ayach, manh ak'och heb' yipok a k'ool, xchi t'ayin.
Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ol waktejkan in chonhab' tik, ol in patikejel jun chonhab' to wik yaji. Ol wak'och in chonhab' xajanab'il tik wuj t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'ool.
Ha heb' in chonhab' wiktaxon yaj tik, icha junok nok' choj t'a kaltak te' tz'el yaw skoti, icha chi' syutej sb'a heb' t'ayin, yuj chi' tzin yajkanel heb'.
Ha in chonhab' tik, lajan wal icha junok nok' ch'akb'a ch'ok yilji, stzok'jicham nok' yuj juntzanhxo nok' yetch'akb'ail. Kotokab' masanil juntzanhxo chonhab' ul satel in chonhab' tik.

Tzijtum heb' yilumal heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ol satanel in chonhab' tik, ichato wan satanel te' uwa heb' awab'il wuuj. Ol stek'em lat'an in munlajel heb'. Ha lum lum nib'ab'il wuuj, takinh lum ol ajkan lum yuj heb'.
Kuseltakxonhej ol ajkan in chonhab' tik yuj heb', ichato ol ok' lum t'ayin. Masanil in chonhab' tik, kuseltakxonhej ol ajkanok. Manhxa mach ol naan jab'ok yuj.

Masanil t'a tzalkixtak t'a tzinan lu'um, ol jawok heb' winh winak sateli, yujto a wespada a in Jehová in tik, a ol satanel masanil b'aj slajwik'och smakb'en in chonhab' tik. Manhxalaj junok mach junk'olal ol ajok.

Ix yawej ixim trigo heb', haxo te' q'uiix ix q'uib' sk'exulok. Nab'anhej ix munlaj heb'. Ix lajwiel yawb'en heb', q'uixwelalxo smolank'e jab'jab' sat yawb'en heb' chi', yuj wal yowal in k'ol t'a heb', xchi Jehová.

Icha tik swal a in Jehová in tik yuj juntzanh nakión te chuk t'a slak'anil Israel tik, to ix yik'ek' lum lum heb' ix wak' smakb'enej Israel in chonhab': Ol wik'el heb' t'a sluum junjun, haxo heb' aj Judá ol wik'el heb' t'a skal heb'.
Ayik toxo ix wik'el juntzanh ch'ok chonhab'il chi', ol ok'xok in k'ol t'a heb', ol wik'an meltzaj heb' t'a sluum yet' t'a schonhab' junjun.

Ha juntzanh chonhab' chi' ix k'ayb'an in chonhab' yak'an sti' t'a sb'i Baal. Axo ol ajok, tato ol sk'anab'ajej sk'ayb'ub'al in chonhab' tik heb', ol slokan in b'i heb' t'a tas syala', tato icha chi' ol yal yaj heb' t'a skal heb' in chonhab' tik.
Tato manh ol sk'anab'ajej heb' tas swal jun, a in wal Jehová in swala' to ol in satel heb' icha stok'jik'eta junok te te' yet' sch'anhal yib', xchi Jehová.
Ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ixik, b'at man junok tzek'ul nab'a lino, tzak'anoch t'a a nanhal ayik manto juk'chajok, xchi t'ayin.
Ix in manan jun tzek'ul chi' icha ix yal Jehová, ix wak'anoch t'a in nanhal.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin:
Ik'b'at jun a tzek'ul ix a man chi', jun ayoch t'a a nanhal chi', tzach b'at t'a Perat. Ata' tza k'ub'ejel t'a sjatelal junok k'een tenam, xchi Jehová.
Ix in b'at b'ian, ix in k'ub'anel jun tzek'ul chi', icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'ayin.
Ix ek' junok tiempoal, ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ixik t'a Perat, b'at ik'xikot jun tzek'ul in cheknak b'at a k'ub'ejel ta', xchi t'ayin.
Ix in b'at b'ian, ix in joyan b'aj aykan chi' wuuj, ix wik'ankoti, palta k'axo, manhxalaj yopisio.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin yik swaleli:
Icha tik ol aj in satanel yik'ojchanhb'ail Judá yet' Jerusalén.

Ha ex in chonhab' ex tik, te chuk ex, malaj he gana tze k'anab'ajej in cheknab'il, anhej tas tze nib'ej a tze k'ulej. Tzex och ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios, tzeyak'an serwil. Lajan ex icha jun tzek'ul manhxalaj yopisio tik.

Icha junok mach stzek'och junok tzek'ul t'a snanhal, icha chi' ix in k'ulej eyet' ex aj Israel yet' ex aj Judá, yik junnhej tzex aj wet'ok, in chonhab' eyaji, yik tzeyak'an ojtakajeli to b'inajnak in, niwan welk'ochi. Palta maj in he k'anab'ajej, xchi Jehová, xa chi, xchi t'ayin.

Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Al t'a heb' etchonhab' tik: Ha Jehová ko Diosal tz'alani: Junjun yet'tal wino, smoj sb'ut'ji yuj wino, xa chi. Ol yalan heb' t'ayach: Toxon kojtak to junjun yet'tal wino smoj sb'ut'ji yuj, xcham heb'.

Ol alan t'a heb' to a in swal icha tik: Ol wak' sat he k'ol he masanil ex kajan ex t'a jun chonhab' tik yuj yowal in k'ool, icha wal tz'aj sat sk'ol mach niwan wino syuk'ej. Ha heb' ol satel sk'ol chi', haton heb' rey yinhtilal winhaj David, heb' sakerdote, heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok yet' masanil ex kajan ex t'a Jerusalén tik.

Ol wak' he mak'lajcham he b'a icha tz'aj spojb'at lum yet'tal wino ayik stenlan sb'a lu'um. Lajan ol yutej sb'a heb' mamab'il yet' heb' uninab'il. Ha in wal Jehová in swala', ol ex in sateli, manhxo ol ok'laj in k'ol t'ayex, xchi Jehová, xa chi, xchi t'ayin.
Ex aj Judá, a Jehová wan slolon t'ayex. Emnakil tzeyutej he b'a, tze maklan eyab' tas syala'.

Alekk'eta he mul t'a Jehová ko Diosal, yakb'an manta tas skot t'a eyib'anh, icha sk'ulej heb' sb'eyek' t'a sat pak'an t'a skal k'ik' k'inal. Tze na' to ol ja wach'ilal t'ayex palta te niwan yaelal ol kot t'a eyib'anh yuj Jehová, ichato ol k'ik'b'ok k 'inal ol eyila'.
Tato max he cha eyab'i, elk'altak ol in ok' yuj eyik'ojchanhb'ail chi'. Ol elta yal in sat, yujto ol ex ik'chajkanb'at t'a najat, xin chi t'a heb'.

Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin: Al t'a winh a reyal yet' t'a ix snun winh: Emanhekkot t'a xilail he reyal, tzex em k'ojan t'a sat lu'um, yujto ol ik'chajel he korona manh jantakok swach'il yilji ayk'e t'a he jolom.
Ha juntzanh chonhab' t'a Neguev ol makchaj yuj heb' soldado, ol oymaj heb' t'a spatiktak, manhxa mach ol yal yochi. Masanil heb' aj Judá, ol ik'chajkanb'at heb' t'a najat.
Ixikek k'elan t'a stojolal norte, tzeyilan skot heb' ajk'ool. ¿Tas yaj in chonhab' wak'nakoch t'a yol he k'ab' he tanhwani, haton heb' ayoch he b'inajb'ilok?
¿Tas ol eyala' ayik ol wak'anoch juntzanh anima eyajalilok, haton heb' eyak'nakoch yipok he k'ool? Ol ja yaelal t'a eyib'anh icha sjawi yaelal t'a yib'anh junok ix ix wan yalji yune'.
Ex aj Jerusalén, tato tze k'anb'ej tas yuj sjawi juntzanh tik t'a eyib'anh, nachajokab' el eyuuj to yuj jantak he mul, yuj chi' b'eran ex eli tzex eq'ui, tzex te ixtajpaxi.
Ha junok k'ik'al anima, tokwal syal sk'exmaj yilji. Ha spintotakil nok' leopardo, tokwal syal sk'exmaji. Ichexta' te k'aynak ex t'a chukal, maxtzak yal sk'exmaj he b'eyb'al.
Yuj chi' ol ex in saklemejb'ati, icha tz'aj saklemkanb'at smatz'il ixim trigo yuj ik' skot t'a takinh lu'um.
Haton wal tik aykanoch t'a eyib'anh wuuj, icha wal smojal. Yujto ix in b'atkan satk'olal eyuuj, axonhej juntzanh komon Dios tzeyak'och yipok he k'ool.
Ol ex wak'el b'eran, ol ex wak'an q'uixwelal.

Ix wil jantak eyajmulal, haton juntzanh q'uixwelaltak tze k'ulej. Yajb'entak tas tze k'ulej t'a lum jolomtak witz yet' t'a yichtak te te' k'ayum xiil. Ex aj Jerusalén, ob'iltak ex, ¿b'aq'uinh ol eyaktejkan he k'ulan chukal chi'? xchi Jehová.
Yuj wal jun niwan tiempo manhxalaj nhab' syak'a', yuj chi' ix lolon Jehová t'ayin Jeremías in tik, ix yalan icha tik:
Ha heb' aj Judá tz'ok' wal heb' yuj kusk'olal, manhxa yip schonhab' heb', toxonhej teltumb'a heb' t'a sat lu'um yuj kusk'olal. Sk'e wal yaw heb' aj Jerusalén yuj syaelal.
Ha heb' b'eyum, schekb'at heb' schekab' heb' ik'oj ha'. Sb'at heb' say ha' t'a yoltak jul, palta manhxalaj ha', malaj yol sch'ub' heb' smeltzaj heb'. Toxonhej smak sat heb' yuj q'uixwelal.
Sk'e tamaljok lum lum sjat yuj stak'inhal. Yuj chi' a heb' munlajwum, stak wal sk'ol heb', smak sat heb' yuj q'uixwelal.
Icha chi' nok' k'ultakil chej, syaktejkan yune' nok' toto tz'alji, yujto manhxa anh ank'ultak sk'ux nok'.

Yet' nok' kaltakte'al b'uru, ha t'a tzalkixtak b'aj malaj ste'al skot tek'tek' nok'. Suk'lan ik' nok' icha nok' okes. Sk'unb'i wal yol sat nok' yilani, yujto manhxa anh ank'ultak wach' sk'uxan nok', xchi Jehová.
Mamin Jehová, wach'chom te niwan ko mul t'a a sat, palta kolwajanh t'ayonh yik wach' max ach alchaj chukal. Tzijtum el sko pitej ko b'a t'ayach, tz'ochpax ko mul.

Ha achnhej ayach och yipok ko k'ool, a achnhej pax ko Kolumal aji ayik ayonh och t'a syaelal. ¿Tas yuj icha ch'ok chonhab'il tzutej a b'a t'a ko chonhab' tik, icha junok paxyalwum junnhej ak'wal tzek' t'ayonh?
¿Tas yuj lajan ach icha junok soldado satk'olal yaji syamji, maxtzak yal skolwaji? Palta Mamin, tik pax ayachek' t'a ko kal. Masanil chonhab' ojtannak to a chonhab' onh. Manh onh aktejkani, xin chi.

Haton juntzanh tik ix yal Jehová yuj heb' chonhab' israel: Ha heb' anima t'a jun chonhab' tik, te ay stzalajk'olal heb' sb'eyeq'ui. Sb'at heb' t'a jun, sb'at heb' t'a junxo. Yuj chi' manh jab'ok tzin tzalaj yet' heb'. Ha tiknaik ol in nakot schukal heb', ol in ch'olb'itan tastak sk'ulej heb', xchi.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Manh ach tewok t'ayin yuj swach'ilok juntzanh anima t'a jun chonhab' tik.

Wach'chom tz'och heb' t'a tzek'ojk'olal, palta manh ol in tak'woklaj t'a heb'. Wach'chom tzijtum silab' snhus heb' yet' jantak sat awb'en syik'kot heb' ofrendail, palta manh ol in tzalaj yet' heb'. Ol in satel heb' yuj owal, yuj wejel yet' pax yuj ilya, xchi t'ayin.

Ix in tak'wi t'a Jehová chi' icha tik: Palta Mamin Jehová in Diosal, a heb' syaloch sb'a a chekab'ok, syal heb' t'a heb' anima tik to malaj owal ol ochok. Malaj wejel ol jawok. Syal heb' to ol ak'nhej junk'olal b'aj kajan onh tik, xin chi.

Ix tak'wi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Tato icha chi' tz'aj yalanel heb' chekab' chi' t'a in b'i, wan yesan heb' syal chi', yujto manhok in tzin chek yal heb'. Malaj junok cheknab'il ix wak' t'a heb', maj in lolonpax t'a heb'. Ha juntzanh syal heb' chi' to a in ix wak' yil heb' yalani, palta manh yeloklaj, malaj yelk'ochi. Munil t'a yol yik heb' snachaanh juntzanh syal chi'.

Ha in Jehová in swal t'a juntzanh chekab' stek'b'ej sb'a yalanel t'a in b'i to malaj owal, malaj wejel ol jawok t'a yib'anh chonhab' tik, manhok in tzin chek yal heb', yuj chi' ol cham heb' yuj owal yet' yuj wejel chi'.

Yet' pax heb' anima b'aj syal heb' chi', ol cham heb' yuj owal yet' wejel. Ol cham heb' ix yetb'eyum heb' yet' yalyuninal. Toxonhej ol kan teljab' sniwanil heb' t'a yoltak skalleal chonhab' Jerusalén. Malaj mach ol mukan heb'. Icha chi' ol aj stupanel smul heb' ix yak'ochi.
Yuj chi' al juntzanh tik t'a heb' anima: k'ual dak'walxo yel yal in sat wok' yuj yaelal ayxo smay ix jawi t'a yib'anh heb' wetchonhab', yuj yaelal tz'ak'an echnaj heb'.

Ayik tzin ek' t'a kal munlajel swilani, ay sniwanil anima teltumb'a yajkan yuj owal. Axo yik tzin ochxita t'a yol chonhab' tik, swilani to wan scham anima yuj wejel. Axo heb' syaloch sb'a schekab'ok Dios yet' heb' sakerdote, toxo ix ik'chajb'at heb' t'a ch'ok chonhab'il manh yojtakok, xa chi, xchi Jehová t'ayin.

Yuj chi' ix walan icha tik: Mamin Jehová, ¿tom junelnhej ix ik'el heb' aj Judá tik t'a a k'ool? ¿Tom toxo ix a patikejel chonhab' Sion? ¿Tas yuj ix onh ak' echnajok to maxtzak yal kanhtaji? Sko nib'ej junk'olal kaji, palta malaj jab'ok tas wach' sjawi t'ayonh. Sko na' to wach'nhej ol onh b'ey t'a kichanh, palta anhej tas ay smay ix ja t'a kib'anh.
Mamin Jehová, skojtakejel ko chukal yet' pax spitalil heb' ko mam kicham. Ix och wal ko mul t'ayach.
Yuj wal yik'jichaanh a b'i, manhxo onh a patikejeli. Manh a patikejel jun chonhab' tik b'aj ay a despacho to niwan yelk'ochi. Nakot a trato ix ak' ket'ok. ¿Tokwal manh ol ak'elk'ochi?

Malaj junok komon Dios, sdiosal ch'ok chonhab'il ol yal yak'ankot nhab'. Ha satcha'anh max yal-laj yak'ankot yaxnhab' t'a yol yiko'. Mamin Jehová, ko Diosal ach, yuj chi' tzach kak'och yipok ko k'ool, yujto a achnhej tzak'kot juntzanh tik, xin chi t'a Jehová.
Ix tak'wi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Wach'chom a winhaj Moisés, ma winhaj Samuel tzul tewok t'ayin yuj heb', manhxo ol ok' in k'ol t'a in chonhab' tik. Al t'a heb' to tz'el heb' t'a wichanh, sb'at heb'.

Tato ay heb' sk'anb'an t'ayach, b'ajtil tzonh b'ati, tato xchi heb', al juntzanh swal tik t'a heb': Ha mach ayoch t'a yib'anh scham yuj ilya, ha' ilya chi' ol milanok. Ha mach ayoch t'a yib'anh scham t'a owal, ha t'a owal chi' ol chamok. Ha mach ayoch t'a yib'anh scham yuj wejel, a wejel chi' ol milanok. Ha pax mach ayoch t'a yib'anh yik'jib'at t'a ch'ok chonhab'il, ol ik'joknhejb'atok, xa chi.

Ha in Jehová in swala': Ol wak'kot chanh makan yaelal t'a yib'anh heb' anima tik: Ol cham heb' t'a skal owal, ol nherjok b'eyek' sniwanil heb' yuj nok' tz'i', ol chijokb'at heb' yuj nok' ostok, haxo nok' kaltakte'al nok' ol wach' lajanel heb'.

Ol jawok jun yaelal chi' yuj wal juntzanh chukal ix sk'ulej winhaj Manasés yuninal winhaj Ezequías t'a Jerusalén, ayik ayoch winh reyal t'a Judá. Masanil chonhab' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ol te xiw heb' yilanoch juntzanh yaelal ol jawok t'a yib'anh in chonhab' tik.
Ex aj Jerusalén, ¿machto wal ol ok' sk'ol t'ayex? ¿Machto wal ol kus sk'ol eyuuj? ¿Machto wal ol och ilk'olal eyuuj?
Ha in Jehová in swala', a ex tik ix in he patikejeli, ex te juwieli. Toxo ix in te tzaktzaj ex wak'an niwank'olal, yuj chi' toxo ix wik'chanh in k'ab' wak'an eyaelal yik tzex in sataneli.

Ol ex wik'elta t'a yoltak he chonhab' t'a yol he makb'en tik, ol ex in saklemejb'at icha tz'aj saklem smatz'il ixim trigo yuj ik'. Ol wak'an satjokel in chonhab' tik. Manhxa junok eyuninal ol wak'kani, yujto max yal he k'ol tzeyaktejkan he chuk b'eyb'al.

Wuujnhej tzijtum ol ajkan heb' ix ix ol cham yetb'eyum, icha wal yarenail sti' ha' mar maxtzak b'ischaji. T'a chimk'ualil ol jawok jun yaelal t'a yib'anh heb' ix nunab'il ayb'at yune' t'a owal, aynhej heb' nank'olal ol jawok kusk'olal yet' xiwk'olal t'a yib'anh heb'.

Ha heb' ix nunab'il manh jantakok yune', tz'el yip heb' ix yuj q'uixwelal, maxtzak yal yik'an yik' heb' ix, emnakilxonhej tz'ajkan heb' ix. Ha k'ualil smeltzajkanoch t'ak'walil t'a heb' ix. Tato ayto heb' ol kan t'a yol schonhab' chi', a in Jehová in swala' to ol wak' miljokcham heb' yuj heb' ajk'ool, xchi Jehová.

Nunin, ob'iltak in. ¿Tas wal yuj ix in ak' aljok? Anhej wal owal yet' telajb'ail swak' yet' masanil anima. Malaj junok mach b'aj ix wak' tumin majanil, malaj pax mach b'aj ix in majnej k'een, palta masanil heb' tzin katab'ani.

Mamin Jehová, elokab'k'och b'aj tzin skatab'ej heb' chi' tato chuk ix wutej ach wak'an serwil, tato maj in k'an a wach'k'olal t'a yib'anh heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, ayik ayoch heb' t'a kusk'olal yet' t'a syaelal.
Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Ex aj Judá, ¿tok ay mach syal smak'an kanhchaj k'een bronke yet' k'een hierro? Icha chi' yaj heb' ajk'ol ol kot t'a stojolal norte, manh ol techaj eyak'an owal yet' heb'.
Yuj wal jantak he chukal ex aj Israel, yuj chi' a wal he b'eyumal yet' masanil tas ay t'a sat he lum tik, ol wak' t'a heb' eyajk'ool chi'. Nab'anhej ol yik'b'at heb', manh ol stupkanlaj heb' t'ayex.
Ol ex wak'kanoch schekab'ok heb' eyajk'ol chi' t'a jun lum lum manh eyojtakok, yujto a yowal in k'ool lajan icha te' k'ak', ol ex satel yuj, xchi Jehová.
Mamin Jehová, ojtak smasanil, na in koti, kolin. Paktzitej t'a heb' wajk'ool. Mokab' ak' niwank'olal heb', paktzitej t'a heb' yakb'an manto in smilcham heb'. Ilnab' wal, uuj tzin sb'uch heb'.
Ayik tzalan a lolonel t'ayin tzin chanhej wab'i, anhej ayoch in tzalajk'olalok, yujto ik in Mamin Jehová in Diosal, Yajal ach t'a Smasanil.
Manh junnhejok tzin ek' yet' heb' stzalaj sk'ulan chukal. Yuj wopisio ak'nak, in ch'okoj tzin eq'ui, yujto swab' syail yowal a k'ol et'ok.
¿Tas wal yuj malaj b'ak'uinh tz'och waan in yaelal icha junok echen malaj yanhal? ¿Tom ol in ixtej icha ha' eluma' stupemi?

Yuj chi' ix tak'wi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Tato tzach meltzajkot t'ayin, ol ach in chaxi, icha chi' b'ian ol yal in ak'an serwil. Tato max a komon alej komon lolonel, anhej tas niwan yelk'och tzala', a ach ol ach lolon wuuj. Ha heb' anima ol meltzajkot heb' ul yab'an a loloni, manhok ach ol a cha ab' slolonel heb'.

Lajan wal ol ach wutejkan t'a heb' etchonhab' tik icha junok muro nab'a bronke. Ol yak' owal heb' et'ok, palta a in wal Jehová in swala' to manh ol ach yak' ganar heb', yujto ayin och et'ok, ol ach in kolo'.
Ol ach in kolel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' chuk, ol ach in kolnhej t'a heb' milumcham anima, xchi t'ayin.
Ix lolon Jehová t'ayin, ix yalan icha tik:
Manh ak'och etb'eyum, manh ol aj uninal t'a jun chonhab' tik.
Ha in Jehová in tik ol wal t'ayach tas ol jawok t'a yib'anh heb' unin ol aljok t'a jun chonhab' tik yet' t'a yib'anh heb' mamab'il nunab'il.

Ol cham heb' yuj juntzanh ilya te ow, malaj mach ol ok' yuj heb', malaj mach ol mukan heb'. Toxonhej ol kan teljab' heb' t'a sat lu'um, icha tz'aj nok' nok'. Ha owal yet' wejel ol ik'an scham heb'. Axo sniwanil heb' chi', ol laj chijokb'at yuj nok' ostok yet' nok' chium nok' t'a kaltak te', xchi Jehová t'ayin.

Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Manh ach och t'a yol junok pat b'aj ayek' heb' anima iloj ak'wal yuj chamnak. Manh ach ok' yet' heb', manh ak' sniwanil sk'ol heb', yujto a in Jehová in swala' to ix wik'el junk'olal t'a heb', maxtzak in xajanej heb', maxtzak ok' in k'ol t'a jun chonhab' tik.
Ol cham heb' icham anima yet' heb' unin. Manhxalaj mach ol mukan heb', malaj mach ol ok' yuj heb'. Malaj mach ol yak' echnaj sniwanil, ma sjoxanel xil sjolom yuj sch'oxanel skusk'olal yuj heb'.
Manhxalaj mach ol b'oan wael yuj chamel chi', yik tz'ak'ji sniwanil sk'ol heb' ayto yuj sb'a yet' jun ix cham chi', wach'chom a heb' mamab'il nunab'il schami.
Anhejtona' manh ach och k'ojan t'a yol junok pat a wa'i yet' uk'an ha' b'aj ay junok q'uinh.

Yujto a in Jehová in Yajal in t'a Smasanil, he Diosal in, a in swal icha tik: Ol wak' lajwok q'uinh yik tzalajk'olal, icha q'uinh yik nupnajel t'a jun chonhab' tik. Ha t'a yol he tiempoal tik ol ujok jun tik, ol eyil wal.

Ayik ol alan jun lolonel tik t'a heb' etchonhab' tik, ol sk'anb'ej heb' t'ayach: ¿Tas yuj ol yak'kot jun niwan yaelal chi' Jehová t'a kib'anh? ¿Tas chukal ix ko k'ulej? ¿Tas ko mul ix och t'a Jehová ko Diosal? xcham heb'.

Tza pakan t'a heb' icha tik: Ha wal Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ha heb' he mam eyicham ix in yaktejkan heb', ix b'at tzak'an heb' t'a spatik komon Dios, ix och heb' ejmelal t'ay. Ix in spatikanel heb', maj sk'anab'ajej sk'ayb'ub'al heb' ix wak'a'.
Ha exxo pax tik, ek'al te chuk tze k'ulej t'a yichanh heb' he mam eyicham chi'. Junjun ex tze k'ulej chukal skot t'a he pensar, maxtzak he k'anab'ajej tas swala'.

Yuj chi' ol ex wik'el t'a jun lum tik, ol ex wak'ankanb'at t'a junokxo chonhab' manh eyojtakok, manh yojtakok pax heb' he mam eyicham. Ata' k'ual t'ak'wal ol eyak' serwil juntzanh komon Dios. Manhxo ol ok' in k'ol t'ayex, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb'.
Palta a in Jehová in swak' in ti': Ha tiknaik, ayik slokan in b'i heb' anima tik, syalan heb' icha tik: T'a sb'i Jehová Dios ik'annakelta heb' ko mam kicham t'a Egipto, xchi heb'.

Palta ol jawok jun pekti', ol yalan heb' anima icha tik: T'a sb'i Jehová, haton ix ik'anelta heb' israel t'a juntzanh chonhab' t'a norte yet' t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' b'aj ix saklemkanb'at heb', xcham heb'. Yujto a in ol wik' meltzaj heb' etisraelal t'a schonhab', haton lum lum wak'nakkan t'a heb' he mam eyicham.

Palta ayik manto ol ujok jun chi', ol wik'kot heb' yajk'ol heb' israel yik tzul yamji heb' yuj heb', icha tz'aj syaman nok' chay heb' yamum chay yet' schimpa, ma icha heb' pechum nok' sb'at tzak'an t'a spatik nok' nok' t'a tzalkixtak, tzek' sayan nok' heb' t'a yoltak k'een nhak'een yet' t'a yoltak sjatelal k'een.
Yujto swil masanil tastak sk'ulej heb'. Malaj junok mach syal sk'ub'anel sb'a t'a yol in sat, ma sk'ub'anel schukal t'a wichanh.

Ol wak' spak t'a heb' yuj chukal sk'ulej chi', yujto ix yixtejb'at in lum heb' yuj juntzanh sdiosal to manh pitzanok, yajb'entak icha sniwanil junok chamnak. Ix sk'ulej heb' tas to max scha in k'ool, xchi Jehová.

Mamin Jehová, wilumal ach, in tanhwumal aji. Ha ach wal tzin a kolo' ayik ay in och t'a syaelal. Ol kot juntzanh chonhab' b'aj slajwik'och lum lum tik, ol ul yalan heb' t'ayach: Ha heb' ko mam kicham, anhej t'a juntzanh komon Dios malaj wach' yochi, malaj yopisio, anhej ta' yak'nakem sb'a heb'.
¿Tom syal sb'oan sdiosal heb' anima? Tato a heb' sb'oani, manh diosok syal chi', xcham heb', xin chi.
Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Yuj chi' t'a junelnhej ol wak' yojtakejel in poder heb'. Icha wal chi' ol aj yojtakanel heb' to a in Jehová in a innhej Dios in, xchi.

Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Ex aj Judá, maxtzak el he chukal t'a he pensar. Max satlaj he chukal chi' t'a schikintak eyaltar. Skan yechel icha letra tz'ochkan t'a junok k'een k'een yuj k'een kinkel ma yuj k'een diamante.
Ha heb' eyuninal snakot juntzanh altar heb', snaanpaxkot juntzanh te te' yechel komon Dios heb', te' ay t'a yichtak te te' k'ayum xiil t'a juntzanh tzalkixtak chaanh yajk'ei,
yet' t'a jolomtak witz t'a stitakel chonhab'. Yuj he chukal tzeyak'och t'a juntzanh lugar yik ejmelal b'aj chaanh t'a masanil he makb'en tik, ol wak' elk'ajb'at he b'eyumal yet' tastak ay t'ayex.
