Yowalil ol ex ik'jokel t'a sat lum he lum tik, haton lum ix wak' he makb'enej. Ol ex wak'kanoch schekab'ok heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayex t'a jun lu'um manh eyojtakok, yujto toxo ix kot yowal in k'ol t'ayex. Ha yowal in k'ol chi', lajan icha junok k'ak' malaj b'ak'uinh stupi, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ob'iltak heb' tzin ik'anel t'a sk'ool, haxo anima syak'och heb' yipok sk'ol yik skolwaj yet' heb' snaani.
Lajan wal heb' icha te' q'uiix t'a tzinan lu'um, malaj b'ak'uinh syil wach'il. Sq'uib'k'e te' t'a kaltak k'een yet' t'a lum lum ay atz'am atz'am t'ay yet' b'aj max yal skajnaj anima.
Palta te wach' yik heb' anima tzin ak'anoch yipok sk'ool.

Lajan wal heb' icha te te' awab'il t'a stitak ha ha', sb'at wal sch'anhal yib' b'aj sb'ey ha ha' chi'. Malaj sna te' wach'chom te ay k'ak', k'ayumnhej xil te'. T'a stiempoal malaj nhab', malaj jab'ok tz'ik'an te', malaj b'ak'uinh syaktej yak'an sat te'. Icha chi' yaj heb'.
¿Tok ay junok tas yelxo wal ak'um musansatil, icha spensar heb' anima? Malaj sb'onab'il jun spensar heb' chi'. ¿Mach wal syal yojtakaneli?
Ha in wal Jehová in tzin ch'olb'itej tastak ay t'a junjun pensar. Wojtak wal tastak tzek' t'a spixan junjun anima. Ha in swak' spak t'a junjun t'a smojal icha sk'ulej, xchi Jehová.

Ha heb' tz'och b'eyumal yuj ixtoj anima, lajan wal heb' icha junok nok' much smanhelta nholob' manh yikok. Ayik te tek'anto heb' ol ek'xok sb'eyumal heb' chi', haxo ol aj scheklaji to malaj spensar heb'.
Ha skajnub' Dios b'ob'ilkan yiktax yichb'anel, lajan wal icha junok palakio te wach' yilji, chaanh b'ob'ilkank'ei.

Mamin Jehová, a ach ayachoch yipok ko k'ol a onh israel onh tik. Masanil heb' tzach aktankani, ol q'uixwokkanel heb'. Masanil heb' tz'el t'a a tz'ey, ol satkanel heb' icha tz'aj satel junok b'i tz'ib'ab'ilem t'a kal pokok. Ol satkanel heb' yujto tzach yaktejkan heb', yujto a ach tik lajan ach icha junok sjaj ha ha'.
Mamin Jehová, ak' b'oxok in k'ool yik tzin b'oxikani. Kol in, yik wach' tzin kolchajkani, yujto anhej t'ayach swal wach' lolonel.
Syal heb' anima t'ayin icha tik: ¿B'aq'uinh ol elk'och slolonel Jehová alnak t'ayonh? Elokab'k'och tas syal chi' tiknaik, xchi heb'.

Mamin, malaj b'aj ix in tewi t'ayach yik tzin k'anankot junok tas tz'ik'an satel heb' anima. Max in nib'ej pax sjawi junok yaelal t'a yib'anh heb'. Ha ach tik ojtak tas ix in k'ana', yujto t'a ichanh ix wala'.
Manh in ak'och t'a xiwk'olal, yujto a t'ayach tzin kol in b'a ayik ay in och t'a syaelal.
Q'uixwokab'kanel heb' tzin pechan b'eyek'ok, mokab' in q'uixwokel a in tik. Xiwokab' heb' chi', mokab' in xiw a in tik. Ak'kot yaelal t'a yib'anh heb', satel heb' t'a junelnhej.

Ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ixik, b'at ochanh linhan t'a spuertail chonhab' b'aj tz'eli tz'och heb' sreyal Judá. Ata' tzalel in lolonel. Ichanhej chi' tza k'ulej t'a juntzanh spuertail Jerusalén.
Tzalan t'a heb' anima icha tik: Ex rey yet' jantak ex kajan ex t'a Jerusalén tik yet' he masanil ex aj Judá, machtak ex tzex och t'a juntzanh puerta tik, ab'ek wal tas syal Jehová:
Tzeyil wal he b'a, manh he kuch eyikatz t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip, manh eyik'ochta t'a spuertail Jerusalén tik, yik max ja yaelal t'a eyib'anh yuj.
Manh eyik'paxelta junok eyikatz t'a yol he pat t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip chi'. Malajokab' junok munlajel tze k'ulej t'a jun k'u chi'. Niwanokab' yelk'och t'ayex icha ajnak walan t'a heb' he mam eyicham.
Palta manh schanakok yab' heb' tas walnak chi'. Spitejnak sb'a heb', manh sk'anab'ajejnakok skachnab'il heb' wak'nak.

Ha in wal Jehová in swala': k'anab'ajejek tas swala', manh eyik'kot eyikatz t'a spuertail chonhab' tik t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip. Niwanokab' yelk'och jun k'u chi' t'ayex, malajokab' junok munlajel tze k'ulej.

Tato tze k'anab'ajej tas swal tik, aynhej heb' yinhtilal winhaj David ol ochnhej reyal t'a in chonhab' tik. Ol ochta heb' t'a spuertail yet' karruaje nherb'il yuj nok' chej, ajun heb' eyajalil ex aj Judá ex tik yet' pax heb' aj Jerusalén tik. Ha jun chonhab' tik malaj b'ak'uinh ol kan tzinan.

Ol laj kot heb' anima t'a junjun chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá, haton juntzanh ay t'a spatik yichanh Jerusalén tik, t'a yol yik Benjamín, t'a ak'lik, t'a tzalkixtak yet' pax t'a yol yik Neguev. Ol yik'kot nok' nok' heb' silab'il yik snhusjitz'a t'a templo. Ol yik'paxkot juntzanhxo nok' silab' heb', ixim trigo, inkienso yet' ofrenda yik syak'an yuj diosal heb' t'ayin.

Palta tato manh ol he k'anab'ajej in cheknab'il tik jun, tato manh niwanok yelk'och jun k'ual chi' t'ayex, tato ol eyik'ochta eyikatz t'a spuertail chonhab' tik t'a jun k'u chi', ol wak' nhusjoktz'a masanil palakio t'a Jerusalén tik. Manhxa mach ol yal smak'an tup jun k'ak' chi', xchi Jehová, xa chi, xchi t'ayin.
Ix lolon Jehová t'ayin, ix yalan icha tik:
Ixik, emanh t'a spat jun winh tz'akum lu'um. Ata' ol wal jun lolonel t'ayach, xchi t'ayin.
Ix in em b'ian, wan stz'akwi winh t'a jun tz'aklab' tzek' sururok.
Ayik wan stz'akan jun lum chen winh, haxo ix aji ix ixtaxb'at lum t'a yol sk'ab' winh. Yuj chi' anheja' yet' lum slumal chi' ix sb'o junxo lu'um winh icha snib'ej.
T'a jun rato chi' ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik:

Ha in wal Jehová in swal t'ayex israel ex tik: ¿Tom max yal ex wutan icha syutej lum lum winh tz'akum tik stz'akani? Ha ex tik, lajan eyaj t'a yol in k'ab' icha yaj lum lum t'a yol sk'ab' winh tz'akum tik.
Q'uinalok a in tik tzin na' in juanb'ati, ma in satanel junok chonhab', ma junok makb'en,
palta tato a jun chonhab' chi' sna sb'a sk'ool, syik'anel sb'a t'a skal chukal, anhejtona' in tzin k'expax in pensar, maxtzak wak'b'at jun yaelal chi' t'a yib'anh.
Q'uinalok tzin na' in b'oank'e junok chonhab' yet' wak'an q'uib'ok,
palta tato anhej chukal sk'ulej, max sk'anab'ajej pax tas swala', tzin k'expax in pensar, maxtzak wak' in wach'k'olal nab'il wuj wak'an t'ay.

Al t'a heb' kajan t'a Judá yet' t'a Jerusalén to a in swal juntzanh lolonel tik: Wan in naan tas ol ex wutej, tas ol aj wak'anoch eyaelal, yuj chi' aktejekkan he chuk b'eyb'al, k'ulejek wach'il, xchi Jehová, xa chi.
Ol yalan heb' t'ayach icha tik: Manh ixtej a b'a onh a kachani. Ha onh tik ol ko k'ulejnhej chukal, icha tas skot t'a ko pensar ko k'ulani, xcham heb', xchi Jehová.
Yuj chi' ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: k'anb'ejek ek' t'a junjun nakión, tato ay b'aj ix ab'chaj sk'ulaj icha tas sk'ulej heb' etisraelal tik. Ha heb' tik yelxo wal te chuk tas sk'ulej heb'.
¿Tok ay junok tiempoal manh ayokem k'een sakb'akom t'a jolomtak witz t'a yol yik Líbano? ¿Ay am b'aj stup ha ha' te siik skot t'a jolomtak witz chi'?

Palta a ex in chonhab' ex tik, manh junnhejok b'aj ayexkani, kotak skal tze k'exan he pensar. Tzin eyaktankani, haxo t'a tas manh diosok tze nhus inkienso. Ex satb'at t'a jun b'e aytaxon t'a peka'. Axo t'a b'e yik chukal b'aj tzex b'ati.
Yuj he chukal chi' ol kan tzinan he chonhab' tik. Ol te b'uchjoknhej. Masanil heb' ol ek' t'a tik, ol laj syum sat heb' ex stzetzani, yujto satub'tak ol aj yilji.

Icha tz'aj saklemb'at tastak yuj ik' skot b'aj sjawi k'u, icha chi' ol aj ex wak'an saklemb'at yuj heb' eyajk'ool. Ol in b'at mikan t'ayex ayik ol ja sk'ual sjawi he yaelal chi'. Manhxo ol in b'at k'elan t'ayex, xchi Jehová.

Ix yalan heb' anima chi' icha tik: Ko naek tas skutej winhaj Jeremías tik yuj tas syal winh t'a kib'anh. Tokwal ol lajwokel heb' sakerdote tzonh k'ayb'ani, ma heb' aj pensar tz'ak'an ko razón, ma heb' schekab' Dios tz'alan slolonel Dios chi' t'ayonh. Yuj chi' ko naekk'e esal lolonel t'a spatik winh, yik smiljicham winh. Manh ol ko k'anab'ajejlaj tas syal winh chi', xchi heb'.
Mamin Jehová, kotanh wal k'elan t'ayin, tzab'an wal tas syal heb' ayoch ajk'olal tik t'ayin.

¿Tom yet' chukal tz'aj spaktzitaj wach'k'olal? Ha heb' chi' toxo ix sna heb' tas ol yutej heb' in smilanchamok. Nakoti to ix in k'och t'a ichanh in tewi t'ayach yuj swach'ilok heb', yik max ak'kot yowal a k'ol t'a yib'anh heb'.

Axo tiknaik jun, ak' cham yuninal heb' yuj wejel yet' yuj owal. Kanokab' heb' ix yetb'eyum heb' junixtakil, manhxaokab' junok yune' heb' ix skani. Miljokab'cham heb' winh yetb'eyum heb' ix, haxo heb' winh yune' heb' ix kelemtakxo, chamokab' heb' t'a owal.
Ak'kot junok nhilanh soldado elk'um t'a skal heb'. Ab'chajokab' yel yaw heb' yuj syaelal, yujto ichato sjoy olan heb' b'aj ol in mukchajok, say modo heb' tas tz'aj in telwi t'a yol sk'ab' heb'.

Palta a ach tik Mamin Jehová, ojtak masanil tastak smol alej heb' t'a wib'anh yik tzin smilancham heb' yalani. Manh ak' niwank'olal heb', mokab' b'at smul heb' chi' satk'olal uuj. Satokab'el heb' t'a ichanh, ak'och syaelal heb' yuj yowal a k'ool.
Ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik: B'at man junok lum ch'ub', tzik'anb'at heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' et'ok yet' heb' sakerdote ichamtak winakxo.
Tzach el t'a puerta b'aj tz'el heb' sb'at ak'ojkan k'alem t'a sch'olanil yik Ben-hinom, ata' ol al juntzanh lolonel swal tik t'ayach t'a heb'.

Tzalan icha tik: Ex sreyal Judá yet' ex kajan ex t'a Jerusalén tik, ab'ek wal slolonel Jehová ko Diosal Yajal t'a Smasanil: Ab'ek, ol wak'b'at jun niwan yaelal t'a yib'anh he chonhab' tik. Masanil mach ol ab'anok, ol sat sk'ol heb' yab'ani.

Yujto tzin eyaktejkani, tzeyak'anoch jun lugar tik yikok komon Dios. Tze nhusan inkienso t'a juntzanh komon Dios manh eyojtakok yet' heb' he mam eyicham. Manhxa yalnab'il jantak heb' unin malaj smul tze milchamok.
Ix he b'ok'e juntzanh altar b'aj tze nhustz'a heb' eyuninal silab'il t'a Baal. Tze k'ulan wal tas manhok in swak' he k'ulej, max ek' t'a in pensar juntzanh tas tze k'ulej chi'.
Yuj chi', a in wal Jehová in tik swala': Ay wal jun k'ual to a jun ch'olan tik, manhxo ol skuch Tofet, ma sch'olanil yik Ben-hinom, palta sch'olanil b'aj smiljicham anima ol sb'iejkani.

Yuj jantak anima ol cham t'a jun ch'olan tik, ol wak' ixtaxel tas nab'il eyuj ex aj Judá yet' ex aj Jerusalén. Ol ex wak' ak'jok ganar yuj heb' eyajk'ol snib'ej tzex milanchamok. Axo he niwanil ol och schib'ejok nok' ostok yet' nok' kaltakte'al nok'.
Ol ochkan he chonhab' tik tzinan lumal, xiwub'tak ol ajkanok. Ha heb' ol ek' t'a tik, ol xiw heb', ol sat sk'ol heb' yilani, ol b'uchwaj heb' yuj tas ol ajkan chi'.
Ol wak' he chilajb'at eyuninal yet' eyisil yuj wejel, ol wak'an he chilajb'at he b'a, ayik ol oymaj heb' ajk'ol t'a spatik he chonhab', xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb'.
Ayik slajwi alan juntzanh tik, tza mak'anpoj jun lum ch'ub' chi' t'a yichanh heb' anima ajun et' chi',

tzalan t'a heb' icha tik: Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil tz'alan icha tik: Ol in satel jun chonhab' tik, icha tz'aj smak'jipoj junok lum ch'ub' maxtzak yal sb'o junelxo. Ha t'a lum Tofet tik ol he mukem heb' he chamnak, yujto manhxa b'aj ol yal he mukan heb'.
Ha in Jehová in swala', icha chi' ol wutej jun chonhab' tik yet' heb' kajan t'ay, lajan ol aj icha ol aj Tofet tik.

Te yajb'entak ol ajkan masanil pat t'a Jerusalén tik yet' spalakio heb' sreyal Judá. Anhejtona' yajb'entak ol ajkan spanhanil yib'anhtak pat b'aj snhusji inkienso t'a k'een k'anal t'a satcha'anh yet' b'aj tze sekem wino ofrendail t'a komon Dios. Icha Tofet chi' ol ajkanok, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb', xchi Jehová t'ayin.

Ayik ix lajwi in k'ulan juntzanh tik, a in Jeremías in tik, in paxta t'a Tofet chi', b'aj ix walkanel slolonel Jehová. In och linhan t'a yol yamaq'uil stemplo Dios, ix walan t'a masanil heb' anima icha tik:

Ha Jehová ko Diosal Yajal t'a Smasanil tz'alan icha tik: Ol wak'b'at yaelal t'a yib'anh jun he chonhab' tik yet' t'a yib'anh juntzanhxo chonhab' ay t'a he lak'anil. Ol jawok masanil juntzanh yaelal toxo ix wal tik t'a eyib'anh, yujto ix he pitej he b'a, maxtzak he k'anab'ajej tas swala', xchi Jehová, xin chi t'a heb'.
Ay jun winh skuchan Pasur yuninal winhaj Imer, sat sakerdote yaj winh t'a stemplo Jehová. Ayik ix yab'an winh tas ix wal a in Jeremías in tik,
ix in schekan mak'jok winh, ix in schekan ak'jokpaxoch winh t'a te' kepo t'a spuertail templo t'a stojolal smakb'en Benjamín.

Axo t'a junxo k'u, a winh ix alani to tzin ik'chajel t'a yol te' kepo chi'. Yuj chi' ix walan t'a winh icha tik: Ha Jehová ix k'exan a b'i. Magor-misabib ol a b'iejkani, syalelk'ochi xiwk'olalnhej yaji.

Yujto syal Jehová icha tik: Ol wak'och xiwk'olal t'a ib'anh yet' masanil heb' wach' ak'an yet'ok. Q'uelan ach wal ochi ol miljokcham heb' a wach'k'ool yuj yespada heb' ajk'ool. Ha exxo aj Judá ex tik ol ex wak'och t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Babilonia. Ay ex ol ex yik'b'at winh t'a Babilonia chi', ayex pax ol ex smilcham winh.
Masanil he b'eyumal yet' masanil tastak ay stojol ay t'ayex yet' sb'eyumal heb' sreyal Judá ol wak'och t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'ol chi', ol yik'anb'at heb' t'a Babilonia chi'.

Ha achxo tik ach Pasur, ol ach ik'chajb'at chekab'ok t'a Babilonia chi' yet' masanil heb' kajan et' t'a a pat. Ata' ol ach chamok, ol ach mukchajkan ta' yet' heb' a wach'k'ool chi', haton heb' b'aj ix esejkanel in ti'ok, xchi Jehová, xin chi.
Mamin Jehová, tonhej ix in a montej. Ix in k'anab'ajan tas ix ala'. Yelxo te tek'an ach, yuj chi' ix in ak' ganar. Masanil tiempo tzin tzetzaji, masanil anima tzin b'uchan uuj.

Ayik swalan t'a heb' juntak el icha tik: Ol jawok yaelal t'a eyib'anh, ol ex lajwokelok, xin chinhej t'a heb'. Yuj chi' aynhejoch heb' yalan chukal lolonel t'ayin, tzin sb'uchan pax heb', yujto swalel a lolonel.

Tato swala' to maxtzak ach wak' b'inajok, maxtzak walpaxel a lolonel, haxo tz'aji, icha te' k'ak' tz'aj a lolonel chi' t'ayin. Stz'ab'at in b'akil yuj swab'i. Tzin nib'ej tzin och waan walanel a lolonel tik, palta maxtzak yal-laj.

Swab' wal sajson heb' in sb'uchani: Syalan heb' icha tik: Ina winh xiwk'olalnhej yaj tik, xchi heb'. Syalanpax heb': Koyek, b'at kik'ekchaanh esal lolonel t'a yib'anh winh, xchi heb'. Anhejtona' heb' in wach'k'ool, snib'ej heb' b'aj tzin lektaji. Syalan heb' wuuj icha tik: Ko sayek modo tas tz'aj kak'an ganar kak'anek ek' ko pak t'a winh, xchi heb'.

Palta a ach tik Mamin Jehová, ayachnhej ek' wet'ok, icha junok soldado malaj mach tz'ak'an ganar. Ha heb' tzin pechani ol ak'jok ganar heb', a inxo jun manh ol in yak' ganar heb'. Ol q'uixwokkanel heb', manh ol satlaj sk'ol heb' t'a sq'uixwelal chi'.

Mamin Jehová, Yajal ach t'a Smasanil, a ach tza ch'olb'itej heb' tojol sb'eyb'al, tzilan tastak sna heb' anima. Ch'ox wil tas ol utej ak'an syaelal juntzanh anima tik, yujto toxo ix wak'och in b'a ab'enal t'a yol a k'ab'.
B'itejek Jehová, alek wach' lolonel t'ay. Ha skolanel heb' tz'ab'an syail t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ixtum anima.
Te chuk jun k'u b'aj aljinak in. Mokab' alchaj wach'il t'a jun k'u b'aj aljinak in t'a in nun.
Ob'iltak jun winak xit' alannak t'a winh in mam to ix alji jun yuninal winh yik stzalaj winh.
Satokab'el jun winak chi', icha juntzanh chonhab' ix satjiel yuj Dios t'a junelnhej. Yab'okab' winh yel aw yuj yaelal t'a q'uinhib'alil yet' aw yik ak'oj owal t'a chimk'ualil.
¿Tas yuj maj in mak'jicham yuj jun winak chi' ayik manto in alji? Tato icha chi', kannhejnak in am t'a ix in nun chi', ichato t'a ix mukchajnak in kani.
¿Tas wal yuj aljinak in? ¿Tom yuj wilan syaelal, yik tzin cham t'a q'uixwelal? xin chi.

Ha winhaj rey Sedequías ix chekankot winhaj Pasur yuninal winhaj Malquías yet' winhaj sakerdote Sofonías yuninal winhaj Maasías, yik sjawi heb' winh in yil a in Jeremías in tik, yik syalan heb' winh t'ayin icha tik:

Tzonh tewi t'ayach to tza k'an t'a Jehová kuuj, yujto a winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia, wan yak'an owal winh ket'ok. k'an t'a Jehová chi' to sch'ox spoder, icha sk'ulejnak t'a pekataxo, yik syik'anel winhaj Nabucodonosor chi', xchi heb' winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix lolon Jehová t'ayin. Ix in tak'wi t'a heb' winh schekab' winh rey chi' icha tik: Alek t'a winhaj Sedequías chi'

to a Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, a tz'alani: Ol wak' meltzaj heb' a soldado t'a spatik, haton heb' tz'ak'an owal yet' winh sreyal Babilonia. Axo heb' soldado winh chi' haton heb' oyanxo och t'a spatiktak jun chonhab' tik, ol in molb'ejoch heb' t'a yol jun chonhab' tik.
Ha in ol wak' owal eyet'ok yet' in poder yet' pax yowal in k'ol te ay smay.
Ol wak'cham masanil heb' anima kajan t'a jun chonhab' tik, ol cham heb' yet' nok' nok' yuj jun niwan yab'il.

Ol lajwok chi', a achxo tik ach Sedequías, ol ach wak'och t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Nabucodonosor yet' t'a juntzanhxo heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach. Ol ach wak'och t'a yol sk'ab' heb' yet' heb' a chekab', heb' a soldado yet' heb' anima pitzanto ol kan t'a jun chonhab' tik, haton heb' olto kan yuj jun niwan yab'il, owal yet' wejel. Ha in wal Jehová in swala', manh ol ok' sk'ol jun winh rey chi' t'a heb', ol miljokcham heb' yuj winh.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Al t'a juntzanh anima tik to a in swal icha tik: Swak' he sik'lej, ¿tom a he k 'inal, mato a he chamel?

Ha mach ol kan t'a jun chonhab' tik, ol cham yuj owal, yuj wejel yet' yuj ilya. Axo pax heb' ol el yak'och sb'a t'a yol sk'ab' heb' aj Babilonia wan yak'an owal t'a jun chonhab' tik jun, manh ol chamlaj heb', tewelxonhej ol kolchaj heb'.
Ha in Jehová in swala', toxo ix in na' wak'ankot yaelal t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' tik, manhxook wach'il ol wak'koti. Ol wak'och t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Babilonia, haxo winh ol nhusantz'aok.

Alpax t'a heb' sreyal Judá yinhtilal winhaj David icha tik: Scham wal eyab'an tas swal a in Jehová in tik: Wach'okab' tzeyutej he b'oan yaj yowal heb' anima t'a junjun k'u. Tze kol heb' tz'ixtaj yuj heb' ixtum anima. Tato chuk tzeyutej he b'oan yaj jun, ol kot yowal in k'ol t'a eyib'anh, icha te' k'ak' te ow sk'e nhilnhon yok manhxa mach syal stupani.

Ex aj Jerusalén, te chaanh eyajk'e t'a yib'anh lum ak'lik, icha yajk'e junok niwan tenam t'a lum ak'lik chi'. Palta a in Jehová in swala' to aykot yowal in k'ol t'ayex. Tzeyal icha tik: ¿Mach ol yal yak'an owal ket'ok? ¿Mach ol yal sk'eul b'aj sko kol ko b'a tik? xe chi.

Ha in Jehová in swala' to ol wak'och eyaelal icha wal smojal yuj tastak tze k'ulej. Ol wak'och sk'ak'al he palakio. Axo tastak ay t'a spatiktak he chonhab', ol lajwokel stz'ab'ati, xchi Jehová, xin chi t'a heb' schekab' winhaj Sedequías chi'.
Ix yalan Jehová t'ayin: Ixik t'a spalakio winh sreyal Judá, tzalan juntzanh lolonel tik
t'a winh, haton winh yinhtilal winhaj David. Tzalan pax t'a yichanh masanil heb' ayoch yopisio yet' winh yet' pax t'a heb' anima ay ta' to smaklej yab' in lolonel tik heb'.

Ha tojolal yet' wach'ilal a tze b'eyb'alej. Manh eyixtej heb' eyetanimail, manh eyixtej heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, ma heb' unin chamnak smam yet' heb' ix ix chamnak yetb'eyum. Manh he milcham heb' anima malaj smul.

Tato t'a wal yel ol he b'eyb'alej juntzanh swal tik, ol ochnhej heb' yinhtilal winhaj David reyal t'a tik. Ayoch heb' t'a yol karruaje yet' t'a yib'anh chej ol ochta heb' t'a spuertail palakio tik, ajun masanil heb' ay yopisio yet' heb' yet' pax heb' anima.
Palta tato manh ol he cha eyab' juntzanh ix wal a in Jehová in tik jun, a jun palakio tik ol satelok, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb', xchi t'ayin.

Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik. Ha spalakio winh sreyal Judá, ha t'a yol in sat lajan wal icha swach'il yilji lum Galaad, icha pax lum jolom witz Líbano. Palta swak' in ti' swalani to ol meltzajkanoch icha tzinan luumal. Manhxa mach ol kajnaj t'ay.
Ol wik'kot heb' anima ay syamk'ab' yik owal t'a jun palakio tik yik satanel heb'. Ol smak'anelta te' k'ute' heb', haton te' manh jantakok swach'il ayoch spatzab'ilok, ol snhusankantz'a te' heb'.
Ol kot heb' anima t'a juntzanhxo chonhab', ol ek' heb' t'a stz'ey jun chonhab' tik, ol laj sk'anb'an heb' t'ay junjun: ¿Tas yuj icha tik ix yutej jun niwan chonhab' tik Jehová? xcham heb'.

Ol tak'wok juntzanhxo heb' icha tik: Icha tik ix yutej Jehová sDiosal heb', yujto ix yaktejkan strato heb' sb'onak yet'ok, haxo t'a juntzanh komon Dios b'aj ix och heb' ejmelal, xcham heb', xchi Jehová.

Manh ex ok' yuj schamel winhaj Josías, ok'anhek yuj winhaj Salum yuninal winhaj Josías chi'. Yujto ix ik'jib'at winh t'a junelnhej, manhxa b'ak'uinh ol meltzaj winh, manhxo ol yil-laj schonhab' winh b'aj aljinak. Ha yuj winhaj Salum chi', winh ix och sreyalok Judá ayik toxo ix cham winh smam winh chi', a Jehová tz'alan yuj winh icha tik. Ix ik'jiel winh t'a jun chonhab' tik, manhxo ol meltzajlaj winh.
Ha t'a jun chonhab' b'aj ix ik'jib'at winh chi', ata' ol cham winh. Manhxo ol ul yilxi schonhab' winh tik.
Ob'iltak ach, yuj wal a chukal tza b'oank'e a palakio yet' a niwak pat. Tzak' munlaj heb' anima, palta max a tuplaj sk'u heb'.

Tzalan icha tik: Ol in b'ok'e junok in niwan palakio, haxo t'a yib'anh ol in b'ok'e juntzanhxo lewan tz'aj yool. Ol jakwokkan swentenail, haxo te' k'ute' ol wak'och yichtakok, haxo yelaw, chakchak ol ajok, xa chi.

¿Am a naani to yujnhejto ayachek' t'a yoltak pat nab'a k'ute' ayoch t'ay, yuj chi' rey ach to niwan elk'ochi? Ha winh a mam ix yak' tzalajb'ok sk'ol winh, yujto tojol ix yutej sb'a winh, wach'nhej tas ix sk'ulej winh, yuj chi' wach'nhej ix ajelk'och winh.
Ix skol heb' meb'a' winh yet' heb' tz'ixtaj yuj heb' chuk spensar. Yuj chi' wach'nhej ix elk'och winh. Ha in Jehová in swala' to a sb'eyb'al winh chi' sch'oxani to yojtak in winh.
Palta a ach tik, anhej b'eyumal tza nib'ej t'a spatik chukal. Tza chekan miljokcham heb' anima malaj smul, tzixtan heb' etchonhab', xchi Jehová.

Syal Jehová yuj winhaj Joacim yuninal winhaj Josías sreyal Judá icha tik: Malaj heb' ol ok' yuj schamel winh. Malaj heb' ol alan icha tik: Ay, ach wetanimail. Ob'iltak onh. Toxo ix cham winh ko reyal, icha ko mam yaj winh, manh xchiok heb'.
Icha tz'aj junok nok' chamnak b'uru, icha chi' ol utaj winh, ol nherchajkanel winh t'a tiel chonhab' Jerusalén, xchi Jehová.

Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ex aj Judá, k'eanhek t'a jolom witz Líbano tzex awaj ta'. Te chaanh tzex awaj t'a jolomtak witz yik Basán yet' t'a tzalkixtak yik Abarim, yujto masanil heb' ayoch eyet'ok toxo ix satel heb'.
Ha in tik, ix wal t'ayex yik wach' eyajek' t'a he chonhab', palta maj yal he k'ol ix eyab'i. Ichanhej chi' ix eyutej he b'a yiktax wanto eyoch chonhab'il, toxon max he cha eyab' tas swala'.

Ol ik'jokb'at heb' eyajalil yuj heb' ajk'ool, icha yik'jib'at junok tas yuj owal ik', haxo heb' ayoch eyet'ok ol ik'jokb'at heb' t'a junokxo ch'ok chonhab'il. Toxonhej ol ex q'uixwokkanok. Manhxa ol ajkan eyelk'och yuj jantak he chukal.

Ha tiknaik, te tzalajk'olal eyajek' t'a he pat nab'a k'ute' kotnak ste'al t'a Líbano. Palta ayik ol jawok yaelal t'a eyib'anh, ol el eyaw eyab'an syail, icha yab'an syail junok ix ix tz'alji yune', xchi Jehová.

Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Jeconías yuninal winhaj Joacim sreyal Judá: Wach'chom aylaj tzach och wuj icha junok kolk'ab' ayoch t'a swach' k'ab' heb' niwak winak, palta swak' in ti' to ol ach in julkaneli.
Ol ach wak'kanoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'ol b'aj tzach te xiwi, heb' snib'an ach smilanchamok, haton winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia yet' heb' ajun yet'ok.
Ol ach wak' ik'jokb'at yet' ix a nun t'a lum lum b'aj manhok ta' ex alji, ata' ol ex cham he chawanhil.
Manhxo ol ex meltzaj t'a tik, wach'chom olto he nib'ej meltzajxi he b'a, xchi Jehová.
¿Tom lajan winhaj Jeconías tik yet' junok lum chen pojeltak manhxa yopisio, ma icha junok yamk'ab' manhxa mach snib'ani? ¿Tas yuj sjuljikanb'at winh yet' heb' yinhtilal t'a jun lum lum manh yojtakok?
Ab'ek wal ex aj Judá, scham wal eyab'an tas syal Jehová.

Ha Jehová tz'alanxi icha tik: Tz'ib'chajokab'kan b'aj ay sb'i heb' yinhtilal heb' rey to a jun winak tik, lajan tz'ajkan icha junok winak malaj yuninal, icha junok winak manh wach'ok ix aj yelk'ochi. Yujto manhxa junok yinhtilal winh ol och reyal t'a spalakiokan winhaj David, syak'anxi reyal t'a Judá tik, xchi Jehová.

Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ex yilumal in chonhab', ob'iltak ex, lajan ex icha junok tanhwum kalnel smilancham nok' skalnel chi', saklemkanb'at nok' yuj. Icha chi' tzeyutej heb' in chonhab' tik, xchi Jehová.

Ha Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, a tz'alan t'a heb' yilumal schonhab' tz'ak'an yajalil t'ay: Ex yilumal in chonhab', ix he saklemkanb'at heb' in chonhab', ix he xib'tankanb'at heb', maj he tanhwej heb'. Yuj chi' a in Jehová in tik swala', ol wak'och eyaelal yuj tas ix he k'ulej chi'.
Axo heb' ix in saklemkanb'at t'a juntzanhxo ch'ok chonhab'il, a in Jehová in tik swala', ol wik' meltzaj heb'. Ol wak'anxi kajnaj heb' t'a schonhab', ol wak'anxi q'uib' sb'isul heb'.
Ol wak'anoch yilumal heb', yik maxtzak xiw heb', manhxa junok heb' ol satok, xchi Jehová.

Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Ay jun k'u ol jawok, ol wak'och jun yinhtilal winhaj rey David reyal t'a in chonhab' tik. Ha jun rey chi' te tojol spensar. Yet' sjelanil ol yak' reyal, tojol ol yutej sch'olb'itan masanil chonhab'.
Ha t'a stiempoal ol yak' reyal chi', ol kolchajkanel heb' aj Judá yet' pax heb' aj Israel, manhxalaj tas ol sna heb'. Haton jun b'i tik ol ak'jok sb'iok: Ha Jehová sb'oanel tas tzonh aj t'a stojolal.

Ha tiknaik, slok in b'i heb' anima tik, syalan heb' icha tik: Yojtak wal Jehová, jun ik'annakelta heb' ko mam kicham t'a Egipto, xchi heb'. Palta swak'kan in ti' tiknaik to ay jun k'u ol jawok ol yal heb' icha tik: Yojtak wal Jehová, jun ix onh ik'anelta t'a norte yet' t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' b'aj ix onh saklemkanb'ati, xcham heb'. Ichato chi' ol kajnajxi heb' israel chi' t'a sluum, xchi Jehová.

Icha tik ix wal t'a heb' syaloch sb'a schekab'ok Dios: Ha Jehová ix alan jun lolonel niwan yelk'och t'ayin. Yuj chi' ix och wal pitz'an t'a in pixan sik'lab'il, ix ib'xik'e in niwanil. Icha sketkonek' heb' uk'um anh toxo wal stelwi, icha chi' ix in aji.

Ha heb' anima kajan t'a jun chonhab' tik, anhej wal ajmulal sk'ulej heb', syak' wal yip heb' sk'ulan chukal. Ha heb' niwak yelk'ochi, anhej ixtoj anima syak' heb'. Yuj chi' toxo ix katab'aj lum lum tik yuj Jehová, toxo ix takjiel lu'um, toxo ix tz'ab'at anh ank'ultak b'aj swa nok' nok'.
Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ha wal heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok tik yet' heb' sakerdote, malaj welk'och t'a yol sat heb'. Swil wal sk'ulan chukal heb' t'a yol in templo.

Ha in Jehová in swala' to yuj chi' te k'ik' k'inal ol ajkan sb'e heb', te nhereri ol aj paxok. Ichato ol ekchajb'at heb', ol telwok heb'. Axo yik ol in ch'olb'itan heb', ol wak'ankot yaelal te ya t'a yib'anh heb'.
Wilnak wal heb' yalnakoch sb'a in chekab'ok t'a Samaria, te chuk tas sk'ulejnak heb'. Yalnakel slolonel Baal heb', icha chi' aj skuchb'annak satb'at in chonhab' Israel heb'.

Ix wilpax heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok t'a Jerusalén, te chuk tas sk'ulej heb'. Anhej ajmulal sk'ulej heb', ixtum anima pax heb', syiptzitan heb' sk'ulan chukal heb'. Malaj junok mach syaktejkan sk'ulan chukal. Ha wal tz'aj wilani, a juntzanh anima tik yet' heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén, lajan wal heb' yet' heb' aj Sodoma yet' heb' aj Gomorra.

Yuj chi' a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, swal juntzanh lolonel tik yuj juntzanh heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok chi': Yujto yuj heb' sk'echaanh chukal t'a masanil smakb'en heb' tik, yuj chi' ol wak' tas k'a' swa heb' yet' yuk'ej heb', to scham anima yuj.

Ha in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil swal icha tik: Ex aj Israel, manh eyak'och tas syal heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok chi' yipok he k'ool, yujto a tas syal heb' chi' esnhej, t'a yol yik heb' snaelta, manhok in tzin chek yal heb'.

Ha t'a heb' b'aj malaj yelk'och in lolonel, ata' syal heb' icha tik: Wach'nhej ol aj eyelk'ochi, xchi heb'. Ha t'a heb' stek'b'ej sb'a sk'ulan tas snaelta t'a yol yiko', syal heb' icha tik: Malaj junok yaelal ol jawok t'a eyib'anh, xchi heb'.
Palta a in Jehová in, a in swala' to a heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok chi', malaj junelok xit'ek' heb' b'aj tz'och molchajel, ayik tzin lolon yet' heb' in chekab'. Malaj junelok syab' heb' in loloni.
Te chuk heb', yuj chi' ol wak'och syaelal heb' yet' yowal in k'ool. Ha yowal in k'ol chi' lajan wal icha junok owal ik' nhab' sja xumnajok.
Manh ol wanaj yowal in k'ol chi', masanto ol elk'och tas nab'il wuuj. Ato b'ak'uinh, ol nachajel juntzanh tik eyuuj.
Manhok in tzin chek juntzanh chekab' chi', malaj tas swal t'a heb'. Tonhej skomon b'at lemnaj heb' yalel slolonel chi' t'a in b'i.
Komonok syojtakejel heb' tas nab'il wuuj, a am in lolonel syal heb' t'a in chonhab'. Tato icha chi', toxom ix yaktejkan schuk b'eyb'alil in chonhab' tik, manhxa am chukal sk'ulej heb'.
Ha in Jehová in swalxi icha tik: Wach'chom t'a lak'an, ma t'a te najat, a in tik Dios innhej t'a smasanil b'aj.
Ha in wal Jehová in swala': Malaj junok b'aj wach' he k'ub'anel he b'a t'ayin. ¿Tom manh eyojtakok to ayinnhej ek' t'a masanil satcha'anh yet' t'a masanil sat lu'um?
Swab' wal tas syal juntzanh chekab' esalwum chi', stek'b'ej wal sb'a heb' yalani to a in lolonel syal heb', a in tzin lolon t'a heb' t'a swayich yalani.
¿B'aq'uinh ol yaktej juntzanh syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok chi' yalan esal lolonel chi'? ¿B'aq'uinh ol yaktej heb' yalan juntzanh lolonel tonhej snak'e t'a yol yik chi'?

Ha heb' chi' sna heb' tas tz'aj in b'atkan satk'olal yuj in chonhab' yuj swayich heb' syal-laj t'ay junjun, icha wal sk'ulejnak heb' he mam eyicham, ayik in b'atnak satk'olal yuj heb', axonhej komon Dios Baal b'aj yak'nakem sb'a heb'.

Ha in wal Jehová in swala': Tato ay junok chekab' chi' ay tas swayichej, yalokab'i to wayich. Palta tato a in lolonel scha jun, yalokab' t'a sjichanil. ¿Tom lajan yopisio ixim sat trigo yet' yok? Icha chi' in lolonel, manh lajanok yet' wayich. Ha in lolonel lajan wal icha te' k'ak', ma icha k'een almágana chok' tz'aj k'een niwak k'een yuj.
Yuj chi', te aykot yowal in k'ol t'a juntzanh chekab' tonhej syal-laj yab' slolonel junjun, syalan heb' to a in lolonel syal heb'.
Ha in swala', te aykot yowal in k'ol t'a juntzanh chekab' te wach' syutej sloloni, syalan heb' to a in lolonel syalel heb'.

Ha in swala', te aykot yowal in k'ol t'a juntzanh chekab' stz'ak yal swayich. Ha yuj juntzanh niwak esal lolonel syal heb' chi', satkanb'at heb' in chonhab'. Manhok in tzin chekb'at heb', manhok in swak' in cheknab'il t'a heb', yuj chi' malaj tas wach' yik'an heb' in chonhab' tik t'a heb', xchi Jehová.

Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ach Jeremías, tato ay junok anima t'a yol chonhab' tik, ma junok syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok, ma junok sakerdote sk'anb'an t'ayach: ¿Tas syal srazón Jehová? tato xchi heb'. Tzalan t'a heb' icha tik: Lajan ex icha wal junok ikatz t'a Jehová, yuj chi' ol ex aktajem yuj, xa chi.
Tato a junok chekab', ma junok sakerdote, ma junok komon anima tz'alan icha tik: Srazón Jehová, tato xchi heb', a in ol wak'och yaelal t'a yib'anh heb' yet' heb' kajan yet'ok.
Tato ay junok mach sk'anb'an t'a junok yamigo, ma t'a junok sk'ab' yok yuj tas swala', syal yalan icha tik: ¿Tas ix yutej Jehová spakani? ma ¿tas ix yal Jehová? xchiokab'i.

Palta max yal yalan icha tik: Ha srazón Jehová tzin k'anb'ej. Tato syal icha chi', a jun lolonel chi' ol meltzajkanoch ikatzil t'ay. Yujto ix yixtejb'at heb' anima tik tas swal a in he Diosal pitzan in tik, Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil.
Icha tik tz'aj he k'anb'an t'a jun in chekab': ¿Tas spak ix yal Jehová, ma tas ix yala'? xe chi.
Ach Jeremías, tato tzato yal heb': Srazón Jehová, tato xchi heb', tzal t'a heb' icha tik: Ha wal Jehová tz'alani: Yujto a ex tik tzeyalnhej juntzanh lolonel b'aj ix ex in kacha' to maxtzak eyala',
yuj chi' ol ex b'at satk'olal wuuj yet' pax jun chonhab' ix wak' t'ayex yet' t'a heb' he mam eyicham. Najat ol ex in yumkaneli.
Masanil tiempo ol ex wak'kan q'uixwelal, manhxalaj jab'ok yelk'och ol ex ajkanok. Manhxo ol b'at satk'olal eyuj tas ol ex utaj chi', xchi Jehová.

Ha winhaj Jeconías sreyal Judá, yuninal winhaj Joacim, ix ik'jib'at winh preso yuj winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia. Ix ik'chajpaxb'at heb' ayoch yajalil yet' winh, heb' b'oum pat yet' heb' tenum k'een. Ixlajwi chi' icha t'a wayichal ix aj sch'oxan chab' mooch sat te' higo Jehová t'ayin, ayek' t'a yichanh templo.
Ha t'a yol junok mooch chi', ayem te' sat higo te wach', q'uinhxo, haton te' b'ab'el sat, haxo t'a yol junxo te' mooch chi', ayem te' higo te chukxolaj, maxtzak yal-laj ko loani.

Axo ix sk'anb'an Jehová t'ayin: ¿Jeremías, tas tzil chi'? xchi. Ix in tak'wi, ix walani: Ay chab' mooch te' sat higo swila'. Ay te' manhxo jantakok swach'il, ay pax te' te chukxolaj, maxtzak yal-laj ko loani, xin chi.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik:

Ha in Jehová he Diosal in swala': Icha wal sat te' higo wach' chi', icha chi' yaj chonhab' Judá t'a yol in sat, haton heb' ix wak' ik'jokb'at t'a smakb'en heb' kaldeo. Te wach' ol wutok in b'a t'a heb'.
Ol in tanhwejnhej heb', ol wik'anxi meltzaj heb' t'a jun schonhab' tik. Ha tik ol wik'chaanh heb', manhxo ol in satel-laj heb'. Icha wal to ol wawejem heb', manhxo ol in tok'k'eta heb'.
Ol wak' wal spensar heb', yik syojtakejel heb' to a in ton Jehová Dios in. Ol och heb' in chonhab'ok, a inxo ol in och sDiosalok heb'. Yujto t'a smasanil sk'ol heb' ol meltzajkot t'ayin.

Axo winhaj Sedequías sreyal Judá, heb' yajal yaj yet' winh yet' masanil heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén, haton heb' ixto kan kajan t'a tik yet' pax heb' ix k'och kajan t'a Egipto, lajan wal heb' t'a yol in sat icha sat te' higo te chukxolaj chi', haton te' maxtzak yal sloji.

Ol wak'b'at junok niwan yaelal t'a yib'anh heb'. Ol te xiw juntzanhxo ch'ok nakional yuj. Manhxalaj ol ajkan yelk'och heb'. Ha heb' anima t'a juntzanh nakión b'aj ol in saklemejb'at heb' chi', ol te b'uchwaj heb' t'a heb', ol b'ajjok heb' yuj heb', ol jawok katab' t'a yib'anh heb'.
Ol wak'b'at owal, wejel yet' ilya t'a yib'anh heb'. Manhxa junok heb' ol kan t'a sat lum lum ix wak' t'a heb' yet' t'a smam yicham heb', xchi Jehová.

Ayik schanhil ab'il yoch winhaj Joacim yuninal winhaj Josías reyal t'a Judá, haton yik b'ab'el ab'il yoch winhaj Nabucodonosor reyal t'a Babilonia, ix lolon Jehová t'ayin a in Jeremías in tik yuj tas ol aj chonhab' Judá.
Ix walan jun lolonel tik t'a masanil heb' anima ay t'a yol yik Judá yet' t'a masanil heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén. Yuj chi' ix walan icha tik:

Ayik 13 ab'il yoch winhaj Josías yuninal winhaj Amón reyal t'a Judá tik, ix el yich slolon Jehová t'ayin, yuj chi' 23 ab'ilxo slolonnhej t'ayin. Tzijtum el ix wal t'ayex, palta manh jab'ok tze cha eyab'i.
Wach'chom tzijtum el ix schekkot heb' schekab' Jehová t'ayex, palta maj he chanhej eyab' tas ix chekji yal heb', maj he k'anab'ajej.
Ix yal wal heb' t'ayex to tzeyaktejkan he chuk b'eyb'al, yik wach' tzex kajnajnhej t'a lum lum yak'nak Jehová t'a heb' ko mam kicham.

Manh ex b'at t'a spatik komon Dios, manh ex och ejmelal t'ay. Manh he tzuntzejkot yowal sk'ol Jehová yuj eyoch ejmelal t'a juntzanh Dios to a ex tze b'o tik, yik wach' max yak'kot junok yaelal Jehová t'a eyib'anh, xchi heb' schekab' chi'.

Axo tiknaik, syal Jehová icha tik: Ha ex tik max yal he k'ol tze cha eyab' tas swala'. Tze tzuntzej wal kot yowal in k'ool, yujto tzex och ejmelal t'a juntzanh he diosal tze b'o'o. Yuj chi' anheja' ex tzeyik'kot yaelal t'a eyib'anh, xchi Jehová.
Yuj chi' syalanxi Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil icha tik: Yujto max he cha eyab' tas swala',

yuj chi' ol wawtejkot masanil juntzanh ch'ok chonhab'il skot t'a norte yet' pax winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia. Ol wak'lab'ej winh yik sjawi winh yet' juntzanh chonhab' chi' yak' owal t'a jun chonhab' tik yet' t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' ay t'a slak'anil yet' heb' anima kajan t'ay. Ol wak' satel heb' smasanil. Junelnhej ol wak' lajwokel heb'. Ha heb' ol ilanok, ol xiwk'e heb', ol b'uchwaj heb' t'a heb'.
Ha wal ol wutejkan heb' chi', manhxa b'aj ol ab'chaj yoch b'it yik q'uinh yuj tzalajk'olal, ma b'it yik nupnajel. Manhxa b'aj ol ab'chaj sk'anh k'een cha', manhxa b'aj ol ilchaj yok kandil.
Masanil jun chonhab' tik ol kan tzinan, ol em lanhnajok. Ha jun chonhab' tik yet' juntzanhxo chonhab' ay t'a slak'anil tik, 70 ab'il ol kan t'a yalanh smandar winh sreyal Babilonia chi'.

Ha in wal Jehová in swak' in ti', ayik ol lajwok 70 ab'il chi', ol in ch'olb'itan smul winh sreyal Babilonia chi' yet' masanil heb' kajan t'a smakb'en winh, haton heb' kaldeo. Ol in satel heb' t'a junelnhej.
Masanil juntzanh yaelal ix wala', ol wak'em t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' chi', haton tastak tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a jun uum tik, haton tas ix in chek yalkan winhaj Jeremías yuj masanil juntzanh chonhab'.
Ol wak'och heb' t'a yol sk'ab' niwak chonhab' yet' heb' niwak yajal. Icha chi' ol aj schaan spak heb', icha wal smojal tas sk'ulej, xchi Jehová.

Ha Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, ha' ix ch'oxan t'ayin icha wayichal, ix yalan t'ayin: Ina jun kopa tik, b'ut'an yuj wino, sch'oxel yowal in k'ool. Ik'b'ati, tzak'an yuk' masanil nakión b'aj ol ach in chekb'ati.
Ayik ol yuk'an heb', ol xej heb', ol kistalax heb' yuj. Icha chi' ol aj heb' yuj jun owal ol wak'b'at t'a skal, xchi Jehová.
Ix in chaan jun kopa chi' t'a Jehová, ix wak'an yuk' masanil chonhab' chi' tas ayem t'a yool, haton juntzanh b'aj ix in scheka'.

Ix wak' yuk' heb' aj Jerusalén yet' masanil heb' kajan t'a junjun chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá. Ix yuk' heb' yet' sreyal yet' yajalil, yik slajwiel heb' yuj. Ha heb' ol ilan heb', ol xiw heb', ol b'uchjok heb', ol katab'aj heb' yuj heb', icha wan kilan tiknaik.
Ix wak'anpax yuk' winh sreyal Egipto, heb' yajal, heb' niwak winak yet' masanil heb' anima kajan ta',

yet' pax heb' anima tonhej tzek' ta'. Ix wak'anpax yuk' masanil heb' rey ay t'a chonhab' Uz yet' masanil heb' ay t'a yol smakb'en heb' filisteo: Haton t'a Ascalón, t'a Gaza, t'a Ecrón yet' heb' anima ixto kan t'a Asdod.
Ix wak'anpax t'a heb' sreyal Edom, Moab yet' t'a heb' yinhtilal Amón.
Yet' t'a heb' sreyal Tiro yet' Sidón yet' masanil heb' sreyal junjun nakión ay t'a stitak ha' mar Mediterráneo.
Ix wak'anpax t'a heb' aj Dedán, t'a heb' aj Tema, t'a heb' aj Buz yet' t'a masanil heb' anima spiljoxejel yib'tak schikin.
Ix wak'anpax t'a heb' rey t'a Arabia yet' t'a masanil makanhil anima kajan t'a takinh lu'um.
Ix wak'pax yuk' heb' rey t'a Zimri, t'a Elam yet' t'a Media,
yet' t'a heb' rey t'a norte, haton heb' lak'nik ma heb' najtik skal. Syalelk'ochi, masanil heb' rey t'a yol yib'anhk'inal ix uk'ani. Slajwub'alxo ol yuk' winh sreyal Babilonia.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ala' to a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, sDiosal in Israel, a in ix wala': Uk'ejek he masanil ex yajal ex tik masanto sk'e t'a he jolom, ol ex xejok, ol ex telwok. Manhxo ol ex k'e waan. Icha chi' ol ex aj yuj jun owal ol wak'b'at t'a he kal, xchi Jehová.
Tato malaj snib'ej heb' schaan jun kopa chi' t'ayach, max yuk' pax heb', al t'a heb' icha tik: Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, ha' tz'alani: Yowalil ol eyuk'ej.

Tik wal tzin chael yich wak'anb'at yaelal t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' wik yaji. ¿Tzam he na' to manh ol k'och yaelal chi' t'a eyib'anh? Ha in wal Jehová in swala' to a jun chi' manh ol ek'b'at sk'och t'a eyib'anh, yujto ol wak'b'at owal t'a yib'anh masanil heb' kajan t'a sat lu'um tik, xchi Jehová, xa chi.

Ach Jeremías, al masanil juntzanh lolonel tik t'a heb': Ha Jehová icha sk'anh k'u, icha chi' ol aj yawajemta t'a satcha'anh, haton t'a skajnub' to yiknhej yaji. Icha wal yel yaw heb' tek'umel yal uwa, icha chi' ol aj yel yaw skot yowal t'a masanil anima kajan t'a sat lu'um tik.

Olto ab'chaj sk'anh b'aj slajwik'och lum lum tik, yujto ay tas ol yal Jehová t'a yib'anh masanil nakión. Ol ch'olb'itaj heb' anima yuj, ol yak'ankanoch chamel t'a yib'anh masanil heb' chuk, xchi Jehová, xa chi, xchi t'ayin.

Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil tz'alan icha tik: Ab'ek, t'a stzolal ol aj syamchaj junjun nakión yuj jun yaelal ol jawok, icha sjawi junok owal ik' nhab'. Wan smolb'an sb'a jun niwan yaelal chi' b'aj slajwik'och lum lum tik, xchi Jehová.

Ha heb' ol cham yuj Jehová t'a jun k'u chi', teltumb'a ol ajkan heb' t'a smasanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Malaj mach ol ok' yuj heb', malaj mach ol molb'an sniwanil heb' yik smukji. Toxonhej ol kan b'ulan sniwanil heb' t'a sat lu'um icha stza' nok' nok'.

Elokab' eyaw yuj yaelal ex yilumal chonhab'. Ek'anhek b'alb'on t'a sat lu'um, yujto toxo ix ja sk'ual he miljichamok. Ol ex saklemkanb'atok. Ol ex ak'jok ganar, ol ex miljokcham icha nok' ch'ak kalnel te b'ak'uech.
Ha heb' yilumal chonhab', manh ol yal sb'at heb' elelal. Ha heb' stanhwumal chonhab' chi' manh ol kolchajkanel heb'.
Ab'ek wal sk'akwi heb' yilumal chonhab' chi'. Tz'el yaw heb' yuj yaelal, yujto toxo ix satel schonhab' heb' yuj Jehová, icha stakjiel anh ank'ultak b'aj swa nok' kalnel.
Ix satjiel schonhab' heb' chi' yuj yowal sk'ol Jehová.
Ix elta juknaj Jehová t'a yet'tal icha junok nok' choj. Yet' wal yowal sk'ool ix yak'ankot jun owal te ay smay t'a skal juntzanh anima chi', chok' ix ajem lanhnaj schonhab' heb'.
Ayik ix och winhaj Joacim yuninal winhaj Josías reyal t'a Judá, ata' ix lolon Jehová t'ayin Jeremías in tik.
Ix yalan icha tik: Ajanh tek'tek' t'a yamaq'uil in templo, tzalan masanil tas ix wal tik t'ayach t'a heb' aj Judá tzul och ejmelal t'a in templo tik. Malaj junok lolonel to max ala'.
Talaj scha yab' heb' t'ayach, syaktankan schuk b'eyb'al heb', tato icha chi', manhxo ol wak'b'at yaelal nab'il wuj wak'anb'at t'a yib'anh heb' yuj schuk b'eyb'al chi'.
Tzal t'a heb' to a in Jehová in swal t'a heb' icha tik: Yujto max he cha eyab' in k'ayb'ub'al swala', max he k'anab'ajej paxi,
max he cha eyab' he kachji yuj heb' in chekab', wach'chom tzijtum el ix in chekb'at heb', palta maj he k'anab'ajej heb',

yuj chi', icha wutejnak in kajnub' t'a Silo, icha chi' ol wutej jun templo tik. Ol wak'b'at katab' t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' tik t'a skal masanil juntzanhxo chonhab' ay t'a yol yib'anhk'inal, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb'.
Ha heb' sakerdote, heb' syaloch sb'a schekab'ok Dios yet' masanil heb' anima, ix yab' wal heb' walan juntzanh lolonel chi' t'a templo.
Ayik ix lajwi walan masanil tas ix schek Jehová wala', ix in syaman heb'. Ix yalan heb' t'ayin icha tik: Ol ach chamok.

¿Tas wal yuj tza tek'b'ej a b'a alan t'a sb'i Jehová to a jun stemplo tik lajan ol ajkan icha ajnak skajnub' t'a Silo? Tzalani to ol satel jun chonhab' tik, manhxa mach ol kajnaj t'ay, xa chi, xchi heb'. Masanil anima ix ja nhilnaj t'a yamaq'uil templo chi', ix oymaj heb' t'a in patik.
Ayik ix yab'an heb' yajal t'a Judá tas wan yuji chi', ix kot heb' t'a spalakio winh rey, ix jawi heb' t'a templo b'aj ay jun ak' puerta, ata' ix jawi k'ojan heb'.

Ix yalan heb' sakerdote yet' heb' syaloch sb'a schekab'ok Dios chi' t'a heb' yajal yet' t'a heb' anima chi' icha tik: Ha jun winh tik smoj scham winh, yujto ix yal winh to ay yaelal ol ja t'a yib'anh ko chonhab' tik. Ha ex tik tzeyab'nhej tas syal winh chi', xchi heb'.
Ix walan t'a heb' yajal chi' yet' t'a heb' anima chi' icha tik: Ha Jehová ix chekan wal tas ix eyab' t'a spatik jun templo tik yet' t'a spatik ko chonhab' tik.
B'oek he b'eyb'al yet' tas tze k'ulej, k'anab'ajejek Jehová ko Diosal yik wach' manh ol yak'kot juntzanh yaelal toxo ix alchaj chi' t'a eyib'anh.
Ha in tik, ayin wal ek' t'a yol he k'ab', syalnhej he k'ulan tas tze nib'ej t'ayin.

Palta, ojtakejek wal el sik'lab'il: Tato a ex yet' heb' anima tik tzin he milchamok, ol och he mul yujto tze milcham junok mach malaj smul. Yujto wal yel, a Jehová ix chekan wal juntzanh lolonel tik, xin chi t'a heb'.

Yuj chi' ix yalan heb' yajal yet' heb' anima chi' t'a heb' sakerdote yet' t'a heb' syaloch sb'a schekab'ok Dios chi': Manh smojok scham jun winh tik, yujto ha t'a sb'i Jehová ko Diosal ix lolon winh t'ayonh, xchi heb'.
Ay juntzanh heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' ix k'e waan, ix yalan heb' t'a heb' anima molanek' chi':

Ha t'a stiempoal winhaj Ezequías sreyal Judá, a winhaj Miqueas aj Moreset ix lolon t'a sb'i Jehová t'a masanil heb' kajan t'a Judá, ix yalan winh icha tik: Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil tz'alan icha tik: Ha Sion tik ol kan yikok munlajel. Ha pax Jerusalén ol emkan lanhnajok, haxo jun tzalan b'aj ay templo tik, wayumtak ol ajok, xchi Jehová, xchi winh.

Palta tokwal ix miljicham winh yuj winhaj rey Ezequías chi' yet' pax yuj heb' anima. Anhej to ix xiw winh, ix tewi winh t'a Jehová. Yuj chi' majxo yak'kot yaelal Jehová toxo ix yal chi'. Tato sko milcham winhaj Jeremías tik, ol kik'kot yaelal t'a kib'anh, xchi heb'.

(Yet' pax winh schekab' Dios skuchan Urías yuninal winhaj Semaías, aj Quiriat-jearim, a winh ix lolon t'a sb'i Jehová t'a jun chonhab' tik yet' t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' ay t'a yol smakb'en, icha ix aj walan Jeremías in tik.

Ha winhaj rey Joacim yet' heb' ayoch yajalil yet'ok yet' heb' niwak yopisio, ix yab' heb' tas ix yal winh. Ix snib'ej winh rey chi' smilcham winh. Axo yik ix yab'an winhaj Urías chi' tas yaji, ix xiwb'at winh, ix b'at winh elelal t'a Egipto.
Ix chekjib'at winhaj Elnatán yuninal winhaj Acbor yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh winak yuj winhaj rey Joacim t'a Egipto chi'.

Haton heb' winh ix b'at ik'ankot winhaj Urías chi', ix yak'anoch winh heb' t'a yol sk'ab' winh rey chi'. Ix yalan winh to smiljicham winh, syumjib'at sniwanil winh b'aj sb'atkan sniwanil heb' komon anima. Icha chi' ix aji.)
Palta a in Jeremías in tik, maj in ak'jioch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' anima yik tzin smilancham heb', yujto a winhaj Ahicam yuninal winhaj Safán ix yak'och sb'a wet'ok.
Ayik toto ochnak winhaj Sedequías yuninal winhaj Josías reyal t'a Judá, ix lolon Jehová t'ayin Jeremías in tik.
Ix yalan icha tik: B'o junok te' yugo yet' juntzanhok nok' tz'uum, tzak'ank'e t'a yib'anh a jaj.

Slajwi chi', tzak'anb'at junok cheknab'il t'a heb' sreyal Edom, t'a heb' yik Moab, t'a heb' yik Amón, t'a heb' yik Tiro yet' t'a heb' yik Sidón. Ha t'a heb' chekab' sjawi ul yil winhaj rey Sedequías t'a Jerusalén, ata' tzak'b'ati.
Tzal t'a heb' to syal heb' t'a heb' sreyal, to a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, sDiosal in Israel tik, a in swala':
Yet' wal in poder te niwan, in b'onak yol yib'anhk'inal tik yet' masanil tastak ay t'ay. In b'onak heb' anima yet' nok' nok', yuj chi' syal wak'an t'a yalnhej mach b'aj in gana swak'a'.
Yuj chi', a tiknaik swak'kanoch juntzanh nakión tik t'a yol sk'ab' winh in chekab' aj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia. Swak'paxkanoch nok' kaltakte'al nok' t'a yalanh smandar winh.

Masanil nakión ol kan t'a yol sk'ab' winh, t'a yol sk'ab' yuninal winh yet' t'a yol sk'ab' yixchikin winh, masanto ol ja sk'ual yak'ji ganar Babilonia chi'. Ichato chi' ol kan Babilonia chi' t'a yol sk'ab' juntzanhxo nakión yet' t'a yol sk'ab' juntzanhxo rey niwak yelk'och yet' yopisio.
Ha in Jehová in swala', tato ay junok nakión max yak'och sb'a t'a yalanh smandar winhaj Nabucodonosor chi', ol wak'och yaelal t'a yib'anh, haton owal, wejel yet' ilya, masanto ol satel heb' yuj winh.

Yuj chi', manh he cha eyab' tas syal heb' tz'alan t'ayex to max eyak'och he b'a t'a yalanh smandar winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia chi'. Ha heb' tz'alan juntzanh chi', haton heb' tik: Eb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok, heb' naumel lolonel, heb' snaanel tas syal wayich yalani yet' heb' schuman yet' k'een k'anal yet' heb' skomon alan tastak toto ol ujok.
Masanil juntzanh tas syal heb' chi', esnhej, yujto ol ex ik'jokb'at t'a juntzanhxo ch'ok nakional. Ha in ol ex in pechb'ati, ata' ol ex chamok.
Axo pax juntzanh nakión syak'och sb'a t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Babilonia chi', a in Jehová in swala' to ol wak'nhejkan heb' t'a sluum, ol munlaj heb' ta', xchi Jehová, xa chib'ati, xchi t'ayin.
Yuj chi' ix walanxi juntzanh tik t'a winhaj Sedequías sreyal Judá icha tik: Ak'och a b'a t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Babilonia yet' schonhab' winh, yik wach' max ex chami.

¿Tas yuj tza b'ekcham a b'a yet' a chonhab' yuj owal, wejel yet' pax yuj ilya? Yujto toxo ix yal Jehová to a juntzanh chi' ol ik'an masanil nakión manh ol yak'och sb'a t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Babilonia chi'.
Manh a cha ab' tas syal juntzanh heb' syaloch sb'a schekab'ok Dios, heb' tz'alani to max ak'och a b'a t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Babilonia chi', yujto nab'a es tas syal heb' chi'.

Ha Jehová ix alani to manhok schekan yal juntzanh chi' heb', nab'a es tas syal heb'. Tato tza k'anab'ajej tas syal heb' chi' jun, ol ach ik'jokel t'a tik yet' heb' esalwum chekab' tz'alan chi' t'ayach, ol ach cham yet' heb', xin chi t'a winh rey chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix walan pax t'a heb' sakerdote yet' t'a masanil anima icha tik: Ha wal Jehová tz'alani: Manh he cha eyab' tas syal juntzanh heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok chi'. Syalan heb' t'ayex to toxo ol ak'jok meltzaj masanil yamk'ab' yik templo ik'b'ilb'at t'a Babilonia. Ha juntzanh syal heb' chi' t'ayex, esal lolonel.
Yuj chi' manh he cha eyab'i. Hak'ek wal och he b'a t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Babilonia chi', yik wach' ol ex kajnajnhej t'a tik. ¿Tas yuj ol kan tzinan jun chonhab' tik?

Tato yel in chekab' heb', tato yet'nak in lolonel heb', tewokab' heb' t'ayin a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, yik max wach' ik'jib'at juntzanhxo yamk'ab' yik in templo t'a Babilonia yet' tastak kannak t'a spalakio heb' tz'ak'an reyal t'a Judá yet' t'a Jerusalén, xchi Jehová, xin chi t'a heb'.

Ayik ix ik'jib'at winhaj Jeconías sreyal Judá, winh yuninal winhaj Joacim yuj winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia, ix ik'jipaxb'at heb' ayoch yajalil t'a Jerusalén yet' winh. Ayik ix ik'jib'at heb' chi' maj ik'jib'atlaj juntzanh niwak oy, jun niwan pila nab'a bronke yet' sb'akhnub'al yet' juntzanhxo syamk'ab'il templo yet' tas ix kan t'a spalakio heb' sreyal Judá yet' Jerusalén. Yuj chi' ix yal Jehová icha tik: Ab'ek tas swal a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, he Diosal in a ex israel ex tik.
Ha in swala' to masanil tas ix kan chi' ol ik'jokb'at t'a Babilonia, ata' ol kannhej, masanto ayik ol ex wik'anxi meltzaj t'a he chonhab' tik, xchi Jehová.

Ayik schanhil ab'il yoch winhaj Sedequías reyal t'a Judá, ayik yoil ujal yoch jun ab'il chi', a winhaj Hananías yuninal winhaj Azur, aj Gabaón, jun winh syaloch sb'a schekab'ok Dios, ix lolon winh t'ayin Jeremías in tik t'a templo. T'a yichanh heb' sakerdote yet' t'a yichanh heb' anima smasanil, ix yalan winh:
--Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, a tz'alan icha tik: Ol in mak' kanhchaj jun te' syugo winh sreyal Babilonia, haton spoder winh ayem t'a eyib'anh.
Yik wal chab' ab'il tik, ol wak' ik'jok meltzaj masanil yamk'ab' yik templo ik'b'ilb'at yuj winhaj Nabucodonosor t'a Babilonia.

Ha in Jehová in swala' to ol wak' meltzaj winhaj Jeconías sreyal Judá, winh yuninal winhaj Joacim yet' masanil heb' anima ik'b'ilb'at t'a Babilonia chi'. Ol in kanhchitej syugo winh rey chi' ayem t'a eyib'anh, xchi Jehová, xchi winhaj Hananías chi'.
Ix in tak'wi t'a winh t'a yichanh heb' sakerdote yet' t'a yichanh masanil anima ayek' t'a templo chi'. Ix walan icha tik:

--Ichokab' chi'. Komonok icha chi' sk'ulej Jehová. Komonok syak'elk'och juntzanh lolonel tzal chi', syak'an ik'jok meltzaj masanil yamk'ab' yik templo ik'b'ilb'at t'a Babilonia chi' yet' masanil anima.
Palta ab' wal juntzanh tas ol wal tik t'ayach yet' t'a heb' anima tik:
Ha heb' schekab' Dios ek'nak t'a peka', ayik manto onh alji et'ok, yalnak heb' to ol ja owal, yaelal yet' ilya t'a yib'anh juntzanh nakión ay spoder.
Palta tato ay junok chekab' tz'alani to ol ja wach'il t'a juntzanh nakión, ato yik ol elk'ochok, ichato chi' ol cheklajelok to a Jehová ix chekan yala', xin chi.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yik'anel jun te' yugo chi' winhaj Hananías ayoch t'a in jaj, ix skanhchitan te' winh.

Ix yalan winh t'a yichanh heb' anima chi' icha tik: --Syal Jehová icha tik: Yik wal chab' ab'il tik, ol wik'el spoder winhaj Nabucodonosor ayoch t'a yib'anh juntzanh nakión tik, xchi Jehová chi', xchi winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix in b'atxi.
Ayik ix ek'b'at jun pekti' ayik toxo ix smak' kanhchaj te' yugo winhaj Hananías ix yik'el t'a in jaj chi', ix lolon Jehová t'ayin, ix yalan icha tik:
Ixik, b'at al t'a winhaj Hananías to a in Jehová in swala': Ha ach ix a kanhchitej te' yugo nab'a te', a inxo ol wak'och jun yugo nab'a hierro sk'exulok te te' chi'.

Ha in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, sDiosal in Israel swal icha tik: Ix wak'och jun yugo nab'a hierro t'a yib'anh juntzanh nakión walnak, yik skan heb' t'a yalanh smandar winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia. Anhejtona' nok' kaltakte'al nok', ix wak'kanoch nok' t'a yalanh smandar jun winh rey chi', xchi Jehová.
Ixlajwi chi', ix walan t'a winhaj Hananías chi' icha tik: --Hananías, ab' wal tas ol wala'. Manhok Jehová ix chekan ala'. Palta a tas tzal syak'och heb' anima yipok sk'ool chi' manh yeloklaj.

Yuj chi' syal Jehová icha tik: Ol ach in satel t'a sat lum tik. Yuj a lolonel ix al chi', ix wach' pitb'iel juntzanh anima tik t'ayin, yuj chi' ha t'a jun ab'il tik ol ach chamok, xchi Jehová, xin chi t'a winh.
Ha t'a yukil uj t'a jun ab'il chi', ix cham winhaj Hananías chi'.

Ha in Jeremías in tik schekab' in Dios, ix wak'b'at jun in karta t'a heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab', t'a heb' sakerdote, t'a heb' schekab' Dios yet' t'a masanil anima aj Jerusalén ik'b'ilb'at yuj winhaj Nabucodonosor t'a Babilonia.

Ix wak'b'at jun karta tik, ayik toxo ix ik'jib'at winhaj rey Jeconías t'a Babilonia chi' yet' ix reina, haton ix snun winh. Ix ik'jipaxb'at heb' smunlaj t'a palakio, heb' yajal yaj t'a Judá yet' t'a Jerusalén, heb' jelan sb'oan tastak yet' pax heb' tenum k'een.

Ix ik'jib'at jun karta tik yuj winhaj Elasa yuninal winhaj Safán yet' winhaj Gemarías yuninal winhaj Hilcías. Haton heb' winh tik ix chekjib'at yuj winhaj Sedequías sreyal Judá t'a winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia chi'. Ha jun karta chi', icha tik syala':
E masanil ex aj Jerusalén ik'b'ilb'at t'a Babilonia yuj ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, haton Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, a tz'alan t'ayex icha tik:
B'oek he pat, tzex kajnaj t'ay, awejek eyawb'en te' yik tze loan sat.
Hak'uekoch eyetb'eyum, aljokab' eyuninal. Ochokab' pax yetb'eyum heb' eyuninal chi', aljokab' pax yuninal heb', q'uib'okab' he b'isul, mokab' emta he b'isul chi'.
Munlajanhek yuj swach'ilok jun chonhab' b'aj ix ex wak'b'at chi'. k'anek in kolwal t'a yib'anh, tato wach' tz'aj jun chonhab' chi', wach' pax ol ex aj yet'ok.

Yujto a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, he Diosal in, a in swal juntzanh tik: Manh eyak' he b'a musansatil yuj juntzanh heb' syesejoch sb'a in chekab'ok yet' heb' naumel lolonel yalani. Manh he cha eyab' swayich heb' syala'.
Ha tas syal heb' chi' t'a in b'i, nab'a es. Ha in Jehová in swala' to manhok in tzin chek yal heb'.
Swalanxi: Ayik ol tz'akwok 70 ab'il yak'an yajalil Babilonia chi', ol wak' in wach'k'olal t'ayex, ol wak'anpaxelk'och b'aj ix wak' in ti' to ol ex wik'xi meltzaj t'a tik.
Ha in wal Jehová in swala', wojtak tas nab'il wuj t'a he patik. Ha tas nab'il chi' wuuj, manh yujok eyab'an syaelal, palta yuj he wach'ilok yik wach' ay tas tzeyak'och yipok he k'ol t'a b'ak'uinh.
Ol lajwok chi', ol eyal he b'a t'ayin, ol ex lesalwok t'ayin, ol wab'an he lesal chi'.
Ha in wal Jehová in swala' to ol ex jawok t'ayin, ol in ch'ox in b'a t'ayex, yujto ol eyak'och he b'a t'a yol in k'ab' t'a smasanil he k'ool.

Ha in Jehová in swala', ol in ch'oxnhej in b'a t'ayex. Ol in k'ex tas eyaji. Ol ex wik'kot t'a masanil nakión yet' t'a masanil b'aj ix ex in saklemejkanb'ati. Ol ex in molb'ej, ol ex wik'anpax meltzaj b'aj ayex ek' kajan ayik ix ex ik'jib'ati, xchi Jehová.
Ha ex tik tzeyala': Ayxo heb' schekab' Jehová t'ayonh t'a Babilonia tik, xe chi.

Palta syal Jehová icha tik t'a yib'anh winh rey ayoch t'a sdespachokan winhaj rey David yet' t'a heb' kajan t'a jun chonhab' tik, haton juntzanh heb' ayto eyuj he b'a yet'ok, heb' maj ik'jib'at t'a Babilonia chi':
Ha in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil swal icha tik: Ol wak'b'at owal, wejel yet' ilya t'a skal heb'. Lajan ol wutejkan heb' icha juntzanh te' higo k'aeltakxo, te chuklaj, maxtzak yal sloji.

Ol in pechb'eyek' heb' yuj owal, yuj wejel, yuj pax ilya. Ol wak'an yajjok heb' yuj masanil nakión. Ol ja katab' t'a yib'anh heb', ol xiw heb' anima yuj heb' ayik ol yilanoch heb'. Ol b'uchwaj heb' t'a heb', ol b'ajjok heb' yuj juntzanh nakión b'aj ol in saklemejkanb'ati.
Ha in Jehová in swala' to tzijtum el ix alji t'a heb' yuj heb' in chekab', palta maj scha yab' heb' tas ix yal heb' in chekab' chi'. Anhejtona' ex pax tik maj he chapax eyab'i.
E masanil ex aj Jerusalén ix ex wak' ik'jokb'at t'a Babilonia, ab'ek wal in lolonel swala'.

Ha in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, he Diosal in paxi, swal yuj winhaj Acab yuninal winhaj Kolaías yet' yuj winhaj Sedequías yuninal winhaj Maasías, haton heb' winh tz'alan juntzanh esal lolonel t'a in b'i: Ol wak'och heb' winh t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia. Ha winh ol chekan miljokcham heb' winh t'a eyichanh.

Yuj chi', ex aj Judá, ex ik'b'il ex b'at t'a Babilonia, tato ayex ol he nib'ej he katab'ej junok mach, ol eyal icha tik: Ach yutejokab' Jehová icha utajnak winhaj Sedequías yet' winhaj Acab, haton heb' winh scheknak winhaj Nabucodonosor nhusjoktz'aok, xe chama.

Icha chi' ol aj sja t'a yib'anh heb' winh, yujto te chuk tas sk'ulej heb' winh t'a yol he chonhab'. Tz'em heb' winh ajmulal yet' heb' ix yetb'eyum heb' yetwinakil. Syalan juntzanh esal lolonel heb' winh t'a in b'i, manhok in tzin chek yal heb' winh. Ha in Jehová in swala', wojtak tas yaji, xchi Jehová, xin chib'at t'a jun in karta chi'.

Ay jun winh skuchan Semaías aj Nehelam ayek' t'a Babilonia chi'. T'a yol yik winh ix yak'kot jun karta t'a masanil heb' anima kajantokan t'a Jerusalén yet' t'a winhaj sakerdote Sofonías yuninal winhaj Maasías yet' t'a juntzanhxo heb' winh sakerdote. Ha t'a jun karta chi' ix yalkot winh t'a winhaj Sofonías chi' icha tik: Ha Jehová Dios ix ach ak'anoch sakerdoteal sk'exulok winhaj Joiada, yik wach' kuchb'um tzach aj t'a stemplo. Tato ay mach sk'och t'ayach aykot t'a sjolom tz'och ijan slolon icha heb' schekab' Dios. Ha jun chi' elanhchamel tzak'och t'a yol te' kepo, tza tzek'an yet' k'een kadena. ¿Tas yuj maj a kach winhaj Jeremías aj Anatot? Ix stek'b'ej sb'a winh slolon t'a ichanh, icha schekab' Dios syutej sb'a winh, yujto ix yak'kot jun karta winh t'ayonh t'a Babilonia tik. Syalan winh icha tik: Najtilto ol ex kajnaj ta'. B'oek he pat, tzex kajnaj t'ay, awejek eyawb'en te' yik tze loan sat, xchi jun skarta winh chi' t'ayonh, xchi skarta winhaj Semaías chi'. Ix yawtan jun karta chi' winhaj sakerdote Sofonías wab' a in Jeremías in tik. Ixlajwi chi', a Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, haton ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, ix lolon t'ayin. Ix yalan icha tik: Alb'at t'a heb' ik'b'ilb'at t'a Babilonia to a in swal icha tik: Ha winhaj Semaías aj Nehelam, winh ix alani to a in ix in chek yal winh to toxo ol meltzaj winh t'a Babilonia chi'. Palta manhok in ix in chek yal jun esal lolonel winh ix eyak'och yipok he k'ol chi'. Yuj chi', a in Jehová in swala' to ol wak' syaelal winhaj Semaías chi' yet' pax heb' yinhtilal. Manhxalaj junok yinhtilal winh chi' ol aj t'a skal heb' in chonhab', yik syak'an tzalajb'ok sk'ol t'a in wach'k'olal ol wak' t'ayex, yujto ix ex skuchb'ej winh yik tze pitej he b'a t'ayin, xchi Jehová, xa chib'ati, xchi t'ayin.
Haton slolonel Jehová tik ix yal t'ayin Jeremías in tik:
Ha in Jehová he Diosal in a ex israel ex tik, swal icha tik: Tz'ib'ejkan masanil tas ix wal t'ayach,

yujto ol k'och sk'ual, ol wak' meltzaj heb' in chonhab' Israel yet' heb' aj Judá ik'b'ilb'at t'a Babilonia. Ha in Jehová in swala' to ol wik'xi meltzaj heb' t'a lum lum wak'nak smakb'enej heb' he mam eyicham, xchi Jehová.
Haton tas ix yal Jehová tik t'a yib'anh chonhab' Israel yet' t'a Judá.
Ix yalan icha tik: Tz'ab'chaj wal yel aw yuj xiwk'olal, manhxalaj tzalajk'olal.

k'anb'ejek wal eyab'i, tokwal ay junok winh winak tz'aj yune'. ¿Tas yuj swila', a heb' winh winak te tek'an, toxonhej wetz'wetz'och heb' winh t'a sk'ol icha heb' ix ix aykot syail unewel t'ay? ¿Tas yuj sakxonhej yilji sat heb' winh smasanil?

Ay jun k'ual to manhxa yalnab'il yaelal ol ujok, malaj junokxo k'u lajan yet' jun k'u ol jawok chi'. Haton t'a jun pekti' chi' ol och wal yaelal t'a yib'anh heb' yinhtilal Jacob, palta ol kolchajel heb' t'a skal.

Ha in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil swal icha tik: Ol wik'el te' yugo ayoch t'a sjaj heb' in chonhab', haton b'aj ayoch heb' chekab'wumal. Manhxa b'ak'uinh ol och heb' chekab'wumal t'a heb' ch'ok chonhab'il.
Ha in Jehová sDiosal in heb' tik ol in yak' serwil, ol yak'anpax serwil winh yinhtil winhaj David heb', haton winh ol wak'och sreyalok heb'.

Ex israel yinhtilal Jacob, in chekab' eyaji, manh ex xiwok, yujto ol ex in kolel yet' heb' eyuninal t'a jun nakión najat b'aj ix ex ik'jib'ati. Ha in Jehová in swala' to ol ex kajnajxi t'a junk'olal, manhxa tas ol he na'a, manhxa mach ol ex xib'tanok.

Ex yinhtilal Jacob, in chekab' eyaji, manh ex xiwok. Ayinnhejoch eyet'ok, ol in satel masanil juntzanh nakión b'aj ix ex in saklemejb'ati. Palta a ex tik manh ol ex in satel-laj, anhej to ol wak'och eyaelal icha t'a smojal. Manh ol ek'b'atlaj in ch'olb'itan tas eyaji.
Ha b'aj ix ex lajwi chi', max yal yanhtaji, a eyaelal manhxalaj sb'onab'il.
Malaj mach tz'alan eyaelal, malaj mach tz'anhtan eyechen chi'. Manhxa yanhal eyaelal chi'.

Masanil heb' tzex xajanani, toxo ix ex b'at satk'olal yuj heb'. ¿Tok tzato sna heb' tas tzex aji? Ha in ix ex wak' echnajok, icha ajk'ol wajoch t'ayex. Te niwan eyaelal ix wak'ochi, yujto manh jantakok he chukal, manhxo b'ischajb'enok.
¿Tas yuj tz'el wal eyaw yuj eyechen chi'? Manhxa yanhal eyaelal chi', yujto manhxo b'ischajb'enok he mul, yuj chi' icha chi' tzex wutej.

Palta masanil heb' snib'ej ex sataneli, ol satel heb'. Masanil heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayex, ol ik'jokkanb'at heb' t'a ch'ok chonhab'il. Ha heb' ix ik'anb'at tastak ay t'ayex, ol ik'jokpaxb'at yik heb'. Ha heb' ix elk'anb'at he k'ael, ol elk'ajpaxb'at yik heb'.

Wach'chom a heb' eyajk'ool chi' syal heb' t'a he patiktak icha tik: Ha Sion toxo ix aktajkani, manhxalaj mach tz'ok' sk'ol yuj, xchi heb'. Palta a in Jehová in swala' to ol wak' b'oxok he k'ool, ol wanhtej eyechen chi'.

Yujto ol k'och sk'ual, ol ex wik'xi meltzaj a ex yinhtilal ex Jacob tik b'aj ik'b'il ex b'ati. Ol ok' in k'ol t'ayex. Ha he chonhab' ol b'oxokk'e b'aj jub'ilem t'a sb'ab'elal yet' pax he palakio ol b'oxok t'a yet'tal.
Ata' ol k'e he jaj he b'itan yuj eyak'an yuj diosal, ol ex tzewaj t'a tzalajk'olal. Ol wak' q'uib' he b'isul, manh jaywanhoknhej ol ex ajok. Manh ol ex patikajelok, a in ol wak' sniwanil eyelk'ochi.
Ha ex israel ex tik, icha eyaj t'a peka', icha chi' ol ex ajxok. Tek'an ol ex ajxok t'a wichanh. Ol wak'och syaelal heb' ix ex ixtani.

Ha in Jehová in swala' to ha t'a he kal ol elta jun mach ol och eyajalilok, a ol ex kuchb'anok. Ha jun eyajalil chi' ol wak' jawok t'a in tz'ey. Yujto malaj junok mach skomon tek'b'ej sb'a sjawi t'a in tz'ey.
Ol ex och in chonhab'ok, a inxo ol in och he Diosalok, xchi Jehová.
Ha yowal sk'ol Jehová ol ja t'a yib'anh heb' chuk, icha wal junok owal ik' nhab' sjawi xumnajok.
Ha yowal sk'ol chi', manh ol ek'b'atlaj masanto ol elk'och tas nab'il yuj. Masanil juntzanh tik ol nachajel eyuuj t'a slajwub' k'ual.
Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ha wal t'a jun pekti' ol jawok chi', a in ol in och sDiosalok junjun makanhil heb' yinhtilal Israel, haxo heb' ol och in chonhab'ok.
Ha heb' israel ix elkan t'a yol sk'ab' chamel, ix scha in wach'k'olal heb' t'a tzinan lu'um, ayik wan sayanek' heb' b'aj syik' yip.
Ha t'a pekataxo in ch'oxnak in b'a t'ayex walannak icha tik: Ex israel xajan ex wuj t'a masanil k 'inal, yuj chi' tz'ok'nhej in k'ool t'ayex.
Ol ex wik'xik'echaanh. Eyet'nak he pandereta ol ex k'ex cheneljok yuj tzalajk'olal.
Ol eyawejxi te' eyuwa t'a lum tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Samaria. Ha mach ol yawej yuwa chi', ol yak' tzalajb'ok sk'ol yet' sat.
Yujto ol jawok jun k'ual to a heb' stanhwumal chonhab' t'a tzalkixtak t'a yol smakb'en Efraín, chaanh ol el yaw heb' icha tik: Kotanhek, koyek t'a Sion t'a Jehová ko Diosal, xcham heb', xchi Jehová.

Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: B'itananhek t'a tzalajk'olal yuj jun chonhab'il heb' yinhtilal Jacob, haton jun te niwan yelk'och t'a yichanh masanil nakión. Ab'chajokab' he b'itani, tzeyalan icha tik: Mamin Jehová, kol onh a chonhab' onh tik, a onh ayonh to kan tik, xe chi.

Ol wik' meltzaj heb' t'a jun nakión ay t'a norte. Ol in molb'ejkot heb' b'aj slajwik'och yol yib'anhk'inal. Ha t'a skal heb' chi', ata' ol jawok heb' max yal-laj yilani yet' heb' tz'em sb'eyi, heb' ix yab'ix yet' heb' ix ato wal yalji yune'. Te niwan ol aj sb'isul heb' smeltzajxi.

Axonhej lesal yet' ok'el ol yak' heb' ayik ol meltzajxok heb'. Ha inxo ol wik'b'at heb' t'a ha ha' tz'el yok yet' t'a yol jun b'e te ak'lik, manhxa b'aj ol telwok heb'. Yujto mamab'il waj t'a chonhab' Israel tik. Axo chonhab' Efraín, ichato in b'ab'el unin yaji, xchi Jehová.

Syalanxi Jehová chi' icha tik: Ex junjun nakión, ab'ek wal in loloni. Alekel t'a juntzanh chonhab' lak'an yet' t'a juntzanh chonhab' t'a sk'axepal ha' mar te najat ay, tzeyalan icha tik: Ha Jehová ix ak'an saklem heb' israel, anhejtona' pax ol molb'anxikot heb'. Ol tanhwajxok heb' yuj icha tz'aj stanhwaj nok' kalnel yuj stanhwumal, xe chi.
Yujto ol in kolkanel heb' yinhtilal Jacob, ol in kolankan heb' t'a yol sk'ab' juntzanh nakión te ay yip.

Ol ja heb', ol sb'itan b'it heb' t'a tzalajk'olal t'a tzalan Sion, haxo yak'an tzalajb'ok sk'ol heb' yet' jantak tas wach' ol wak' t'ay, haton ixim trigo, wino, akeite, nok' kalnel yet' nok' wakax. Lajan ol aj heb' icha te' awb'en te' aynhejoch yalil, manhxo ol el-laj yip heb' junelxo.

Ol k'e cheneljok heb' ix kob'estak yuj tzalajk'olal. Ol tzalaj pax heb' winh kelemtak yet' heb' winh ichamtak winak. Ha in ol wak' sniwanil sk'ol heb', ol meltzajoch skusk'olal heb' t'a tzalajk'olal, yelxo niwan stzalajk'olal heb' ol wak' t'a yichanh yaelal ix yil heb'.
Ha heb' sakerdote a wal wael te wach' ol wak' swa heb', haxo heb' in chonhab' ol yak' tzalajb'ok sk'ol yet' masanil tas ol wak' t'ay, xchi Jehová.

Syalanxi Jehová chi' icha tik: Tz'ab'chaj wal yoch aw t'a chonhab' Ramá, ay mach sik'sik'an wal yok' yuj yaelal. Ha ix Raquel tz'ok' wal ix yuj heb' yune'. Manhxa snib'ej ix sniwanaj sk'ool, yujto manhxalaj heb' yune' ix ix kani.

Ach Raquel, manhxo ach ok'ok, mokxob' el yal a sat yujto a in Jehová in swala', a tas ix a k'ulej yuj swach'ilok heb' une' chi', ol a cha spak. Ha heb' une' chi', ol elta heb' t'a schonhab' heb' ajk'ool, ol jaxkan kajan heb' t'a tik.
Ha in Jehová in swala' to syal ak'anoch yipok a k'ol tas ol ujok t'a b'ak'uinh. Ha heb' une', ol meltzajxok heb' t'a schonhab' tik.

Ix wab' wal sk'akwi heb' aj Efraín yuj kusk'olal, syalan heb' icha tik: Ix onh a k'ayb'ej icha tz'aj sk'ayb'aj junok nok' kelem wakax manh yojtakok smunlaji, palta ix kileli. Ik'onh meltzaj et'ok, b'ekan ko k'ol ko meltzaji, yujto a ach tik Jehová, ko Diosal ach.

Ix kik'el ko b'a t'ayach, palta ix ko na ko b'a tiknaik. Ayik ix nachajel ko chukal kuuj, toxonhej ix onh em nhojan yuj q'uixwelal. Emnakilxonhej skutej ko b'a yuj jantak ko mul ix och t'a yiktax ko kelem uninal, xchi heb' aj Efraín chi' t'ayin.

Ha in Jehová in swala' to a heb' aj Efraín tik, ichato wuninal yaj heb', xajan heb' wuuj. Wach'chom swak' syaelal heb', palta max waktej in naan heb', ya swab' yuj heb', yujto tz'ok' wal in k'ol t'a heb'.

Ex aj Israel, sik'lab'il tzeyilkan jun b'e b'aj tzex b'ati, yujto anheja' t'a jun b'e chi' ol ex meltzajxok yik tzex jax t'a he chonhab' ol eyaktejkan tik. Meltzajanhek ex chonhab' Israel. Meltzajanhek t'a juntzanh he chonhab'.

¿B'aq'uinh ol eyaktejkan he b'eyek' icha junok ix ix te pit? Ha in Jehová in ol wak' ujok junok tas to manta b'aj tzuji t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik: Ha junok ix ix ol tzuntzanb'at junok winh winak, xchi Jehová.

Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, haton ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, a tz'alan icha tik: Ayik ol wik'anxikot heb' israel tik t'a sluum b'aj kajantaxoni, ol laj yal heb' anima kajan t'a yol yik Judá icha tik: Yak'okab' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a yib'anh jun tzalan sik'b'ilel yuj, b'aj sb'eyb'alaj tojolal, xcham heb'.
Ol laj kajnajxok heb' anima t'a juntzanh chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá yet' heb' munlajwum tz'awan tastak, yet' pax heb' tanhwum kalnel ol kajnaj heb' ta'.
Ha in ol wak'xi yip heb' k'unb'inak. Ha heb' tz'el yip yuj wejel, ol wak' b'ut'jok sk'ol heb', xchi Jehová.
Ayik ix lajwi wilan juntzanh tik ix el in wayanh, ix in ek' k'elelok, te wach' jun ix ch'oxji wil tik.
Ha wal Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ol k'och sk'ual, ol wak'anxi q'uib' sb'isul heb' anima yet' nok' nok' t'a Israel yet' t'a Judá.

Ha in wal Jehová in swala' to icha wal ix aj wak'an wip in tok'aneli, in juanemi, wak'an ik'jokemi, in sataneli yet' wak'an ixtajok, anhejtona' icha chi' ol aj wak'anxi wip wak'anxiem yich, yik tzin b'oanxik'ei.
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi' manhxo ol yal heb' anima icha tik: Ha heb' mamab'il ix slo te' uwa heb' te paj, haxo heb' uninab'il, jululixonhej sb'at spajil te' t'a yichtak ye heb', manh xchiok heb'.
Yujto junjun mach ol cham yuj smul. Ha mach ol loan te' paj uwa chi', munil a ol ab'an spajil te', xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ol jawok sk'ual, ol in b'oan junokxo in trato yet' heb' yinhtilal Israel yet' heb' yinhtilal Judá.

Ha in Jehová in swala' to a jun trato chi', manh lajanok yet' jun in b'onak yet' heb' he mam eyicham ayik wik'annakelta heb' t'a Egipto. Ichato ochnak in ketzketz t'a sk'ab' heb' ayik wik'annakelta heb' chi', palta maj sk'anab'ajej in trato heb' in b'o yet'ok, wach'chom ichato wetb'eyum wutejnak heb'.

Haton in trato tik ol in b'o eyet'ok a ex yinhtilal ex israel tik t'a jun pekti' chi': Ha in wal Jehová in swala' to ol wak'och juntzanh in cheknab'il t'a he pixan, ichato ol in tz'ib'ejkanoch t'a he pensar, ol in och he Diosalok, a exxo ol ex och in chonhab'ok.

Manhxo yowalilok ay junok ex ol eyal t'a heb' eyetchonhab' icha tik: Ojtakejel Jehová, manhxo xe chiok. Yujto a in Jehová in swala' to he masanil ol in eyojtakejeli, wach'chom heb' unin, ma heb' icham anima. Ol wak' niwank'olal schukal heb', manhxa b'ak'uinh ol in nakot smul heb', xchi Jehová.

Ha Jehová ix ak'ankanoch k'u yik syak'an sakil k'inal t'a k'ualil, k'een uj yet' k'een k'anal yik syak' sakil k'inal t'ak'walil. A' tz'ak'ank'e ponhnaj ha' mar ayik sk'anh ha'. Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil tz'alan icha tik:
Yakb'an manto satel juntzanh tz'ak'an sakil k'inal chi', a ex israel ex tik manh ol ex satel-laj t'a nakional t'a wichanh.

Ha in Jehová in swala': Icha satcha'anh malaj b'ak'uinh syal yechtaji, mato icha sjulal yich lum lum malaj b'ak'uinh tz'ojtakajeli, icha chi' waj eyet' in chonhab' israel ex tik, malaj b'ak'uinh ol ex in patikejel yuj tas tze k'ulej, xchi Jehová.
Ha in Jehová in swalxi icha tik: Ol ja sk'ual to ol b'ochajxik'e in chonhab', schael yich t'a torre Hananel, masanto ol k'och t'a jun puerta ay t'a jun schikin.
Tojolnhej ol b'at t'a smojonal, masanto t'a lum tzalan yik Gareb, skumlajb'at t'a stojolal Goa.

Masanil lum sch'olanil b'aj smukchaj heb' chamnak, b'aj sb'at yumchajkanel k'een tik'aq'uil taanh yet' t'a yib'anh sti' ha ha' skuch Cedrón, masanto t'a junxo schikin b'aj ay puerta yik nok' chej, t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, wik ol ajkanok. Masanil juntzanh chi', manhxa b'ak'uinh ol juchajemok, manhxa b'ak'uinh ol satelok, xchi Jehová.
Ayik ayoch slajunhil ab'il yoch winhaj Sedequías reyal t'a Judá, ayik 18 ab'ilxo pax yoch winhaj Nabucodonosor reyal t'a Babilonia, ix lolon Jehová t'ayin Jeremías in tik.
Ha t'a yik chi' wan yak'an owal heb' soldado winhaj Nabucodonosor chi' t'a Jerusalén, a inxo Jeremías in tik, ayin och preso t'a yamaq'uil b'aj ayek' heb' stanhwumal spalakio heb' sreyal Judá.
Ha winhaj rey Sedequías chi' ix in chekan yamjok, yujto ix wal icha tik: Ha Jehová tz'alani: Ol wak'och jun chonhab' tik t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Babilonia.

Axo winhaj rey Sedequías, manhxo ol yal-laj skolanel sb'a winh t'a yol sk'ab' heb' kaldeo. Ol yamchaj winh yuj winh sreyal Babilonia chi'. Yowalil ol k'och winh t'a yichanh jun winh rey chi'. Ol lolon winh yet' winh, ol yil wal och winh.

Ha winhaj Nabucodonosor chi', ol schek ik'jokb'at winhaj Sedequías chi' winh t'a Babilonia chi'. Ata' ol kannhej winh masanto ol cham winh. Wach'chom ol eyak' owal yet' heb' kaldeo chi', palta manh ol yal-laj eyuuj, xchi Jehová, xin chi. Yuj chi' ayin och t'a preso chi'.
Ata' ix yal Jehová t'ayin icha tik:

Ilnab'i, a winhaj Hanamel yuninal winhaj Salum winh a k'ab' ok, ol jawok winh t'ayach, ol ul yalan winh icha tik: Man jun in lum ay t'a Anatot. Smoj ton wal a ach tza mana', yujto ayto kuj ko b'a, xcham winh, xchi Jehová t'ayin.

Icha ix aj yalan chi' t'ayin, icha chi' ix aji. Ix jawi winh in k'ab' wok chi' t'ayin ayik ayinek' t'a yamaq'uil b'aj ayek' heb' stanhwumal spalakio winh rey chi'. Ix ul yalan winh t'ayin icha tik: Man jun in lu'um ay t'a Anatot, t'a yol smakb'en Benjamín. Ha ach ay alan ik a manani, skan lum t'a yol a k'ab', yujto te ayto kuj ko b'a, xchi winh t'ayin. Yuj chi' ix nachajel wuuj to slolonel Jehová jun chi'.
Ix in manan lum t'a winhaj Hanamel chi', ix wak'an 17 k'een plata stojolok lu'um.
Ix in tz'ib'ankan jun trato chi', ix in makankan yet' in sello t'a yichanh heb' testigo.
Ixlajwi chi', ix wik'ankot jun b'aj ix tz'ib'chajkan jun trato b'aj ayoch sello chi', haxo skopiail maj och selloal yik wach' syal yilji.

Ixlajwi chi', a wal t'a yichanh winh in k'ab' wok aj Hanamel chi' yet' t'a yichanh pax heb' testigo yet' t'a yichanh masanil heb' wetchonhab' k'ojanem ta' ix wak'an in firma b'aj ix tz'ib'chajkan jun trato chi', ix wak'ankan schab'il t'a winhaj Baruc yuninal winhaj Nerías, yixchikin winhaj Maaseías.
T'a yichanh heb' ix wal t'a winhaj Baruc chi' icha tik:

Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, a ix alani to skan juntzanh b'aj ix tz'ib'chajkan jun trato tik, haton jun ayoch selloal yet' jun malaj selloal, tza sik'kan t'a yol junok lum chen yik wach' najtil ol ek'ok.
Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, ko Diosal, a tz'alan icha tik: Ha b'ak'uinh, ol laj smanxi spat heb' anima, slum heb' yet' te' uwa awab'ilxo t'a jun nakión tik, xchi Jehová, xin chi.
Ixlajwi wak'ankan jun b'aj ix tz'ib'chaj jun trato yik jun lum lum chi' t'a winhaj Baruc chi', ix in lesalwi t'a Jehová icha tik:
Mamin Jehová yet' wal a poder a b'onak satcha'anh yet' lum lum tik. Malaj tas ajaltak sb'o uuj.

Ha ach tik, tza xajanej jantak makanhil anima tz'eq'ui. Palta tzak'paxoch yaelal t'a yib'anh heb' uninab'il yuj smul smam yicham. Ach Dios te niwan elk'ochi, masanil syal uuj. Ha a b'i, Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil.
Te niwan elk'och t'a tas tza na' yet' t'a tas tza k'ulej. Ha ach tik, tzil masanil tastak sk'ulej heb' anima, tza pakan t'a junjun heb' icha wal smojal tas sk'ulej chi'.

Ha ach a b'onak juntzanh tas niwak satub'tak t'a Egipto yet' juntzanh ch'oxnab'il niwan yelk'ochi. Anhejtona' tiknaik jantak tas tza ch'ox pax t'a ko kal a onh israel onh tik yet' t'a skal masanil anima, yuj chi' tzach b'inaj wal.
Yet' wal jantak a poder chi' ik'nakelta a chonhab' Israel tik t'a Egipto, a ch'oxannak juntzanh tas satub'tak yet' juntzanh ch'oxnab'il niwak yelk'ochi. Yuj chi' xiwnak wal masanil anima.
Slajwi chi' ak'annak jun lum te yax sat tik t'ayonh israel onh tik, icha ajnak ak'annakkan a ti' t'a heb' ko mam kicham.

Palta ayik skajnajnak heb' t'a sat lum lum tik, yikannak lum heb', maj scha yab' a cheknab'il heb', maj sk'anab'ajej a k'ayb'ub'al heb', maj sk'ulej heb' tas tza chek sk'ulej. Yuj chi' ix ak'kot masanil juntzanh yaelal tik t'a kib'anh.

Ha tiknaik, a heb' kaldeo toxo ix sb'ok'e juntzanh stek'nub' heb' yik syak'an owal heb' t'a ko chonhab' tik. Yuj owal, wejel yet' ilya, ol yak' ganar ko chonhab' tik heb' ak'um owal chi'. Mamin, wan yelk'och tas alnakkani.
Palta Mamin Jehová, wach'chom ol ak'jok ganar jun ko chonhab' tik yuj heb' kaldeo chi', palta a ach ix ala': Man jun lum chi', tza tupan t'a yichanh heb' testigo, xa chi, xin chi t'a in lesal chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix tak'wi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:
Ha in Jehová in, sDiosal in smasanil anima. ¿Tok ay tas ajaltak sb'o wuuj?
Yuj chi' swal t'ayach, a in ol wak'och jun chonhab' tik t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal heb' kaldeo t'a Babilonia.

Ha heb' kaldeo wan yak'an owal t'a jun chonhab' tik, ol ochta heb' t'a yool, ol yak'anoch sk'ak'al heb'. Ol tz'ab'at masanil juntzanh pat b'aj ix laj yak'och smul heb' anima t'ayin, haton t'a spanhanil yib'anh juntzanh pat chi' b'aj ix snhus inkienso heb' t'a Baal. Ix yak'an wino heb' t'a juntzanh komon Dios, yuj chi' ix stzuntzejkot yowal in k'ol heb'.

Atax yik ix el yich chonhab' Israel yet' Judá, ix sb'eyb'alej juntzanh tas max scha in k'ol heb'. Ha in wal Jehová in swala' to max yaktej heb' stzuntzankot yowal in k'ol yuj juntzanh yechel komon Dios sb'ok'e heb'.

Ha heb' anima t'a jun chonhab' tik, yiktax ix el yich skajnaj heb' t'ay, masanto tiknaik, malaj jab'ok wach'il sk'ulej heb', anhej yowal in k'ol stzuntzejkot heb', yuj chi' ol in satel heb' yet' schonhab' tik.

Ha heb' Israel yet' heb' aj Judá, stzuntzej wal kot yowal in k'ol heb' yuj jantak chukal sk'ulej, lajan heb' yet' sreyal, heb' yajal, heb' sakerdote, heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok yet' pax masanil anima kajan t'a Jerusalén yet' t'a Judá tik.
Max kot k'elan heb' t'ayin, palta to a yich spatik heb' syak'koti. Wach'chom max waktej in k'ayb'an heb', palta manh wal jab'ok scha yab' heb', malaj yelk'och t'a heb' b'aj tzin kacha'.
Ix yixtejb'at in templo heb' to wiknhej yaji, ix yak'anoch juntzanh yechel yajb'entak heb' t'a yool.

Anhejtona' ix sb'opaxk'e altar yik Baal heb' t'a sch'olanil yik Ben-hinom, ata' snhustz'a yuninal heb' yet' yisil heb' silab'il t'a komon Dios Moloc. Icha wal chi' tz'aj yoch smul heb' aj Judá sk'ulan tas manhok in swala', max ek' jab'ok t'a in pensar juntzanh tas sb'eyb'alej heb' chi'.
Syal heb' anima icha tik: Ha ko chonhab' tik, ol ak'jokoch t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Babilonia yuj owal, yuj wejel yet' pax yuj ilya, xchi heb'. Palta a in Jehová he Diosal in swala':
Ol in molb'ejxi heb' b'aj ol in saklemejb'at t'a junjun nakión yuj yowal in k'ol te ay smay. Ol lajwok chi', ol in wik'anxikot heb'. Ha t'a tik ol aj heb', manhxa tas ol ik'an heb'.
Ol och heb' in chonhab'ok, a inxo ol in och sDiosalok heb'.
Junxonhej ol wutej spensar heb', lajanxonhej ol yutej heb' in yak'an serwil t'a masanil tiempo, yik tz'och swach'ilok heb' yet' yinhtilal.

Ol in b'o junok in trato yet' heb' t'a junelnhej, manh ol waktejkan wak'an in wach'k'olal t'a heb'. Ol wak' sk'ulej heb' to aynhej ol aj welk'och t'a sat heb', yik manhxa b'ak'uinh ol yik'kanel sb'a heb' t'ayin.
Yet' wal in tzalajk'olal ol wak'an wach'ilal t'a heb'. T'a wal yel ol wak' kajnaj heb' t'a jun lu'um tik t'a smasanil in k'ool.
Icha wal ix aj wak'anb'at jun niwan yaelal t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' tik, icha chi' ol aj wak'anpaxb'at wach'ilal t'a yib'anh, icha ix aj wak'an in ti'.
Ha heb' anima tik syal heb' to ol kan tzinan jun chonhab' tik. Manhxa anima, ma nok' nok' ol kan t'ay. Ol ak'jok ganar yuj heb' kaldeo, xchi heb'. Palta ol meltzajxok heb' anima sman lum lum tik.

Ol sman sluum heb', ol sb'oan yumal heb' yet' sello yet' pax sfirma heb' testigo. Icha chi' ol ujok t'a yol yik Benjamín yet' t'a spatik yichanh Jerusalén yet' t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá, t'a tzalkixtak, t'a ak'liktak yet' t'a yol smakb'en Neguev. Ha in wal Jehová in swala' to ol wik'xichaanh in chonhab' tik, xchi Jehová.
Ha in Jeremías in tik ayinto och t'a preso t'a yamaq'uil b'aj ayek' heb' stanhwumal palakio, ix lolonxi Jehová t'ayin, ix yalani:
Ha in Jehová in in b'onakem yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Wach' wutejnakkan lu'um t'a yet'tal, a in swal t'ayach icha tik:
Awajanh t'ayin, ol in tak'wok t'ayach. Ol in ch'ox t'ayach tas niwak yelk'ochi yet' tas satub'tak yalji to manh ojtakok.

Ha in Jehová he Diosal in, ay wal jun in lolonel swalkan t'a yib'anh spat heb' aj Jerusalén yet' t'a yib'anh spalakio heb' winh sreyal Judá. Ha juntzanh pat chi' wan sjuchajemi yik sk'anchaj sk'enal t'a juntzanh olan t'a smuroal chonhab', yik wach' max och heb' kaldeo yak' owal yet'ok.

Ha t'a yol juntzanh pat chi', toxonhej ol b'ut'jokel yuj sniwanil heb' anima ol miljokcham yuj heb' kaldeo yuj yowal in k'ol te ay smay. Ol in b'at mikan t'a jun chonhab' tik, yujto te niwan smul heb' ix och t'ayin.
Palta ol wanhtej heb', ol wak'anxi sk'inal heb', ol wak'an kajnaj heb' t'a junk'olal, manhxa tas ol ik'an heb'.
Ol wik'xi meltzaj heb' aj Judá yet' heb' aj Israel b'aj ik'b'ilb'at t'a ch'ok chonhab'il. Ol laj in b'oanxik'e schonhab' heb' icha t'a sb'ab'elal.
Ol wik'el schukal heb' ix yak'och t'ayin. Ol wak'an niwank'olal smul heb' yet' spitalil t'ayin.

Ol te tzalajb'ok in k'ol yuj Jerusalén tik. Ha wal yik ol yab'an masanil nakión yuj tas niwan yelk'och ol in k'ulej t'a in chonhab' tik, ol yal wach' lolonel heb' t'ayin, ol in yak'an b'inaj heb'. Palta ol sat wal sk'ol heb', ol ib'xokk'e heb' yuj xiwelal ayik ol yilan heb' jantak wach'il yet' junk'olal ol wak' t'a in chonhab' tik.

Ha ex tik tzeyala' to a jun lum tik kuseltak yajkani, manhxa anima, ma nok' nok' tz'ilchaj t'ay.
